This is the launcher that presents what, in my opinion, a home screen should be. It has only features that matter yet lacks nothing essential.
 Features: 
 Adaptive Icon Packs: Choose from many popular icon packs to customize your home screen. Even icon packs with adaptive icons are supported.
 Smart Unread: The widget on the first page will show the most important notification on your phone. When music is playing, control it by tapping the widget. Tap once to pause, twice to skip, three times to rewind.
 Feed overlay: Swipe right to open a news feed selected in the settings. Any app can implement a feed from now on. To use the Google App, you need Rootless Pixel Bridge v3 or newer from my GitHub 
 Themes: When you get bored of the default Android themes, there are many custom launcher themes to choose from in the settings menu. All of them have their own distinct style and feeling.
 Grid division: Choose if you want 4, 5 or 6 columns on your home screen. Or let the launcher decide using your phone’s size.

 QuickSwitch Support: Rooted users on Android 9.0 can use the QuickSwitch module to enable integration with the new recents look.

 HOW IT WORKS

 KEY FEATURES

 Personalized Backgrounds: Use your own pictures for a truly custom experience.
 Full screen widget adjuster: An intuitive, full-screen editor lets you drag to adjust size, width, and vertical position.

fdroid:com.anant.gecko.description:
Gecko is a free, open-source time-travelling audio recorder for Android. It keeps a rolling in-memory buffer of microphone audio so you can save something that just happened, then optionally keep recording forward.
Features:
• Continuous listening into a ring buffer (foreground mic service)
• Save the last 1 / 5 / 30 minutes, 2 / 6 hours, a custom span, or everything held
• Press-and-hold a duration chip to save history and keep recording
• Settings for RAM budget and sample rate (8 / 16 / 44.1 kHz)
• Exports WAV files to Music/Gecko via MediaStore
• Restarts listening after reboot if it was left on
• Multiple UI packs (Biolume, Sonar, Oxide, Volt)
Privacy:
• No ads, no analytics, no crash reporters
• Audio stays on-device; nothing is uploaded
• Microphone is used only while listening is enabled
Battery notes:
Defaults favour clear speech (16 kHz sample rate, 256 MB buffer, power-saving mic mode, quiet notification). Drop to 8 kHz in Settings when you want quieter battery.
Source: https://github.com/anantdark/Gecko
License: GPL-3.0-only

fdroid:com.odiousapps.mx3launcher.name: MX3 Launcher
fdroid:com.odiousapps.mx3launcher.summary: Minimal launcher screen for Google TV
fdroid:com.odiousapps.mx3launcher.description:
A minimal Google TV launcher: a flat grid of apps and nothing else.
Built as a lighter alternative to full-featured TV launchers (no
live-TV integration, no content recommendation rows, no search/voice)
for anyone who just wants a fast app grid.
Features:
* Flat app grid, 5, 6, or 7 columns (your choice), showing every
 installed launchable app.
* Top bar with a live clock, a Wi-Fi status icon that jumps straight to
 system network settings, a system settings shortcut, and the
 launcher's own settings shortcut.
* Theme: follow system, light, or dark, with a choice of background
 gradient presets.
* Per-app show/hide and reordering, via move-up/move-down controls
 rather than drag-and-drop, since drag gestures do not have a sane
 D-pad equivalent.
* Press Menu while an app icon has D-pad focus to jump straight to that
 app's system "App info" page (permissions, storage, uninstall), the
 standard "long-press an icon" destination on touch launchers, reached
 here without needing a touch-only gesture.
* Optional online backup and restore of settings via
 sync.odiousapps.com (see "Online services" below), with multiple
 timestamped backups to pick from when restoring, plus a one-tap reset
 to defaults (which works offline).
* Optional "Soundbar wake": before launching an app, call a URL on your
 own server to wake a soundbar that has gone into standby (see
 "Online services" below).
* A background service detects the device waking from standby and
 brings the launcher back to the foreground if something else (such as
 the device's own built-in launcher) took over during that time.
MX3 Launcher does not itself favour, require, or bundle any particular
third-party app -- it simply lists whatever is already installed.
Online services (both optional, off until you pair them):
The app grid and all other features work fully offline. Two features
talk to sync.odiousapps.com, a pairing/backup service run by the
developer, and only after you press "Pair" in Settings and approve the
request on another device (by scanning the QR code or entering the
short code at sync.odiousapps.com, where you sign in to your account):
* Online backup: pairing gives the TV a device token. When you back up,
 the TV uploads your theme, background gradient, column count, the
 list of hidden apps and your custom app order to sync.odiousapps.com,
 where it is stored against your account. The hidden-app list and app
 order are package names of apps installed on the TV (for example
 com.example.app). Restoring downloads a chosen backup back from the
 same server. Nothing is uploaded unless you press "Back up settings".
 Earlier versions saved backups locally to the Downloads folder
 instead, but that didn't work reliably on TVs: Android/Google TV has
 no Storage Access Framework file picker, and files saved by another
 app (or by a previous install or version of this one) can't be read
 back due to Android's file permissions, so backups couldn't be
 restored. Online backup replaced it for that reason.
* Soundbar wake: pairing fetches a URL and secret key that you saved
 earlier in your sync.odiousapps.com account; these are stored on the
 TV. Once enabled in Settings, every time you launch an app the TV
 makes a request to that URL (your own server, not
 sync.odiousapps.com) with ?key= , plus the IR code name
 and a "check current" flag, and waits for it to succeed before
 launching. No information about which app is being launched is sent.
 The server side needs the example script from the source repository
 (website_lan/send_ir.php), which relies on the MQTTv5Client PHP class
 (https://github.com/evilbunny2008/MQTTv5Client) to talk to the smart
 socket and IR blaster over MQTT. Without it, soundbar wake won't work.

fdroid:de.jeanlucmakiola.agendula.name: Agendula: Tasks
fdroid:de.jeanlucmakiola.agendula.summary: A Material 3 Expressive task app with CalDAV sync.
fdroid:de.jeanlucmakiola.agendula.description:
Agendula is a modern, open-source task app for Android.
Sync your tasks over CalDAV: add a Nextcloud, Radicale, Baïkal or any other CalDAV account and pick which task lists come along. Or keep everything on the phone — Agendula stores your tasks itself, with no account and nothing else to install.
Already use OpenTasks or tasks.org? Point Agendula at that app instead, so tasks synced by DAVx5 or similar show up as they are, and copy them into Agendula's own storage whenever you like, under Settings → Storage.
What it does: lists you manage in the app, due and start dates, all-day tasks, subtasks, priorities, progress, repeating tasks you can edit one occurrence at a time, several reminders per task with snooze, iCalendar import and export, a home-screen widget, launcher shortcuts and a Quick Settings tile.
The design is real Material 3 Expressive throughout, with dynamic color and expressive motion and shapes.
Privacy: no telemetry, no analytics, no ads. Agendula goes online only to sync with the CalDAV accounts you add. Without one, your tasks never leave the device unless you export them.

fdroid:dev.librenotes.app.name: LibreNotes
fdroid:dev.librenotes.app.description:
LibreNotes is a private, self-hosted note-taking app with end-to-end encryption. Your notes are stored only on your own server — no cloud accounts, no third-party services, no tracking.
Features:
- Markdown notes with live preview
- End-to-end encryption (XChaCha20-Poly1305 + Argon2id): the server never sees your plaintext or keys
- Offline-first: full local cache, works without network, syncs when your server is reachable
- Conflict resolution: if two devices edit the same note, you choose the winner
- Trash bin with restore and permanent delete
- Dark theme with orange accent
- Works on Android, Linux desktop, and web from the same codebase
The sync server is a single compiled binary you run on a home server. It binds to your LAN only. For access away from home, add devices and the server to a Tailscale or WireGuard mesh — no server changes needed.
All source code is AGPLv3. No proprietary dependencies, no Firebase, no Google Play Services.
Note: F-Droid and GitHub APKs are signed by different keys, so updates from the other source won't install over this one. Pick one source and stay with it.

fdroid:io.github.nongfsq.usbdebugguard.name: USB Debug Guard
fdroid:io.github.nongfsq.usbdebugguard.summary: Turn the screen off during long USB debugging sessions while keeping ADB alive
fdroid:io.github.nongfsq.usbdebugguard.description:
USB Debug Guard is a root-only tool for long USB debugging sessions. It protects the display while keeping ADB reachable, then restores the previous display settings when protection stops.
 Features 
 Detects USB data connections and ADB state through Android system APIs, without routine Root polling.
 Turns the screen off while keeping ADB reachable, or keeps it awake at minimum brightness for devices that lose ADB when the display sleeps.
 Saves and restores the previous display settings.
 Can lock the device after USB disconnects.
 Runs only after you enable its foreground service.
 Stops automatic Root work after a denial, timeout, exception, or process cleanup failure, preventing an endless su retry loop.
 English and Simplified Chinese.
 Requirements 
 A working Root manager such as Magisk or KernelSU, able to run Android settings and input commands.
 A USB data connection. A charge-only cable or charger does not start protection.
 Root behavior varies between devices, OEM firmware, and Root managers. Test the app on a non-critical device before relying on it for unattended sessions.

fdroid:org.c3lingo.audio.name: c3lingo audio

fdroid:org.c3lingo.audio.description:
Listen to c3lingo's live interpretation and the hall audio of talks at the Chaos Communication Congress and other events, on your phone and with your own headphones.
The app shows the event's channel list from the server, so it always matches the current event. Playback is native:
• keeps playing in the background and with the screen locked

The audio is streamed with WebRTC from a Galène server (https://galene.org/). The app connects to https://audio.c3lingo.org/, which can be changed in the settings.
The app is open source: https://github.com/stblassitude/c3lingo-audio

fdroid:rs.ltt.android.name: Ltt.rs
fdroid:rs.ltt.android.summary: Simple and maintainable Android e-mail client
fdroid:rs.ltt.android.description:
Proof of concept e-mail (JMAP) client (pronounced \"Letters\"). Makes heavy use of Android Jetpack to be more maintainable than some of the other Android e-mail clients.
Features, and design considerations:
* Heavily cached, but not fully offline capable. Ltt.rs makes use of JMAP’s great caching capabilities. However, marking a thread as read does a round-trip to the server to update things such as read count. The action itself won’t get lost even if performed offline.
* Account setup and done. Settings invite feature creep and its friend unmaintainability. There is one specific work flow. K-9 Mail or FairEmail is more suitable for others.
* Minimal dependencies. Only widely known, highly tested libraries from reputable vendors. Third-party libraries are often of poor quality, and end up unmaintained.
* First class Autocrypt. Ltt.rs fits right into its strict UX guidelines.
* Based on jmap-mua, a headless e-mail client, or a library that handles everything an e-mail client would, aside from data storage and UI. There is also lttrs-cli, which uses the same library.
* Looks to Gmail for inspiration in cases of uncertainty.

apple-itunes:900259081.name: Zoom Rooms
apple-itunes:900259081.description:
Zoom Rooms video conferencing systems use appliance or custom hardware deployments to bring high-quality video, audio, and sharing to any type of workspace, making it extremely flexible. Easily connect to participants on mobile devices, desktops, and in other rooms across a variety of locations.
The Zoom Rooms app on iPad has five modes to choose from: Zoom Rooms Controller, Zoom Rooms for Touch, scheduling display, workspace desk, and reservation only room.
Zoom Rooms Controller
Connect your iPad to a Mac, PC, or Zoom Rooms Appliance as the dedicated Zoom Rooms Controller for that room. The iPhone app allows you to pair with a Zoom Room, giving you similar control functionality from your personal mobile device.
Zoom Rooms for Touch
Use the iPad as a Zoom Rooms (for shared spaces), Zoom Rooms kiosk, personal Zoom Rooms or Zoom Rooms digital signage only device. Zoom Rooms (for shared spaces) and personal Zoom Rooms allow you to start or join Zoom meetings, start a Zoom Whiteboard session, and access other Zoom Rooms features. Zoom Rooms kiosk can be configured to provide virtual receptionist and Workspace Reservation functionality. Zoom Rooms digital signage only can be configured to show digital signage content. Consult Zoom support documentation for more details.
Zoom Rooms Scheduling Display
Connect your iPad to a Mac, PC, or Zoom Rooms Appliance as the dedicated scheduling display for that room. A scheduling display is usually placed outside the room to show current availability, display upcoming meetings, and allow users to reserve the room on an ad-hoc basis.
Workspace Desk
Use the iPad to display the status of a workspace desk and allow users to make ad-hoc reservations or check in for their existing scheduled reservation with a QR code.
Reservation Only Room
Use the iPad to display the status of a workspace reservation only room and allow users to make ad-hoc reservations or check in for their existing scheduled reservation with a QR code.
Simply install the Zoom Rooms app and follow the on-screen instructions to select a mode and activate.
KEY FEATURES:
● One touch to join or start a meeting
● Intuitive room controls to easily manage audio, video, participants, and more
● Supports native room control integration to control lighting, projectors, and more
Follow us on social @zoom!
Have a question? Contact us at http://support.zoom.us.

apple-itunes:585193266.name: Sygic: GPS Navigation, 3D Maps
apple-itunes:585193266.description:
Sygic GPS Navigation & Maps is innovative GPS navigation app with monthly-updated offline maps and with precise live traffic & speed camera alerts, both updated in real-time. It‘s trusted by more than 200 million drivers worldwide. Offline 3D maps are stored on your phone for GPS navigation without an internet connection. We update the maps multiple times per year for free, so that you can always rely on Sygic GPS Navigation.
NAVIGATE ANYWHERE, EVEN WITHOUT AN INTERNET CONNECTION

ESCAPE THE TRAFFIC

STAY SAFE

apple-macos:410968114.name: PDFScanner - Scanning and OCR
apple-macos:410968114.description:
There are many applications for macOS that allow scanning of images or text. Most of them are however complex, slow or not really suited for scanning documents or letters.
PDFScanner has been created with one simple task in mind: Scanning and archiving documents as quick and easy as possible, and making them findable with Spotlight search.
When performing OCR, PDFScanner adds the recognized text directly to the scanned image as an invisible layer, so the text can be selected and copied just like in other PDF files.
PDFScanner supports the following features:
• Support for all scanners that are supported by the macOS Image Capture application (please check that using the scanner in Image Capture works before purchasing to be sure)
• Direct scanning with the iPhone or iPad camera. Perspective correction is done on device and with adequate lighting the quality comes close to using a real scanner. This feature requires your Mac and iOS device to be logged in with the same iCloud account and the "Handoff" feature to be activated on both devices.
• Optical character recognition to make the document searchable, allow to find it via Spotlight and other search tools or copy the text.
• Supported OCR languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Turkish and Finnish
• Intuitive and fast user interface to reorder, delete or edit pages
• Fully automatic straightening of crooked pages (deskew), manual correction also available
• Full multithreading support. Scanning, OCR and straightening is done on multiple pages in parallel and you can even reorder or delete pages while PDFScanner is still working
• „Fake Duplex“ mode to simplify scanning of double sided documents without a duplex scanner
• Saving to PDF (optionally compressing the scan inside the PDF to save disk space). PDFScanner can perform super high compression for monochrome scans (usually smaller than 50kb per page including OCR text)
• Supports PDF/A for long-term archiving
• Customizable file name patterns (include for example date, time and machine name in the filename) - PDFScanner can even guess the document title and date from the OCR text.
• It is also possible to open or import existing PDF documents and perform OCR on them via a menu option (the language can be set in the Preferences).
• Advanced users can use the included Automator action to create custom OCR workflows or folder actions
PDFScanner runs on all macOS versions starting with 13.5 Ventura and is compatible to Tahoe, Golden Gate and future releases. It is only available on the Mac App Store.

flathub:cc.craftos_pc.CraftOS-PC-Acceler.name: CraftOS-PC Accelerated
flathub:cc.craftos_pc.CraftOS-PC-Acceler.description:
CraftOS-PC is a fantasy terminal that allows you to write and run 
 programs inside an '80s-style text console.
 CraftOS-PC emulates the popular Minecraft mod "ComputerCraft", which 
 adds programmable computers to Minecraft using the Lua programming 
 language. CraftOS-PC takes this experience outside Minecraft to allow 
 you to run the same programs anywhere you go.
 CraftOS-PC provides a set of functions (called APIs) that make it super 
 easy to do simple tasks such as write text to the screen, read files, 
 and more. The simplicity of these functions makes CraftOS-PC great for 
 new programmers, but their power makes it possible to write all sorts of
 complex programs with less code.
 If you aren't ready to write programs yet, there's already a large 
 number of programs for ComputerCraft that will work in CraftOS-PC, 
 ranging from simple games to whole graphical operating systems. These 
 can be downloaded through the built-in Pastebin and GitHub Gist clients.

FFaudioConverter is a graphical audio converter application.
 It can convert files or whole folders containing music and video files to other audio formats.

flathub:io.github.NikolausB.WorkoutTimer.name: Workout Timer
flathub:io.github.NikolausB.WorkoutTimer.description:
A sport training application for Linux. Features a configurable round timer with pause periods
 and audio alerts, a training plan builder with multi-round circuit support, and an AI coach for
 generating personalized plans.
 Features:
 Home page with quick access to recent and recommended workouts
 Configurable round timer with adjustable rounds, duration, and pause
 Training plan builder with timed and rep-based exercises
 Multi-round circuits with configurable rest between rounds
 AI coach for generating training plans with local or cloud LLMs
 Built-in exercise database with 873 exercises
 11 pre-built default training plans, including pop culture-inspired workouts
 Training history with per-exercise logging and CSV export/import
 Customizable sound effects for different events

flathub:io.github.amarz45.Comicpress.name: Comicpress
flathub:io.github.amarz45.Comicpress.summary: Converts and compresses comics and manga for ereaders
flathub:io.github.amarz45.Comicpress.description:
Comicpress takes DRM-free comic book files (CBR, CBZ, PDF) and compresses
 them to a fraction of their original size while improving how they look on
 e-ink ereaders. It applies image-processing operations such as contrast
 stretching, high-quality scaling, quantization, and dithering, all of
 which can be customized or disabled.

flathub:io.github.doukutsu_rs.doukutsu-r.name: doukutsu-rs
flathub:io.github.doukutsu_rs.doukutsu-r.summary: A reimplementation of Cave Story's engine with many quality-of-life improvements
flathub:io.github.doukutsu_rs.doukutsu-r.description:
doukutsu-rs initially started as a Rust learning project, but eventually evolved into a complete and faithful reimplementation of the engine of Cave Story - a great indie game created by Studio Pixel.
 It brings many quality-of-life improvements that let you enjoy the 2004 indie classic like a modern game: game logic decoupled from the frame rate with motion interpolation for high refresh rate displays, a flexible non-fixed resolution, switchable 50/60 tps game speeds, multiplayer support, cutscene skipping, and enhanced lighting effects beyond those of the Switch version.
 A single executable supports game data from multiple versions: the original freeware release, Cave Story+, and the Nintendo Switch port.
 NOTE: The default data files directory is under $XDG_DATA_HOME/doukutsu-rs/data . That being $HOME/.var/app/io.github.doukutsu_rs.doukutsu-rs/data/doukutsu-rs/data by default.

flathub:io.github.kovzol.geogebra-discov.name: GeoGebra Discovery
flathub:io.github.kovzol.geogebra-discov.description:
GeoGebra Discovery is an experimental version of GeoGebra. It contains some bleeding
 edge features of GeoGebra that are under heavy development and therefore not intended for every
 day use yet, so they are not included in the official GeoGebra version.

flathub:io.github.tobagin.scramble.name: Scramble
flathub:io.github.tobagin.scramble.description:
Scramble is a simple utility for viewing and removing metadata from images. 
 The application provides a clean interface with a drag-and-drop workflow.
 View detailed image metadata including EXIF, IPTC, and XMP
 Remove metadata with a single click
 Batch process multiple images at once — clean an entire folder in one go
 Load images via drag-and-drop
 Keep your original files safe with a non-destructive workflow
 Work offline with no data collection
 Support JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, HEIF, and HEIC formats

flathub:io.github.zhrexl.thisweekinmylif.name: Schedule
flathub:io.github.zhrexl.thisweekinmylif.description:
Schedule is a kanban-styled planner that aims to help you organize your workflow and keep track of your activities efficiently.
 Easily create and manage your own activities and tasks, drag and drop cards anywhere, and implement your own ideas and system of task management with versatility.

flathub:io.sourceforge.wsjt.wsjtx.name: wsjtx
flathub:io.sourceforge.wsjt.wsjtx.description:
WSJT-X implements amateur radio communication protocols or "modes" called FT4, FT8, JT4, JT9,
 JT65, QRA64, ISCAT, MSK144, and WSPR, as well as one called Echo for detecting and measuring your
 own radio signals reflected from the Moon. These modes were all designed for making reliable, confirmed
 QSOs under extreme weak-signal conditions.

flathub:org.kde.klines.name: Kolor Lines
flathub:org.kde.klines.description:
Kolor Lines is a simple but highly addictive one player game.
 The player has to move the colored balls around the game board, gathering them into the lines
 of the same color by five. Once the line is complete it is removed from the board, therefore freeing
 precious space. In the same time the new balls keep arriving by three after each move, filling
 up the game board.

flathub:org.torproject.torbrowser-launch.name: Tor Browser Launcher
flathub:org.torproject.torbrowser-launch.summary: A program to help you download, keep updated, and run Tor Browser
flathub:org.torproject.torbrowser-launch.description:
Tor Browser Launcher is intended to make Tor Browser easier to maintain and use for GNU/Linux
 users. It downloads the same Tor Browser from torproject.org that everyone else uses, and it doesn't
 alter it in any way. But it does make it much more usable, and it makes the task of keeping it
 up-to-date more secure.
 You install torbrowser-launcher from your distribution's package manager and it handles everything
 else, including:
 Downloading the most recent version of Tor Browser for you, in your language and for your
 architecture
 Automatically updating (while preserving your bookmarks and preferences)
 Verifying Tor Browser's GnuPG signature
 Includes AppArmor profiles to make a Tor Browser compromise not as bad (in some distros)
 Adding a Tor Browser application launcher to your desktop environment's menu
 Lets you set Tor Browser as your default browser

fedora-packages:catch22/catch22-libs.name: catch22-libs
fedora-packages:catch22/catch22-libs.description: catch22 is a collection of 22 time-series features coded in C that can be run from Python, R, Matlab, and Julia. The catch22 features are a high-performing subset of the over 7000 features in hctsa. Features were selected based on their classification performance across a collection of 93 real-world time-series classification problems, as described in our open-access paper: - Lubba et al. (2019). catch22: CAnonical Time-series CHaracteristics (https://doi.org/10.1007/s10618-019-00647-x) The computational pipeline used to generate the catch22 feature set is in the op_importance (https://github.com/chlubba/op_importance) repository. For catch22-related information and resources, including a list of publications using catch22, see the catch22 wiki (https://github.com/chlubba/catch22/wiki). This package contains the implementation compiled as a shared library.

firefox-addons:2893360.description:
Stay organized online with Web Highlights — a powerful Firefox extension to highlight text on websites, annotate PDFs, take notes, and manage bookmarks. Whether you're a student, blogger, developer, researcher, or lifelong learner, Web Highlights helps you stay productive, save, organize, and revisit what matters — all in one place.
Use it as your personal text highlighter for Firefox with smart note-taking, PDF annotation, tagging, and full-text search. Choose offline use or sync everything to the cloud via the web app.
⭐ TOP FEATURES ⭐
🟢 Highlight websites and PDFs (including local files)
🎨 Multiple highlighter colors
✍ Take notes and connect them with your highlights
🔖 Save pages as bookmarks or use as a read-it-later web clipper tool
🏷 Tag your highlights & bookmarks for easy filtering
🔄 Sync across devices and access highlights anywhere *
💻 Web app & sidebar with an overview of all your highlights, bookmarks, and notes
🔍 Powerful full-text search to find anything instantly
📷 Highlight images and visual elements *
𝐓 Highlight in various formats (headings, paragraphs, etc.) *
🧠 Daily recap of your highlights for better retention
⚡ Use keyboard shortcuts for ultimate productivity
📄 Export to Notion, Obsidian, Capacities, and other popular note-taking tools
📑 Copy to HTML and Markdown
📁 Export to PDF and HTML files *
📱 Bookmark on mobile with our web app *
⏰ Set email reminders for specific pages *
📚 Import Kindle highlights easily
💾 Backup and download your research *
🔗 Share your highlights *
👥 Discover content from others
(*) Premium/Ultimate features available during a 7-day free trial: See pricing: https://web-highlights.com/pricing 
💡 WHY WEB HIGHLIGHTS?
✅ It just works – Highlight text in multiple colors on any website or PDF with a simple click
✅ Persistent highlights - Your highlights stay visible even after reloading the page.
✅ Works offline – No account required for basic use
✅ Sync across devices - Create an account to access your highlights anywhere from the web app.
✅ Integrate with Notion, Capacities, Obsidian, and other note-taking tools
✅ Export your research — PDF, HTML, Markdown, or clipboard.
✅ Perfect for online deep work & and efficient research management.
✅ Help children learn - We proudly support the Save the Children charity and other great causes.
🔥 HOW IT WORKS 🔥
You can use Web Highlights completely free without an account. Highlight, bookmark, and take notes offline anytime.
Create a free account to enable cloud sync and unlock all features with a 7-day trial. Afterward, continue using the free offline version with basic features or upgrade for seamless access across all devices. Check out the current pricing here: https://web-highlights.com/pricing .
💡 PRO TIPS & GOOD TO KNOW 💡
➡ Enable/disable the highlighter popup via the settings and highlight using keyboard shortcuts or by right-clicking text.
➡ Customize keyboard shortcuts in your Firefox settings: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/manage-extension-shortcuts-firefox 
➡ Some websites may have limited compatibility.
➡ Local PDF support requires access to file URLs (see PDF setup guide: https://web-highlights.com/blog/how-to-highlight-pdfs-using-web-highlights ).
➡ Right-click images to save them to your sidebar of highlights & notes.
➡ Use as a web clipper – Click the bookmark icon or right-click any website to save pages and add tags like "ReadingList" for easy reference later.
➡ Disable extension on specific websites: Click the power icon in the sidebar to disable the highlighter on a site. You can also configure a blacklisted domain list with patterns in the settings under "Excluded" domains.
➡ Sort highlights manually: Highlights should appear in the same order as on the page. If not, use the drag & drop or arrows in your annotation sidebar to rearrange them as needed.
➡ Customizable Sidebar: Change the sidebar width by dragging its edge, and align it on the left or right side of the page for a personalized experience.
➡ Switch to Advanced Highlighter Mode in settings to organize highlights with headings, paragraphs, and more in the sidebar.
➡ Multiple Colors: Choose from predefined standard and pastel shades or click the plus icon to add your own custom color.
➡ Note Taking: Use standard keyboard shortcuts like CMD + B for bold, CMD + U for underline, etc., in the note-taking editor for efficient formatting.
➡ Focus highlights on website: Click on a highlight in the sidebar, and the page will scroll directly to the highlighted section for quick access.
➡ Color Mode: Switch between dark and light mode by clicking the sun/moon icon in the sidebar.
➡ Your data is always private unless you choose to share it.
➡ You may be exposed to affiliate links on sites you visit while using this extension, and you may be encouraged to click on them, but you are never required to do so.

✔ Your highlights, notes, and bookmarks are private by default
✔ Nothing is ever sold or used to profile you
✔ Secure sync and export, only accessible with your account

firefox-addons:868460.name: MediaPlayer - Video and Audio Player
firefox-addons:868460.summary: A powerful media player built on top of the video.js project with HTTP Live Streaming (HSL), speed control, and playlist support
firefox-addons:868460.description:
"Media Player" is a browser extension to play music and video files either locally or from an online source. This project aims to bring VLC like media playing experience by using native HTML5 technology. The add-on is built on top of the well-known video.js project by applying a few custom plug-ins to enhance the user experience. This player supports media boosting, speed control, playlist media selection, fullwidth-progress bar, HTTP-streaming (M3U8), and wave surfer visual for audio files.
You can start watching an offline video file by drag and drop the video file into the player or by pressing the big play button. To have the player load subtitle as well, make sure to drop both video and subtitle files together (The dropped subtitle should have the same name as the file and needs to be in SRT or VTT format). Also, you can add a subtitle file later using the "+CC" button. This button appears when there is no subtitle found for the current track.
You can use your keyboard to control the following playback options:
1. "F" key: This will toggle the fullscreen mode on and off
2. "Space" key: This will toggle the playing state of the player
3. "Key Up" and "key Down": These keys can be used to increase or decrease volume.
4. "Key Left" and "Key Right": These keys can be used to seek backward and forward for 10 seconds.
This extension also supports media keys even if the player is not focused. Additionally, the mouse wheel can also be used to increase or decrease the volume.
Change Log:
0.1.2:
1. Media Player now supports history (it will save the current track position and retrieves it after a restart)
2. Media player now supports global keyboard shortcuts for toggle pause and play state, move to the previous track and move to the next track
0.1.3:
1. Better playlist!
0.1.4:
1. For audio tracks, a seek-able wave-surfer is replaced the old poster image
2. playback rate is now adjustable.
0.1.7:
1. Supports live stream (m3u8)
2. Supports folder drop and recursive media file search

Bunker Wars: WW1 Strategy is a real-time strategy war game with multiplayer! Gather an army, participate in epic PVP battles, devise your own tactics for victory, and become the best in tower defense!
In the midst of a world war, defend your base from enemies and break through their defenses. Upgrade your bunkers and expand your territories by sending an army to capture strangers. Install towers and distribute troops to different targets.
Strategize in every battle, bypass trenches, upgrade your base, and capture all enemy structures to win this epic RTS game!
Prove to other players that you are a real strategist and commander in real-time multiplayer! Play ranked battles in PVP mode with multiple players at the same time. Choose different game modes and improve your tactical skills in each of them. Get to the top of the best tower defense players by defeating rivals in ranked leagues!
Engage in an exciting campaign to lead your army to victory with every mission. Unlock unique heroes from various empires and upgrade their skills and talents to win on the battlefield. Choose from a large set of abilities to receive various advantages in the war for bunkers.
To win in RTS Bunker Wars: WW1 Strategy, you must try acting like a real general, fortifying your bases with towers, and tactically directing troops to enemy buildings. Enlarge your army, break through the opponent's defenses, expand your territory, and strengthen the defense of your towers. In this military strategy game, you need to react quickly and make decisions in real-time.

bluejetty:00019554:ios.description:
The Sonos app brings all your content and settings together in one place for effortless control of your Sonos products and listening experience.
ONE TAP TO ALL YOUR FAVORITE SOUNDS
The Home screen puts all your content and controls right at your fingertips. Quickly jump back into your recent favorites, discover new music, and fill your home with Sonos sound.
STREAMING STREAMLINED
Browse, search, and play content from all your services with a single app, including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, Pandora, TIDAL, Audible, Deezer, iHeartRadio, and SiriusXM. 
WHOLE-HOME CONTROL
Play something different in every part of your home or the same thing everywhere. The Sonos app gives you complete control of your Sonos products and listening experience from any room. 
PERSONALIZED LISTENING
Create your ultimate music library by saving go-to artists, albums, playlists, and stations to Sonos Favorites. Fine-tune products for your space with Trueplay™. And adjust settings for your needs and preferences. 
EASY SETUP 
The app automatically detects your Sonos products, then it’s only a few taps to incredible sound. Easily set up a stereo pair, create a cinematic surround sound system, and add speakers to more rooms. 
GET THE MOST OUT OF YOUR SONOS EXPERIENCE
Enable Sonos Voice Control to play music and control your system with hands-free ease and unheard-of privacy.* Explore helpful tips and recommendations in your Message Center. 
*Requires a voice-enabled Sonos product. Sonos Voice Control not available in all languages and countries.

bluejetty:00097129:ios.description:
Welcome to Supermarket Idle: Simulator, the ultimate idle tycoon experience! Have you ever dreamed of running your own grocery store? Start your journey today, manage every detail of your shop, and turn a local market into a massive retail empire.
In this addictive simulator, you are the boss! Experience the thrill of managing a fast-paced supermarket where every decision matters. From stocking shelves to handling the checkout, the success of your business is in your hands.
Master Your Store Layout
Design your layout, organize aisles, and optimize the flow to ensure customers find everything they need. A well-organized shop is the key to happy shoppers!
Stock, Sell and Profit
Keep your shelves filled with fresh groceries, snacks, and electronics. Don’t let your customers leave empty-handed—efficiency is everything in the retail world.
Build a Wealthy Empire
Even when you’re away, your business keeps earning! Upgrade your offline income to maximize wealth and become the most successful tycoon in the industry.
Hire and Train Your Team
Recruit professional cashiers and stockers to keep the lines moving. Experience realistic mechanics as you grow your staff and scale your operations.
Unlock New Sections
Expand your business with new areas like the Bakery, Pharmacy, and Produce section. Grow from a tiny mini-mart into a giant hypermarket!
Boost Your Sales
Run promotions and discounts to attract more shoppers. Increase your daily revenue and prove your management skills in this strategic business adventure.
Why you will love Supermarket Idle:
Satisfying organizing and stocking gameplay.
Deep management strategy for casual and pro players.
A perfect blend of idle mechanics and business growth.
Realistic supermarket atmosphere and smooth controls.
Download Supermarket Idle: Simulator now and start your retail adventure! Can you become the world’s most successful store manager?

Join millions of music lovers who have upgraded their iPhone audio with Boom. Enjoy deeper bass, immersive 3D surround sound, personalized Headphone EQ for 5,000+ headphone models, a powerful 16-band equalizer, and seamless offline music playback. Organize and enjoy your favorite tracks anytime, anywhere while experiencing richer, clearer, and more immersive sound. Once you hear your favorite songs with Boom, ordinary audio simply won't compare. Get your 7-day trial now!
■*** Why You'll Love Boom ***■
• 3D Surround Sound: Patented technology, amazing audio on any headphones.
• Bass Booster: Amp-up your music and feel every beat come to life
• Perfect Sound for Every Headphone: Automatically optimize sound for over 5,000 headphone models with the all-new Boom Headphone EQ.
• 29 Handcrafted EQ Presets: Dubstep, pop & many more presets.
• 8 or 16-band Custom Equalizer: Craft your own Equalizer to enjoy your music in your way
• TIDAL with Boom: Incredible listening experience from the leading streaming service.
• Stream 40K Radio Stations and Podcast Worldwide: Improved audio output on your favorite stations
• Multiple Library Access: Access phone music and music stored on Dropbox & Google Drive too!
• Files support - To access songs stored on your phone or other cloud storage services such as OneDrive.
• Music Visualizer: Watch every beat come alive with stunning real-time visualizers.
• Synced Lyrics Support: Sing along with real-time lyrics or create and sync your own.
• Beautiful, User-Friendly Interface: Clean, minimal and easy to use interface
• Enhances All Headphones: Get an amazing listening experience on any headphones
• CarPlay Support - Access your music on a CarPlay compatible infotainment system when your phone is connected!
Offline Music Playback
■ Multiple ways to Add Music for Offline Listening.
* Transfer from Computer Upload songs wirelessly from a computer on the same network using the phone’s IP address. 
* Import from Phone Import files or folders directly from the Files app, including audio from the Apple Music library. 
■ Download from Web
* Download music directly from supported websites using an in-app browser, with support for link-based downloads (e.g., YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp).

You can enjoy Boom for free with our 7-day trial version. Get unrestricted access to all features and experience the magic of vibrant audio output for free.

• Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

bluejetty:00146410:ios.description:
KeePass Touch - The Cross-Plattform Password Manager
===========
You often forget your passwords and just can't remember? 
Probably go through that horrible password reset stuff via email, hm?
What if you won't have to do that any longer?
You're looking for a way to keep all your passwords safe and be able to get to them anytime and anywhere?
Well, search no more! Welcome to KeePass Touch!
KeePass Touch provides a secure password storage / manager on your device that's compatible with any KeePass Application on any device: PC, Tablet or phone. So you can get to all your passwords anywhere. Just remember your one Master Password and all your other passwords are safe & secure and you don't need to know any of them.
By using the most recent encryption standards your data and passwords are always secure.
** TOP Features **
- Dropbox & One Drive with AutoSync 
- Import from CloudServices like GoogleDrive, OneDrive etc.
- Import via Files App
- Sync via WiFi Built in
- Sync to / from FTP Server
- Unlock KeePass Touch with FaceID & TouchID
- Open KeePass Touch from other Apps (Callback-URL)
Additional Features:
- View, Edit, and Create KeePass 1.x and 2.x files
- Search for entries from the top of tables like in Mail
- Key File Support
- Copy password entries to the clipboard for easy entry
- Open websites in Safari while KeePass Touch runs in the background
- Prevent unauthorized access to KeePass Touch with a PIN
- Remember database passwords in the device's secure keychain
- Optionally clear the clipboard after set time on devices that support background tasks
- Generate new passwords
As this project ist "Open Source", it can provide a security, that similar programms just can reach, because everyone can look under the hood so you see what you get!!

- Simple games that young children won't get bored of

bluejetty:00176655:ios.name: Desh Tamil Keyboard
bluejetty:00176655:ios.summary:
Desh Tamil Keyboard is a keyboard extension that makes Tamil typing super easy:
• Type in English letters and get Tamil words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the langu
bluejetty:00176655:ios.description:
Desh Tamil Keyboard is a keyboard extension that makes Tamil typing super easy:
• Type in English letters and get Tamil words with our transliteration technology
• Type faster using word predictions
• Easily switch to English with the language key
• Word predictions and spell-correct is available in English also
• Emoji button is available after pressing 123
Open the app and follow instructions to get your new Tamil keyboard:
• Enable keyboard from settings
• Activate the keyboard by holding the Globe icon and selecting "Desh Tamil Keyboard"
• Type Tamil everywhere!
Allowing full access:
• When enabling the keyboard, you may enable "Allow Full Access"
• This allows us to access crash reports and will help us improve the stability of the app
• We respect your privacy. No personal information is collected
• A standard warning is shown when you enable any downloaded keyboard app
How to access settings:
• Tap on the ⋯ button after opening the app and tap Settings. This option will be available after keyboard is activated
• Available settings: sound on key press, vibrate on key press, emoji row, number row
Using the clipboard:
• The clipboard lets you save text that you frequently use and paste them easily
• After you copy any text, it can be viewed from the clipboard by tapping on "Paste copied text". You can use the Pin button to save it permanently
• To show copied text automatically when clipboard is opened, you can change the "Paste from Other Apps" setting to "Allow"
Using stickers to make your chats more fun:
• Open the stickers page by clicking on the sticker icon on the keyboard. Click on any sticker you like to copy it
• Navigate back to your chat app and use your phone's Paste option in the message box
• The sticker will be pasted in the chat. Note that animations are currently sent as GIFs due to technical limitations
Do share your feedback and help us improve Desh Tamil Keyboard. And don't forget to leave a review if you like it.

 THE.DEMON has designed the powerful 「SuperMe」App, allowing you to create the most lovely anime cartoon avatar Maker Creator. A customized cartoon avatar will make you cute and personalized on social networks.

8. You can save the creation to your mobile phone and update your social network avatar: Facebook、WeChat、 WhatsApp 、Twitter、Instagram、Pinterest、tiktok、linkedin...
9. You can share the avatar you created via Email, SMS, Bluetooth, and social networks.
10. Communicate the creation of your cartoon avatar online with nearly 20 million users around the world, and share your creation to get more praise and communication from global cartoon and cartoon lovers.
Online Activities
1. Sign-in activities: Different rewards can be gained when you sign in once a day, and the longer the sign-in time, the higher and richer the reward.

3. Adventure team game: a custom avatar adventure team, after feeding the team members, can bring you free gold coins and mysterious avatar accessories.

E-mail: partner@maoyoo.net

bluejetty:00179407:ios.description:
《三国演义：吞噬无界》是一款三国题材冒险跑图rpg手游。
游戏采用了经典回合制战斗模式，延用了FC摇杆操作，通过编队、技能、阵法等多维度设定，丰富了游戏策略性。同时搭配了探索式跑图玩法，以及有趣的烧脑解谜关卡，带你开启传奇三国之旅。
+++【游戏特色】+++
【品行系统 全新上线】
品行值系统上线啦！通过周目中的部分任务可提升品行值，纪律/仁义/勇气/魅力和智慧，任意一个品行值的不同，都可能影响人物事件的走向和结局。一起来创造专属于你的三国吧！
【单机逆袭 经典重现】
FC吞食天地重制版，比红白机更方便的对战，比像素点更精细的画面。采用弱联网设计，即使没有网络，一样可以畅快游戏。
【探索式趣味跑图】
探索式萌版地图，跟随故事主线层层延展，更多支线任务暗藏其中等你来发掘。在游戏中隐藏着众多的彩蛋，比如游戏中分散各地的神器，隐藏的看不见的道路，前后呼应的地图等等，甚至连NPC对话都暗藏玄机。这里的每一处细节，甚至连每一个武将的技能描述，都蕴含着我们对三国这段历史的独特思考。
【回合制策略战斗】
经典回合制战斗，敌方无论在阵型、武器、还是护甲类型都会存在弱点。根据敌方弱点选择合适的上阵武将，变换合适的阵型以更好的应对敌方。抛开无脑操作，阵法策略，尽显智慧，最终天下属于智者！
【名将招募养成】
《三国演义》中塑造了一批叱咤风云的英雄豪杰，在游戏中都会一一出现，关羽、张飞、诸葛亮……甚至周仓、廖化也能在游戏中见到其身影。每个武将都有其独特的天赋和技能策略组合，不同的阵容组合都会给你带来富有惊喜的战斗体验。英雄集结，吞食三国，随心搭配，书写属于你的三国名将传。
【自由剧情多结局】
游戏剧情高度还原历史，同时还有有趣的人物传记及限时剧情副本，体验不一样的三国。跟着剧情慢慢展开，NPC对话非常重要，吐嘈式对白，冷笑话集锦，他们的每句对白都将成为经典。

bluejetty:00181183:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00181183:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate 3D squishy toy simulator, designed to melt your stress away! 
Create, paint, and customize your own DIY fidget toys using a massive library of cute, kawaii colors and shapes. Squeeze, press, and stretch your virtual creations to experience oddly satisfying ASMR anti-stress physics right on your screen.
Create adorable cute DIY creations and discover the most relaxing fidget experience ever! Design, paint and color your favorite characters in full 3D, then squeeze, stretch, rotate and play with them just like real sensory toys. Build an amazing collection of handmade creations and enjoy an endlessly satisfying and calming experience that you'll want to come back to every day.
Whether you love fidget fun, relaxing ASMR, creative DIY games or realistic simulator experiences, Squishy Magic has something for everyone. Every toy starts as a blank canvas—choose its colors, textures and decorations, then watch it come to life before enjoying hours of interactive play. It's the perfect mix of creativity, collection and stress relief.
Love collecting adorable characters? Fill your shelves with hundreds of unique creations, including dumpling squishies, sugar squishies, axolotl and other magical creatures, plushie toys, ice cubes, pop-It inspired fidgets and many more Kawaii favorites. Every design becomes part of your personal collection, making every masterpiece truly your own.
Once you've finished painting and coloring, it's time to play! Press, squeeze, stretch, rotate and crush your creations using realistic physics in the ultimate simulator. Watch every toy slowly return to its original shape while enjoying relaxing ASMR sounds that make every interaction feel incredibly satisfying. It's the perfect antistress activity after a busy day.
Looking for creative Stress Relief? Let the soft sounds, smooth animations and realistic squishing melt away your stress. Every squeeze, every stretch and every bounce delivers a soothing, calming experience inspired by your favorite fidget toys and Sensory Toys. Whether you're relaxing for a few minutes or enjoying a longer play session, Squishy Magic is your happy place.

GEGO is a simple, powerful GPS tracking app that helps you keep tabs on what matters—luggage, vehicles, gear, and even people—with live maps, smart alerts, and secure sharing.
Do more with GEGO
 • Live GPS tracking with global coverage
 • Smart alerts: geofences, movement, and opening*
 • Share live links with family or support agents when needed
 • Easy setup; manage multiple devices in one app
 • Works for travel, commutes, business trips, and family safety
Popular uses
 • Bags: track checked luggage, get alerts, share with airline agents
 • Cars: anti-theft motion/geofence alerts, find your car faster
 • People: support kids, elderly, or loved ones with real-time safe zone alerts (with consent)
 • Gear: protect camera, sports & music equipment on the move
Plans & requirements
 • Requires a GEGO device and an active membership.
 • Manage your plan in-app.
Privacy & responsibility
 • You control what you share and with whom. For tracking people, obtain explicit consent and follow local laws.
*Opening alerts available on compatible devices and scenarios.

bluejetty:00039386:ios.description:
Previously known as FLICK SOLITAIRE.
Learn to play and love solitaire with a beautiful re-imagining of the classic card game.
Collect dazzling card decks by Inscryption, Monument Valley, Cyanide & Happiness and many more diverse global artists.
Relax and unwind in a calming sensory space where you choose how it looks - using your card collection.
Take some time for YOU and relax with a good FLICK.
A modern, stylish and tactile solitaire game that provides a global platform for artists and their work, this is solitaire as you’ve never experienced it.
Make cards fly with our unique “FLICK” action. Quickly flick cards instead of dragging them! Making it feel and sound like you're playing with real cards.
Learn to play and love solitaire with our in game tips and tutorials.
• Classic Solitaire (a.k.a. Patience or Klondike solitaire)
• Pyramid Solitaire - Clear the pyramid by matching card pairs
• Spider Solitaire - Build same-suit columns; played with 2 card decks
• Elevens Solitaire - Pair cards that add up to eleven or form JQK
All levels of classic solitaire, spider solitaire and pyramid solitaire are 100% solvable – guaranteed. Can you beat them all?
Build your own beautiful card collection. Choose your first exclusive deck FREE from 70+ created by top independent, diverse, global artists – just for Art of Solitaire - including:
• Heart & Brain by the Awkward Yeti - Nick Seluk
• Birbs ‘n’ Bread by Kenny Mays
• Tropical Flora & Fauna by Mateus Pessoa
• Deep Space Desperados by Rex Crowle
• Love at First Fright by Andrea Young
• A Colorful Game by Aurélia Durand
Collect them all and discover cool new artists and card decks every month.
Let us know what you’d like to see from Flick.
Is there a solitaire variation you’d love to play next? Spiderette Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, Tri-peaks Solitaire, Clock Solitaire or maybe there’s a card game that’s special to you.
feedback@flick.games
# Made with love in England by a small team and our artist friends.
# Need help: support@flick.games
# Thanks to all the fans of klondike, pyramid &, elevens, and spider solitaire and ASMR.
Terms of Use: https://artof.cards/info/terms-conditions

WHAT IS EMILY SKYE FIT?
Discover workouts, programs and meal plans that have helped 14 million women worldwide get real results – no matter where you’re starting from.
Build strength with 600+ workouts plus 4 and 6-week limited-time progr
bluejetty:00123419:ios.description:
WHAT IS EMILY SKYE FIT?
Discover workouts, programs and meal plans that have helped 14 million women worldwide get real results – no matter where you’re starting from.
Build strength with 600+ workouts plus 4 and 6-week limited-time programs and challenges (hello Booty Challenge!), fuel your training with 500+ recipes and personalised meal plans, stay active during pregnancy and regain strength while postpartum, and get the right mindset with expert advice and meditations and tips from mental health experts. PLUS with 24/7 support, we’ll be with you every step of the way!
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
Emily Skye FITis your ultimate health and fitness toolkit – your transformation starts here!
Workouts
Fitness is about more than weight loss. With Emily Skye FIT, you’ll build strength and the confidence to love yourself and your body. 
– 600+ workouts and 7 specialised exercise programs for women. 
– At Home and In Gym workouts. 
– 5 NEW home and gym workouts added to your planner every week, including targeted strength training, HIIT, and active recovery. 
Enjoy dedicated workout programs and challenges including:
– Booty Challenge – transform your glutes in 6 weeks. 
– Abs to the Core – define your abs and increase core strength in 6 weeks. 
– Upper Body Blast – transform your arms, shoulders and back in 6 weeks with targeted upper body workouts. 
– Body Sculpt – create your strongest, most sculpted body in 6 weeks.
– FIT Pregnancy – 130+ pregnancy-safe workouts, nutrition tips and expert prenatal advice for all three trimesters. 
– FIT Post-Pregnancy – rebuild strength across three progressive stages. 
– Start Strong – feel strong with this 4-week weight and strength training program for beginners.
– FIT Foundations – the perfect introduction (or comeback) to fitness for true beginners.
Food
Stay on track with balanced meal plans covering breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks and treats for your entire week!
- 500+ healthy, dietitian-approved recipes to fuel your training.
- Save time grocery shopping with auto-generated shopping lists.
- Vegetarian or vegan? Enjoy meal plans and modifications just for you.
- Gluten-free options for every single recipe!
Success
Get exclusive tips covering fitness, nutrition, wellbeing, pregnancy and postpartum from Emily’s team of experts.
- Advice that’s helped women all over the world achieve their goals.
- Connect with like-minded women in a supportive Facebook community.
Join now for a 7-day FREE trial!
Emily Skye FIT can use HealthKit to log your workouts and meditations. Don’t worry, we’ll ask for permission before we do this.
SUBSCRIPTION AUTOMATIC-RENEWAL FEATURE
1, 3, 12 month subscriptions available.
Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of your current period. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged at the same price for renewal, as stated above, within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Current subscriptions may not be cancelled during the active subscription period, but you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

Privacy Policy: https://emilyskyefit.com/article/show/10442/esf-privacy-policy-v2

bluejetty:00079965:ios.description:
Evil enemies have invaded your kingdom -- kidnapped the princess and locked her into the dungeon! As the greatest Idle King Tycoon of the world, your quest is to lead your army into the fight with monster bosses all while managing and expanding your kingdom. 
Dark Dungeons, evil enemies, and other unique troops are waiting for you! Plan a unique battle strategy, fight an idle war and defeat bosses. Unlock all the islands, from Green Goblins to Venomous Vampires, and locate the 6 magic keys.
Play actively as a hero or choose to automate your workflow and collect idle income, even when you are offline! Get rich quick! No need to tap like in an online clicker simulator! Enjoy this addicting tycoon simulation game and level up! The automatic battle system in the game uses idle clicker gameplay to help you steadily earn extra gold coins. These gold coins can be used to enhance your knights’ and mercenaries' attack and speed to destroy the evil bosses.
Ready to expand your kingdom?
Enter the world of King Royale : Idle Tycoon game. You are the King, take on the challenge, make the best battle strategy in this quest to rescue your little princess.
Features:
-Manage your Kingdom and become the best Idle King Tycoon.
-Unlock new skills and heroes to help you beat the Boss.
-Level up your favorite heroes and skills in this idle role-play game. 
-Set your fight strategy by combining king’s equipment, knight skills and heroes.
-Defeat all of the evil enemies, beat bosses in the dark dungeons and earn gold.
-Adventure through different continents to find all magic keys.
-Recruit managers to increase your fielders’ and collectors’ motivation for gold digging and collecting.
-Yield gold actively or automate your workflow to increase your idle income!
-Win huge treasure chests daily,
Are you already a fan of King Royale : Idle Tycoon Saga? If so, like us on Facebook, follow us on Twitter and Instagram, join our Discord Community and visit our website https://kingroyale.de for the latest news:

With the release of its all-new 5th generation Viper SmartStart app, connecting with and controlling your vehicle is easier than ever – including real time status via the updated dashboards, and control via your Apple watch!
- Add a Viper SmartStart GPS module to the Viper remote start or security system in your car so you can start, lock and unlock your car from virtually anywhere. You can also locate your car, share its location with your friends or family, and get safety notifications if your Viper SmartStart-protected car is speeding or goes where it's not supposed to go.
- For the ultimate connected car experience, install a complete Viper SmartStart Digital System and you’ll also get engine runtime and real time status on your choice of app dashboard. Get notified if your vehicle sets a diagnostic code, or check your fuel, battery, or odometer right in the app! 
- All 4G LTE GPS modules come with a free 30-day GPS trial so you can check out the cool features right away, and there’s even an option for a year of free Basic service. Step up to Secure service to get 2-way control confirmations or add GPS or Small Fleet & Family for the ultimate in car control and monitoring along with extended warranty and theft protection. 
The sleek, modern dashboards of Viper SmartStart 5.3 mobile app give you fingertip control over the following features of your installed Viper remote start or security/remote start system:
- Lock/arm
- Unlock/disarm
- Remote car starter
- Trunk release
- Panic
- Aux channels
Follow these three simple steps to get Viper SmartStart:
1) Download the free Viper SmartStart app
2) Get a SmartStart system installed in your vehicle
3) Set up your account, and start using your SmartStart system
Viper SmartStart also includes Viper Motor Club, providing convenient 24/7 access to our nationwide roadside assistance network. Just press a button in the app to get connected for towing due to breakdown or accidents, or assistance with a dead battery or flat tire. Member roadside assistance is free with Secure or higher level service plans and pre-registration. Even if you don’t sign up, you can use the guest program for the same great service at a fixed cost. 
Latest features:
- Real time status on your favorite dashboard! Check the remote start runtime or whether your doors are locked and more instantly just by opening the app! (digital systems only)
- Monitor the battery, odometer, and fuel level in the extended Status page (requires a digital system, some features may not be supported on all vehicles)
- Convenient widget for one-touch command execution without needing to open the app first
- Start, lock, unlock or locate your car using your Apple watch, or send other commands
- Receive alert notifications on your phone and Apple watch
- Four user-selectable dashboards and launch page settings – now you can customize the app for the way you use it
- Modern dashboard "swipe up to start" feature eliminates accidental remote start commands
- Map page integrates GPS and SmartPark features seamlessly – locate your vehicle, or track down where you parked
- Manage notifications: Each user can select how they want to receive alerts or other notifications. Choose from push alerts with custom sound effects, email, or SMS (SMS alerts may not be available outside North America)

bluejetty:00064785:ios.description:
Dash Wallet is the first iPhone wallet for Dash - Digital Cash - a better innovative alternative to bitcoin which is focused on payments.
Dash is a cryptocurrency that seeks to fix the flaws that other cryptocurrencies suffer from. It relies on a network of Masternodes to allow such things as instant transactions, optional privacy features, and a direct funding mechanism to kickstart innovative ideas.
Intuitive and secure, Dash Wallet gives you complete control over your digital cash. Send and receive Dash payments instantly, with the safest mobile wallet available.
Dash Wallet is the first and only iPhone wallet that connects directly to the Dash network. This means that there are no servers to get hacked or go down - your funds are always safe. Even if your phone is lost, damaged or stolen, you can easily recover your funds using your personal recovery phrase.
Features:
* Send and receive Dash payments in seconds, online or in-person
* One button payments to Dash-accepting merchants and websites
* Pay quickly with Face ID recognition
* Sweeping of paper wallets (e.g. those used for cold storage)
* 3rd party integrations to allow users to buy and sell Dash
* Simple recovery phrase enables you to recover funds when your device is lost or broken
* Flexible settings to meet a range of custom security preferences
* Direct Dash network client - no central server to get hacked or go down
Dash Wallet is open source and free. There are no extra transaction fees or costs. Send any amount of money to anyone in the world instantly. This is how money should be.

bluejetty:00157850:ios.description:
Play relaxing word games and discover beautiful destinations on a breezy holiday trip around the world!
Breezy Crossword is the perfect crossword puzzle game for anyone who loves word games, word search, brain puzzles, and peaceful adventure. Whether you’re a fan of relaxing puzzle games, daily crosswords, or simply want to train your brain during downtime, Breezy Crossword is designed to help you unwind.
A Relaxing Word Game with Adventure – Key Features:
• Easy Crossword Puzzles in Stunning Locations: Solve fun, relaxing crossword puzzles that gently train your brain. Each level is set in real-world destinations like the Great Wall, Yosemite, the Amazon Rainforest, and the Sphinx. Discover new places as you progress!
• Powerups & Word Mastery: Use smart powerups like Hints, Hammers, and Rockets to uncover hidden words. Master each level by solving crosswords without mistakes and earn higher rewards.
• Daily Crossword Puzzle Game: Every day brings a new word search challenge. Complete daily crossword puzzles to collect monthly collectibles and unlock milestone rewards.
• Weekly Events with Collectibles: Join themed weekly events like Lost Treasure and Garden Bloom. Collect rubies, emeralds, and other items hidden in grid cells to unlock big rewards by the end of the week.
• Lucky Spin Rewards: Spin the lucky wheel every 6 hours to win coins, hammers, or other helpful boosts. Watch a quick video to spin again and increase your rewards.
• Brain Training Meets Travel Discovery: Perfect for players who love relaxing puzzles, vocabulary games, or just want to play something calming on their holiday. Discover new facts about world landmarks while keeping your brain active.
• Quests and Leaderboards: Complete daily, weekly, and lifetime quests like finishing levels, collecting powerups, or finding bonus words. Climb global leaderboards and see how you rank against friends and players worldwide.
• Offline Mode + Cloud Save: Play offline while traveling or commuting. Sync your progress across devices to save your profile and maintain your mastery.
Why You’ll Love Breezy Crossword:
• Relaxing and easy word puzzles that fit your schedule
• Travel-themed crossword game with calming backgrounds
• Ideal for fans of wordscapes, scrabble, trivia, and puzzle games
• Great for vocabulary building and casual brain training
• Free to play off

bluejetty:00073550:ios.summary: Tide Alert is the #1 app for tide predictions, tidal currents, and lunar phases, all in one beautiful interface. Powered by NOAA tide forecasts, it delivers accurate high tide and low tide times, current speeds, slack tide windows, swell da
bluejetty:00073550:ios.description:
Tide Alert is the #1 app for tide predictions, tidal currents, and lunar phases, all in one beautiful interface. Powered by NOAA tide forecasts, it delivers accurate high tide and low tide times, current speeds, slack tide windows, swell data, water temperature, and wind conditions for thousands of stations along the US coastline. 
Set custom alerts for high tide, low tide, or any tide level you choose and never miss a window again. With full offline support, your tide data is always available, even without cell service. 
What's New:
Tidal Currents & Slack Tides
 • View real-time tidal current speed overlayed on the tide chart. 
 • See slack tide periods with estimated begin and end times. 
 • Current data sourced from NOAA current prediction stations. 
Compare Tide Charts
 • Compare multiple stations side by side. 
 • Add stations to compare directly from the map. 
Monthly High & Low 
 • Redesigned monthly view with visual tide range bars.
 • See the month's lowest, highest, and average tidal range at a glance.
Apple Watch
 • New ocean conditions view with wind, swell height, water temperature, and current speed. 
 • Tap the wave icon on the main screen to check conditions instantly.
Wind, Swell & Water Temperature
 • Hourly wind speed, gust, and direction forecasts.
 • Swell chart with height, period, and direction. 
 • Water temperature from NOAA and Open-Meteo.
Who is Tide Alert for?
Anyone who needs to know the tides. Fishermen timing their catch. Surfers checking swell and tides together. Kayakers and paddleboarders planning safe launches. Boaters and sailors navigating harbors. Crabbers and clammers working low tides. Beach photographers chasing golden hour at low tide. Dog walkers, birdwatchers, and tide pool explorers. Divers planning slack water entries.
Key Features:
 • Tide predictions for thousands of NOAA stations across the US.
 • Tidal current speed and slack tide annotations on the chart.
 • Custom tide alerts — get notified for high tide, low tide, or any level.
 • Full offline access to tide data and charts for favorite stations.
 • Interactive map with station discovery and quick actions.
 • Compare tide charts across multiple stations.
 • Monthly high & low tide overview with daily range bars.
 • Wind, swell, and water temperature conditions.
 • Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, and moonset on the chart.
 • Moon phase calendar.
 • Apple Watch app with tide chart, conditions, and complications.
 • Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy widgets.
 • iOS Shortcuts and Siri voice commands.
 • Customizable chart symbols and reference levels.
 • Supports all US time zones and daylight saving time.
Tide Alert is free to try with all features available during the trial period. After the trial, a subscription is required to continue.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
DISCLAIMER — See https://tidealert.app/disclaimer.html
Use Tide Alert at your own risk. Tide data does not account for the effects of wind, storms, rain, freshwater runoff, or floods. The tide graph uses predicted high and low tide events with approximated segments between them. Do NOT use Tide Alert for NAVIGATION or any purpose that may result in personal injury or property damage. Tide Alert is not liable for any loss, injuries, or damage caused by its use. Tide Alert is not associated with NOAA.

bluejetty:00087882:ios.summary:
Band Companion gives bands and solo performers one clear place to organize songs, build setlists, plan events and keep important details ready. 
No more searching through group chats, separate calendars or scattered files. Know what comes
bluejetty:00087882:ios.description:
Band Companion gives bands and solo performers one clear place to organize songs, build setlists, plan events and keep important details ready. 
No more searching through group chats, separate calendars or scattered files. Know what comes next, what to play and where to find it.
ORGANIZE YOUR SONGS
Build one dependable song library. Keep lyrics, chords, key, BPM, duration, status, song notes and a backing track with each song. Add a song once, then use it in any setlist.
TURN YOUR SONGS INTO A SET
Put songs in the right order, rearrange them in seconds and see the total playing time immediately. Add setlist notes and connect setlists to events, so everyone knows what to play and when.
KNOW WHAT'S NEXT
Plan rehearsals, shows, recordings, releases and more. Keep every date, reminder, detail and setlist in one calendar, so nothing important gets lost in a group chat.
SONG SHEETS THAT WORK YOUR WAY
Keep lyrics, chords and arrangement cues clear during rehearsals and performances. Highlight an entrance, mark a solo, choose what to show, adjust fonts and sizes, and let the song sheet scroll automatically while you play.
BACKING TRACKS, READY ON CUE
Attach a backing track to each song and play it directly from the song sheet. Jump to the part you need, keep recent tracks ready on your device and prepare every backing track in a setlist for offline use.
ONE SET. EVERYONE FOLLOWS.
Start a Live Session and every joined device follows the active song. One person leads the set, while you decide which device plays the backing track.
NOTES WHERE YOU NEED THEM
Create formatted notes for arrangements, practical details, checklists and useful links. Pin important notes and connect them directly to songs, setlists and events.
YOUR BAND, CONNECTED
Invite members with a link or code and keep everyone up to date in one shared space. Manage multiple bands, acts or projects without mixing their information.
AVAILABLE ON PHONE, TABLET AND WEB
Start on one device and continue on another. Your songs, setlists, events and notes stay up to date automatically and remain accessible when the internet connection is unreliable.
Band Companion is available in English, Dutch, German, French and Spanish.
Bring your songs, sets and dates together with Band Companion.

bluejetty:00045257:ios.description:
The ParkDC Permits app is the simple, fast way for Washington, DC residents and their visitors to park on their neighborhood streets in Residential Permit Parking (RPP) areas across all eight wards. The ParkDC Permits app allows residents to manage visitor and temporary parking permits for friends, family members, contractors, and home health care aides from the palm of their hand.
App Features: 
• Residents – text or email your unique code to your visitors 
• Residents – approve your visitors in advance or in real time
• Residents – view permit requests and pending and active permits
• Visitors – request parking from your resident/host in advance or upon arrival 
• Visitors – receive real time alerts and active construction maps to make finding parking easier
If you have any questions, comments, or concerns regarding the ParkDC Permits app, please contact us via:
• Call the 24/7 Call Center at 202-671-2631
• Email us at DDOT.Parking@dc.gov
• Visit the ParkDC website at parkdc.com
Thank you for using the ParkDC Permits App!

bluejetty:00163255:android.description:
VivaMoneda is committed to offering safe and reliable lending services, with the goal of establishing a healthy and positive lending relationship between the platform and its users. The platform strives to provide flexible lending options that suit the individual needs of users, thereby encouraging a positive financial experience. Transparency, accessibility and customer service are fundamental values that guide VivaMoneda's operation to ensure the satisfaction and trust of its users.
Requirements to request it:
1、Citizens with a Mexican identification card.
2、The age must be between 18 and 65 years old.
3、Have a bank account in Mexico.
4、Ability to pay.
Steps to obtain your quick loan:
1、Download the application (VivaMoneda).
2、Complete with real information.
3、Request a loan within the application.
4、After approval, the loan amount will be directly transferred to the user's bank account.
5、Remember the payment deadline to improve your loan conditions in the future.
Loan information:
Credit limit: from $500 to $30,000 pesos;
Annual interest: 3% to 18%;
5% VAT
Fee from $50 to $250 (Varies depending on credit score);
Terms: from 91 to 210 days
For example, for a loan of $1,000 that must be paid in 180 days, annual interest: 3%, the calculation is as follows:
Interest: $1,000 * 3%/365 * 180 = $17.8
Commission: $100
VAT: $1,000 * 5% = $50
Total amount to pay: $1067.8
Benefits of opting for VivaMoneda:
1、Manage all your procedures from your mobile device, without paperwork complications.
2、Flexible amounts and terms: Take advantage of flexible amounts and terms. Making payments on time or making advance payments can improve your conditions.
3、Variety of payment methods: Enjoy convenient payment options, such as 24/7 bank transfers or cash payments at partner stores such as Western Union, without additional costs.
Privacy & Security:
At VivaMoneda, the protection of your data is essential. We have implemented strict security and confidentiality measures. Your information is not shared with third parties without your express authorization. For more details about our Privacy Policy, please contact us via phone, email or WhatsApp. We are committed to maintaining the privacy and security of your data.
Contact information:
We are open Monday to Friday from 9:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m.

bluejetty:00171174:android.name: Moonlight Blade
bluejetty:00171174:android.summary: Moonlight Blade Mobile is a fascinating open world MMORPG in the traditional Chinese style. The game presents a magnificent world of martial arts, containing a different combination of techniques and features, with high-quality art technolo
bluejetty:00171174:android.description:
Moonlight Blade Mobile is a fascinating open world MMORPG in the traditional Chinese style. The game presents a magnificent world of martial arts, containing a different combination of techniques and features, with high-quality art technology, so that every blade of grass, every tree, hills and clouds are in front of your eyes.
12 unique schools, with their own characteristics and advantages in PVP and PVE games.
There are many professions in the game to help you develop and improve: cooking, fishing, hunting, etc. You also expect a variety of images and the opportunity to create a unique appearance for your hero, up to 600 character customization!
=====Features=====
■ Multiplayer Games ■
One of the highlights of Moonlight Blade Mobile is its robust multiplayer feature. Join forces with friends and form powerful guilds to conquer challenging raids and take down formidable bosses. Coordinate your strategies and unleash devastating combos to dominate the battlefield. With real-time player interaction, you can team up with players from around the world and forge new friendships in the virtual realm.
■ PVP Multiplayer■ 
PVP enthusiasts will find Moonlight Blade Mobile to be a haven for competitive gameplay. Engage in thrilling arena battles and prove your skills as the ultimate warrior. Participate in intense guild wars, where strategic coordination and teamwork are essential for victory. Rise to the top of the leaderboards and earn exclusive rewards, fame, and recognition.
Compete against renowned warriors from around the world in a PVP system.
A combat system that gives you the freedom to continuously combine skills. Support for a variety of PVP formats including 1 on 1 or 5 on 5 groups, including Guild Wars and Battle Royale modes that stand out from other open world MMORPG formats.
■ AAA Graphics ■ 
The graphics of Moonlight Blade Mobile are nothing short of breathtaking. The meticulously designed world is filled with stunning landscapes, detailed character models, and breathtaking special effects. Each battle is brought to life with smooth animations and dynamic combat mechanics, making every encounter a visually stunning spectacle.
Picturesque weather with four seasons - spring, summer, autumn and winter.
Full HD when playing on a computer with a refresh rate of up to 120Hz.
■ Customization ■ 
Customization options are abundant in Moonlight Blade Mobile. Tailor your character's appearance to your liking, equip them with powerful weapons and armor, and choose from a wide array of skills and abilities to create your own unique playstyle. Whether you prefer a stealthy assassin, a mighty warrior, or a master of magic, there's a class and playstyle that suits your preferences.
■ Storyline ■ 
The immersive storyline of Moonlight Blade Mobile will keep you engaged from the moment you step foot in the game. Unravel the mysteries of the world and uncover dark secrets as you progress through the gripping narrative. Meet intriguing characters, make impactful choices, and shape the outcome of the story in this epic adventure.
Moonlight Blade Mobile brings the excitement of an AAA MMORPG to the palm of your hand. Whether you're a fan of multiplayer games, love engaging in PVP battles, or simply enjoy immersive storytelling, this game has something for everyone. Join the millions of players worldwide and embark on an unforgettable journey in Moonlight Blade Mobile. Are you ready to become a legend?
We are happy to see you on the expanses of its beauty and richness of the world - Moonlight Blade Mobile!
Team of Moonlight Blade Mobile
