bluejetty:00184083:ios.description:
FIN เป็นเครื่องมือสำหรับบันทึก และ วิเคราะห์ข้อมูลการลงทุนในกองทุนรวม ที่อิงข้อมูลกองทุนรวมจริง (ไม่ใช่ app ส่งคำสั่งซื้อขายกองทุนรวม ทุกอย่างคือ simulation อิงตามข้อมูลที่ผู้ใช้บันทึกเข้าไปใน FIN) ถูกสร้างมาเพื่อแก้ปัญหาที่มีมาอย่างยาวนานสำหรับผู้ลงทุนในกองทุนรวม โดยใน Version ล่าสุดนี้มีความสามารถหลัก 5 ด้าน
1. Fund Ranking ตามประเภทของกองทุนรวม (RMF, SSF, TESG, TESGX, หุ้นไทย, กองที่ลงทุนในต่างประเทศ, อื่นๆ) และ ระยะเวลาที่ผ่านมา โดย update ค่า NAV แบบทันทีทันใดทุกตอนเย็นวันทำการตั้งแต่ 6.00pm เป็นต้นไป และ สามารถเลือกเรียงลำดับ NAV Performance ได้ รวมถึงสามารถเลือก Filter ให้แสดงผลเฉพาะ บลจ. ที่กำหนดได้ และ ตาม นโยบายการจ่ายปันผล
2. Consolidate Portfolio ผู้ใช้สามารถติดตามราคาของกองทุนต่างๆ ที่ลงทุนไว้ แบบรวมศูนย์ที่เดียว รองรับกับทุก บลจ. และ update ค่า profit/loss ให้ผู้ใช้รู้แบบทันทีทันใดที่มีการเปลี่ยนแปลงมูลค่าทรัพย์สินใน Portfolio ในวันนั้นๆ รวมถึงมีการแสดงผลในกราฟได้หลายรูปแบบเพื่อการสื่อความหมายที่รวดเร็วที่สุด

bluejetty:00095927:ios.description:
Pregnancy Tracker – Pregnancy Week by Week & Baby Development Tracker
Track your pregnancy journey from the very first week until birth with Pregnancy Tracker, your all-in-one tool for expecting moms. Get accurate, easy-to-read information about your baby’s growth, your body’s changes, and everything you need to prepare for delivery.
► Baby Development Tracker
• Explore your baby’s development in realistic, interactive views.
• Compare your baby’s size to fruits, animals, and sweet treats.
• Pregnancy Week by Week Guides. Learn what’s happening every week for you and your baby.
2D, 3D & 4D Ultrasound Scans – View real ultrasound images by week.
• Simple Pregnancy Insights. Easy, clear explanations for both mom and baby.
 ► Daily Pregnancy Information
• Daily Blog Posts. Tips, tricks, and helpful advice for every stage.
• Stage-Based Articles. Articles tailored to your pregnancy stage for relevant guidance.
► Essential Pregnancy Tools
• Symptoms Tracking – Log and monitor how you feel.
• Kick Counter – Track your baby’s movements with ease.
• Weight Tracker – Keep your pregnancy weight on track.
• Contraction Timer – Accurately measure contractions during labor.
• Gender Prediction – Fun ways to guess your baby’s gender.
• My Bump – Save belly photos and milestones.
• Pill Reminder – Never miss prenatal vitamins or medicine.
► Pregnancy Planning Tools
• Appointment Tracker – Keep all doctor visits organized.
• Hospital Bag Checklist – Be ready for the big day with all essentials.
• To-Do List – Stay on top of important pregnancy tasks.
• Birth Plan Creator – Outline and share your preferences for labor and delivery.
• Baby Name Finder – Discover and save your favorite baby names.
• Questions List – Keep a handy list of things to ask your doctor.
• Shopping List – Plan your baby essentials shopping.
►AI Pregnancy Assistant
• AI Chat Support 
• Ask questions and get instant, reliable answers about pregnancy, symptoms, and preparation.
Why choose Pregnancy Tracker?
Combines pregnancy week-by-week tracking, baby development visualization, and essential tools in one app.
Helps you stay informed, prepared, and confident throughout your pregnancy journey.
Designed for first-time moms and experienced parents alike.
Download Pregnancy Tracker now and enjoy the ultimate companion from bump to baby!

bluejetty:00165737:ios.description:
SparkBible is a free Bible study app designed to help you read Scripture daily and learn deeper with video, commentary, devotionals, study tools, and AI-powered insights. Whether you are new to the Bible or looking for advanced study resources like Greek, Hebrew, interlinear, and concordance tools, SparkBible helps you grow in faith every day.
WHY SPARKBIBLE?
+ Daily Bible reading that guides your study of Scripture with amazing resources
+ Video commentary for every chapter of the Bible
+ Devotional tools to strengthen your daily walk
+ AI study insights that make complex passages easier to understand
+ Hebrew, Greek, and interlinear word studies to explore the original text
LEARN FROM TOP BIBLE TEACHERS
Discover thousands of Bible study videos, sermons, and commentary from leading pastors, theologians, and seminary professors. Learn from voices such as:
John Piper, Tim Keller, N.T. Wright, Jen Wilkin, Francis Chan, Tony Evans, Jackie Hill Perry, Rick Warren, John MacArthur, BibleProject, The Gospel Coalition (TGC), Fuller Seminary, Southern Seminary, Biola, and many others.
BIBLE VERSIONS AVAILABLE
SparkBible offers multiple translations to support your study, including:
NIV, ESV, NLT, NASB, CSB, KJV, NRSV, ASV, RSV, WEB, RV, WEBBE, WMB, and WMBBE.
APP FEATURES IN DETAIL
+ Watch Bible video commentary alongside Scripture to help you learn more deeply
+ Use AI study tools to get more insights and answer difficult questions about whatever you’re reading
+ Highlight verses, add personal notes, and bookmark passages for later
+ Explore Greek, Hebrew, and interlinear study tools for deeper learning
+ AI-powered Bible Search that helps you find even the most difficult passages
+ Use SparkBible for personal devotion or in a church Bible study group
+ Access resources completely free with no hidden costs
TRY SPARKBIBLE PLUS
Want to go even deeper in your daily Bible study? Upgrade to SparkBible Plus and unlock advanced features built for serious learners. With Plus you’ll get:
+ AI Study Tools that provide key insights, cultural background, and word studies in Greek and Hebrew — plus deep dives into people, places, and themes of Scripture.
+ Premium Bible Search that links directly to the AI Study Tools, helping you connect verses with commentary, interlinear, and concordance resources.
+ Exclusive Video Bible Courses from trusted teachers, giving you structured lessons for deeper study.
SparkBible Plus turns your Bible reading into a richer, more insightful experience — combining daily devotionals, AI insights, and advanced study resources in one simple app.
WHY CHOOSE SPARKBIBLE?
The Bible is the most important book of all time, but it can be hard to understand. SparkBible makes Bible study simple, approachable, and powerful by combining daily devotionals, video and audio commentary, AI-powered insights, and advanced study resources like concordance, Greek, Hebrew, and interlinear tools.
SparkBible is more than just another Bible app — it’s your complete Bible study companion. Download SparkBible free today and start your daily journey in Scripture.
Spark Bible Terms of Use: https://sparkbible.com/terms

bluejetty:00024297:ios.description:
This farm has a story to tell. A land full of mystery awaits! In every corner lies a new discovery in this world of epic adventure as you help our heroine fulfill her quest.
Fight exciting battles in amazing role-playing adventures with familiar merge puzzle mechanics, diverse gameplay, and unique graphic style.
Your task is to solve all troubles of your village, fight monsters, repair the damage, and protect the people from the enemy.
Tools and weapons will be required to tackle those challenges, such as knives, hammers, gloves, swords, and axes. 
Craft tools and merge them together, ready your sword and let magic guide you through this RPG fantasy where the way of dungeons of old may lead you to a gold-filled castle... or to the red dragon's own lair.
Features:
- Discover
Medieval Merge leads you through a magical land where you will find incredible missions with plenty of mysteries to solve.
- Explore
In this journey, you will be the master of the middle ages, writing your own path while exploring a world of wizards and monsters!
- Merge
Combine items into valuable tools to help the villagers to rebuild and manage the farm after the destruction caused by an evil sorcerer.
- Conquer
Be the hero, the merge master warrior, and craft the right weapons to use in the next battle.
- Earn
Renovate the place, unlock treasure chests, and collect valuable items like gems and gold coins.
Are you ready to become a knight? Start now with this merge game - An epic RPG adventure awaits you!
Have a problem? Want to suggest a cool new feature? Send your feedback to Pixodust Games. We love to hear from our players! support@pixodust.com
Be sure to check for updates. We're always working on ways of improving gameplay and adding new content!

bluejetty:00043254:ios.description:
WALAWA offers electric scooters as a practical and independent way to get around the city.
With the app, you can:
• Find available scooters on the map and check their battery level.
• Reserve a scooter for a few minutes while you walk to it.
• Scan the QR code to unlock it and start your ride.
• Pause your ride whenever needed.
• Add funds to your wallet by paying with a QR code through your banking app or with a credit or debit card. You can also purchase minute packages.
• View your ride and payment history.
• Finish your ride, park in an allowed area, and submit a photo showing that the scooter was parked correctly.
To use WALAWA, you need a phone with a camera and location services, an account, and a registered identity document.
Ride within the service area, follow traffic rules, and park without blocking the way.

PRO FEATURES, available via single in-app purchase:
• Cloud synchronization
• Unlock with Face ID
• Unlock with Touch ID
• Password Generator
• CSV Import
SECURITY FEATURES
• All data is encrypted, including Entry names, Category definitions and the data itself.
• Encrypts data using AES or Blowfish algorithms with key sizes of 256, 192 or 128 bits.
• When the data file is decrypted, up to all combinations of algorithm and key size are tried with the Master password to unlock the data file. The app itself does not store any hint to the actual cipher, key size or cipher mode of operation.
• Uses a randomly generated 'salt' combined with the Master password. Salt helps to protect from off-line dictionary attacks.
• The key to open the data file is created by combining your master password with the 512-bit 'salt'. The result is hashed 1000 times by SHA-256. Repetitive hashing makes a brute force attack more difficult.
• Supports auto destruction of the data file after a predefined number of unsuccessful unlocks have been tried.
For more info see http://www.awallet.org/

bluejetty:00099083:ios.description:
Stack is poker built like a sport. Play ranked 1v1 Duels, climb a real ELO ladder from Donkey to Endboss, and get better every single hand — with AI coaching baked right into the game.
Most poker apps make you choose. Casino apps are fun but teach you nothing. Solver tools teach you something but feel like homework. Stack is the one that's both: a competitive poker game you play to win AND improve at the same time. Chess.com built this for chess. Stack is building it for poker.
----- PLAY & COMPETE -----
RANKED 1v1 DUELS — REAL PLAYERS, REAL ELO
This is the heart of Stack. Go head-to-head in ranked 1v1 Duels against real players with a live ELO rating. Match instantly or challenge your friends. Start as a Donkey, grind your way to Endboss. Your rank is earned, not bought — every win moves you up, every loss means something.
PLAY POKER YOUR WAY
6-max cash, heads-up, and ranked Duels against AI opponents that actually punish mistakes. Jump into a hand in seconds. Blitz mode keeps the action fast.
DAILY MISSIONS + STREAKS
Show up, play, earn XP, keep your streak alive. The daily loop keeps you sharp and keeps your rank climbing.
XP, RANKS & COSMETICS
Earn XP for every session, unlock rank tiers from Donkey to Endboss, and personalize your table with cosmetics you earn — not just buy.
----- GET BETTER WHILE YOU PLAY -----
AI HAND INSIGHTS + REPLAY
After your hands, get AI-powered analysis showing exactly where you lost EV and what the right play was. Replay the hand and see it differently.
PREFLOP TRAINER 
Drill your preflop ranges until they're automatic. Rapid-fire spots so you stop leaking before the flop.
POKER PUZZLES — RATED & RANKED
Solve real in-game decisions formatted as puzzles, each with a difficulty rating and a correct answer with explanation. Addictive and humbling.
CONCEPTS & LESSONS LIBRARY
Short, structured lessons — from preflop fundamentals to GTO concepts — for players who want to understand the game, not memorize charts.
----- WHY STACK -----
Poker should feel like a game you're climbing, not a spreadsheet you're studying. Stack gives you a rank to chase, daily reasons to come back, and AI coaching so you're getting better the whole time you're having fun. Play first. Improve automatically.
----- PERFECT FOR -----
• Competitive players who want a real rank to climb
• Players stuck at a stake who know they're leaking somewhere
• Beginners who want to learn poker by playing, not by reading solver software
• Anyone who finds casino apps empty and GTO apps too dry
----- PRO MEMBERSHIP -----
Pro: $9.99/month or $99.99/year
• Unlimited AI hand insights and replay
• Full Concepts & lessons library
• Advanced ranked Duel modes
• All cosmetics unlocked
• Priority support
Free includes ranked play vs AI, daily missions, Puzzles, and Range Rush.
----- VIRTUAL CHIPS -----
Stack uses virtual chips for all in-game play. Virtual chips have no cash value and cannot be redeemed for real money. All chip purchases are for in-app play only. Stack is a poker game and training app — not a real-money gambling platform.
----- LINKS -----
Support: support@stackpoker.gg
Privacy Policy: https://stackpoker.gg/privacy
Terms of Service: https://stackpoker.gg/terms

Car Care Made Simple

Fast Delivery or Same-Day Pickup

Built for DIYers of All Experience Levels
Whether you're changing your oil or rebuilding an engine, the Advance Auto Parts app is your trusted partner. With access to Carquest professional-grade parts, you’ll get the quality and performance you demand.

bluejetty:00152721:ios.name: Screen Mirroring: Mirror To TV
bluejetty:00152721:ios.summary: Every day, you capture moments, curate entertainment, and develop ideas on your Phone. These experiences deserve a stage far grander than a handful of inches. Screen Mirroring: Mirror To TV is the invisible bridge that effortlessly transpor
bluejetty:00152721:ios.description:
Every day, you capture moments, curate entertainment, and develop ideas on your Phone. These experiences deserve a stage far grander than a handful of inches. Screen Mirroring: Mirror To TV is the invisible bridge that effortlessly transports your entire digital universe to the television, transforming passive viewing into dynamic, shared participation.
The Art of Effortless Connection
We believe technology should serve you, not the other way around.Our philosophy is embodied in a single, powerful action: tap once. There are no complex menus to navigate or confusing settings to configure. From the spontaneous decision to share a viral clip to the critical need to display a business chart, the power to cast your screen is always one intuitive touch away. This is simplicity, perfected.
A Canvas for Every Content Type
Your television is about to become the most versatile screen in your home. This application is the key that unlocks its full potential:
-Relive & Revel: Elevate your photo albums and home videos into a curated cinematic experience, surrounded by friends and family.
-Command the Room: Present documents, lead a slideshow, or annotate a web page directly from your device, making your meetings and lessons profoundly more impactful.
-Sound & Vision: Immerse yourself in the depth of your music library or stream web videos with a clarity that does justice to the content.
Universal Harmony, Not Hardware Hassles
The application’s intelligent scanner automatically discovers every compatible device on your network, learns your preferences, and prioritizes your favorites - making reconnection a silent, automatic process.
Precision Engineered for Demanding Moments
Mirroring is not just about projection; it's about synchronization.For those who teach, demo, game, or train, a split-second delay is unacceptable. Our proprietary low-latency mode is engineered for these precision scenarios, ensuring your actions on the phone are reflected on the screen in near real-time. This is the reliability required for professional and immersive use.
The Simplicity of Three Steps:
-Unite your iPhone and TV on a common Wi-Fi network.
-Launch the app and let it find your device.
-Select ‘Start Mirroring’ and experience the transition.
Stop containing your world. It’s time to expand it. Download Screen Mirroring: Mirror To TV and begin sharing without limits.
Subscription Information:
- Payment for your subscription will be processed through your iTunes account.
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless you disable it at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- The renewal fee is charged within the 24-hour window before your renewal date.
- By purchasing a subscription, any remaining time on a free trial will be forfeited.
- You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes Account Settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00173235:ios.description:
The Best Asian Food Delivery!
Fantuan Delivery offers the largest selection of your favourite Asian restaurants and other local favourite cuisines delivered to your door, anytime and anywhere.
【Fantuan Delivery & Pick-up】
Bringing the taste of authentic Asian cuisines to your door. Browse from hundreds of local restaurants to traditional Asian restaurants in your city. Unsure of what to eat tonight? Let Fantuan help filter the restaurants you crave.
Promotions: Enjoy limited-time discounts and promo codes every day.
Self Pick-up: Order in advance on our app and pick up meals at restaurants. Skip the line, save more. (No delivery fee, no tips, no service charges.)
Exclusive Restaurants: Find restaurants exclusive to Fantuan.
Restaurant partners include: Haidilao Hotpot, Coco bubble tea, Sharetea, Dinesty, Church’s Chicken, Subway, Me+Crepe, Old Xian, and more. BBQ, hotpot, dumplings, dim sum, bubble tea, brunch, cake…
【Dine-in Deals & Reviews】
Fantuan now offers exclusive dine-in discounts and vouchers at popular restaurants. Order ahead in the app, scan to redeem in-store – fast, simple, and more affordable.
More than just deals, Fantuan also features user reviews and photo notes to help you find the best-rated local spots and avoid disappointing experiences.
Now available in Vancouver, Toronto, New York, Los Angeles, Chicago and more cities.
【Additional Services】
Fantuan Errands
Need to deliver a parcel but don’t have the time? Or need to grab something from the store but don’t want to go out? Fantuan Errands can help. Whether it’s documents, flowers, keys, or groceries – just tell us what you need, and we’ll take care of it.
TT Mart
Order grocery and convenience store items right from Fantuan. Enjoy a wide range of daily essentials, fresh produce, snacks, drinks, and more – all delivered to your door.
Multiple Payment Methods
Visa / MasterCard / Apple Pay / PayPal / Venmo / Cash / Alipay / WeChat Pay
【About Fantuan】
Fantuan was founded in Vancouver, Canada in 2014. With a mission of "life made easier", we are a technology company that provides a one-stop platform connecting people with their local community. Fantuan operates in major cities across Canada, the United States, Australia and the UK. As a leading local lifestyle service platform, we help users unlock the richness of their neighborhood. From food and grocery delivery to convenience services and daily deals, Fantuan brings communities closer together. Fantuan is also one of Deloitte Canada's Fast 50 companies.

bluejetty:00069539:ios.description:
Cozy Onet brings a fresh, relaxing experience to classic pair-matching and Onet tile puzzle games. Clear well-designed levels, unlock vibrant themes, and enjoy satisfying visual board layouts at your own pace.
Simple to play, yet deeply engaging for your daily brain exercise.
HOW TO PLAY
* Tap two identical tiles to select them.
* Link matching tiles using 3 or fewer straight lines.
* Clear all tiles from the board to complete each level.
EXCITING GAMEPLAY MODES
* Timer Challenge: Test your speed and clear all pairs before the clock runs out.
* Bomb Mode: Match explosive bomb tiles to defuse them safely before time expires.
* Dynamic Boards: Stay sharp as gravity shift mechanics keep the tile layouts moving.
POWERFUL BOOSTERS
* Hint: Reveal an active connectable pair on the board.
* Shuffle: Rearrange remaining tiles to unlock new matching moves.
* Swap Images: Replace all active board tiles with brand-new picture sets.
* Defuse: Instantly disarm active bomb tiles anywhere on the grid.
HIGHLIGHTS
* 1,000+ Unique Tile Cards: Play with cute animals, fresh fruits, nature, dinosaurs, and seasonal art sets.
* Relaxing Background Themes: Customize your puzzle board with beautifully animated scenery.
* Earn Star Rewards: Connect longer paths between tiles to earn higher star ratings.
* Frequent Updates: New picture sets, event levels, and visual themes added regularly.
* Apple Game Center Integration: Track high scores and complete achievements against global players.
* Universal Support: Optimized for smooth performance across iOS, iPadOS, and Apple Silicon Mac devices.
* Lightweight & Efficient: Designed to conserve storage space and battery life.
FAIR FREE-TO-PLAY EXPERIENCE
* Enjoy continuous puzzle gameplay with minimal, non-intrusive ad placements.
* Optional one-time ad removal option available.
* Rewarded video ads are strictly optional for bonus boosts.

bluejetty:00166118:ios.description:
Step into the action-packed world of Air Shooter: Girl Got Gun, where you play as a fearless girl shooting from a helicopter to protect hostage. Tap to aim and fire at enemies chasing a running hostage, ensuring his safety as you clear the path of danger. With each successful mission, unlock new weapons, skins for both the girl and the helicopter, and become the ultimate airborne hero!
How to Play:
- Tap to Shoot: Aim by tapping on the enemies and fire to eliminate threats.
- Protect the Hostage: Defend the hostage by shooting enemies that are chasing from behind.
- Unlock Weapons and Skins: Earn rewards to unlock new powerful weapons, skins for your character, and customize your helicopter.
- Complete Levels: Clear each level by defeating all enemies and rescuing the hostage to progress.
Game Features:
- Simple Tap-to-Shoot Controls: Easily aim and shoot with a tap-based control system.
- Multiple Weapons: Upgrade and unlock a variety of weapons to improve your firepower.
- Customization Options: Unlock skins for the girl and helicopter to customize your character and vehicle.
- Challenging Missions: Face increasingly difficult enemies as you progress through action-packed levels.
- Vibrant Graphics: Enjoy smooth animations and vibrant environments as you fly and shoot.
Can you protect the hostages and take down every enemy? Take aim and become the hero in Air Shooter: Girl Got Gun!

bluejetty:00182573:ios.description:
This the best top-grossing game ever!
Based on a famous 1980's game ,Steam Blocks and bricks is a great re-skin.
Do you want to relax and have fun with the use ? We offer you to download FREE game Block Puzzle: Steampunk (Tetrix) in steampunk style. The game is suitable for all ages. This is a very exciting and atmospheric puzzle game.
Drag over the blocks and fill the cells. Let's play a simple and addictive puzzle game! Only start it, and you will immerse yourself in excellent atmosphere of block puzzles and Steampunk. You can enjoy the game for FREE!
The best puzzle game Block Puzzle: Steampunk helps you to improve complex planning skills and critical thinking, because it requires the player to make quick decisions in the process of combining pieces of different shapes.
Game Block Puzzle: Steampunk is able to provide a comprehensive influence on your brain. To play this game you need to use great number of cognitive processes such as concentration, hand-eye coordination, memory, etc.
Stylish design of Block Puzzle: Steampunk with its original design and pleasant audio series provides the player aesthetic pleasure from the game.
The game has three levels which depends on complexity, so that it is suitable for beginner and professional.
Improved management that is oriented for all users will allow you to play as one hand or two. You don`t need to make any settings, just run and play as you wish.
Rules of the game:
- Turn over the blocks as you wish.
- To move the blocks, drag over them by tap on it or using the pointers or just click on the left or right side of the screen.
- Try to fill a row. When your row will be filled your blocks will scatter in the air and you will get points. The game ends when the grid will be filled by any form of blocks.
- Don`t worry! Time is not limited!
There are seven shapes of blocks, each made up of four small bricks
Only one block falls at a time. At first the blocks falls slowly, as the game progresses they will fall faster and faster so be ready to
rotate them in a way you need As Soon As Possible!
By tapping the "LEFT" and "RIGHT" Arrow keys, you can slide the falling Tetrimino from side to side.
By tapping the "Dual Arrow"(rotation button) key or on the falling block, you can rotate the blocks 90 degrees clockwise.
To clear a line, every square of the row has to be filled.
Because of cool smooth graphics and Steam punk design this game has it's rebirth! 
Attractive and eye-catching design make this game addictive and very interesting again!
So check it out ! Download it right now and enjoy!

bluejetty:00170754:ios.description:
Creality Cloud Lite App, your reliable assistant for 3D printing.
Our goal is to simplify the complexity of 3D printing and enable more people to enjoy the fun of 3D printing. 
This app provides a convenient user experience, allowing you to distribute print tasks and remotely control your 3D printer. 
You can also monitor the printing status in real-time, no matter where you are, enabling you to perform 3D printing operations anytime, anywhere. 
The built-in AI print detection feature continuously monitors the printing process. 
If any printing abnormalities are detected, you will receive timely notifications and the print will automatically pause. 
Additionally, you can record the printing process, create time-lapse videos, and share your 3D printing creations with friends. 
Furthermore, this app supports integration with the Creality Sonic Pad, allowing remote control functionality by synchronizing with your Creality Cloud account.

bluejetty:00187385:ios.description:
Oracle Mobile Authenticator enables you to securely verify your identity by using your mobile device as an authentication factor. The app generates one-time passcode for login. Or it can receive notifications for login, which can be approved with a simple tap. When this authentication is used on top of username-password, it adds an additional layer of security that is essential for today's online applications.
Features:
 • Generate one-time passwords even when the device is offline
 • Push Notification based approval
 • Touch ID or App PIN for app protection
 • Set up via QR code, Config URL, or by entering key manually
 • Multiple account support
 • Generate OTP for other applications that make use of Passcode as per RFC 6238

bluejetty:00133534:ios.description: "Rescue Line 3D " is a finger controlled physical leisure game, with a classic physics challenge game with interesting plot settings and a variety of challenging level scene designs. bluejetty:00155585:ios.description:

· Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
· Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
· Transfer money between your accounts
· Make payments on your PS & Co loans
· Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
· Turn off your debit card if you’ve misplaced it

· Find branches and ATMs near you
· Send secure messages to the bank

bluejetty:00072977:ios.name: AI Sonic - Chat & Write Bot
bluejetty:00072977:ios.summary: WriteBot is your personal AI writing assistant, offering you unparalleled aid in crafting diverse types of writing, from academic works to professional Writes. The AI learns and adapts to your writing style, making it an essential tool for
bluejetty:00072977:ios.description:
WriteBot is your personal AI writing assistant, offering you unparalleled aid in crafting diverse types of writing, from academic works to professional Writes. The AI learns and adapts to your writing style, making it an essential tool for students, professionals, writers, and anyone in need of refining their written communication skills.
Drafting
Write drafting is one of WriteBot's stand-out features. The AI understands the context, tone, and purpose of your Writes, helping you articulate your messages effectively and concisely. Whether it's an official Write or a friendly note, WriteBot always delivers.
Summarize
Another distinctive feature of WriteBot is its ability to summarize articles. It's not just about reducing word count; WriteBot condenses content while retaining core ideas, allowing you to digest lengthy articles quickly and effectively. This feature is especially beneficial for those needing to grasp main ideas from complex articles or reports swiftly.
Productivity
WriteBot focuses on saving time and boosting productivity. It provides real-time suggestions, assisting in sentence construction and idea flow. This enables you to complete writing tasks efficiently, freeing up time for other activities. Paid subscription is required to access all questions. The free version will have limited number of practice questions.
WriteBot's user-friendly interface is designed for ease of use and accessibility. Regardless of your technical proficiency, WriteBot is a straightforward, intuitive tool to help enhance your writing.
We are committed to providing continuous support and enhancing your WriteBot experience.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Paid subscriptions are automatically renewed until they are turned off via user account settings after purchase. Account will be charged no more than 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off via the user's account settings after purchase. No refunds will be provided for any unused parts of the subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://www.eastgatekent.com/sonic/policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.eastgatekent.com/sonic/service/

bluejetty:00091955:ios.description:
MowSnowPros is the easiest way to book reliable, on-demand, no-contract lawn mowing, snow removal and other yard services — all from your phone. Whether you need snow shovelling after a storm or lawn care during the summer, MowSnowPros connects you with vetted local Pros who complete your yard services quickly, affordably, and with no contracts or commitments.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Enter your address
2. Pick the service you need (snow removal, lawn mowing, spring cleanup, fall cleanup, or other yard care)
3. View instant pricing based on your job scope, size and service required.
4. Submit your request to nearby MowSnowPros
5. Receive job notifications every step of the way
6. View the before/after photos when the job is complete and pay-per-service directly in the app
It’s simple, fast, and designed for homeowners, landlords, tenants, Airbnb hosts, property managers, and anyone who needs yard work done without hassle.
Also offering no-contract recurring service for vacation or the entire season.
AVAILABLE SERVICES
- Snow Removal: driveway clearing, walkway shovelling, sidewalk snow removal, ice management
- Lawn Mowing: mowing, trimming, edging, and grass clipping cleanup
- Spring Yard Cleanup: power-raking, aerating, leaf removal, lawn mowing, debris cleanup, light yard care maintenance
- Fall Yard Cleanup: leaves, branches, debris collection, lawn mowing, aerating, pre-winter yard prep
- Weeding/Garden Cleanup
- Hedge Trimming
- Dog Poop Pickup
- Christmas Tree Removal
- Packed Snow/Ice Clearing
- Other On-Demand Yard Services depending on your region
WHERE MOWSNOWPROS IS AVAILABLE
MowSnowPros operates in the following Canadian cities & surrounding areas:
- Calgary, Alberta (Also: Airdrie, Chestermere, Cochrane, Okotoks)
- Edmonton, Alberta (Also: Beaumont, Fort Saskatchewan, Sherwood Park, Spruce Grove/Stony Plain, St. Albert., Leduc)
- Red Deer, Alberta
- Lethbridge, Alberta
- Regina, Saskatchewan
- Saskatoon, Saskatachewan
- Winnipeg, Manitoba
- Ottawa, Ontario
WHY PEOPLE LOVE MOWSNOWPROS:
ON-DEMAND CONVENIENCE
Request yard work whenever you need it — no scheduling phone calls or waiting days for availability.
NO CONTRACTS. NO SEASONAL FEES.
Pay only per job. Perfect for travelers, landlords, or anyone who doesn’t want long-term commitments.
UPFRONT PRICING
Know the price before you book. No surprises, no additional fees, no negotiations.
PHOTO PROOF OF EVERY JOB
You’ll receive before-and-after photos to confirm the work is done right.
VETTED LOCAL PROS
All MowSnowPros meet/maintain our requirements, complete onboarding and are reviewed by the community.
FAST RESPONSE TIMES
Most jobs are accepted within hours and completed the same day.
GREAT FOR REMOTE MANAGEMENT
Manage snow removal and lawn care for rental properties, Airbnb/short-term rentals, elderly family members, or vacant homes — from anywhere.
PERFECT FOR
- Homeowners looking for hassle-free yard services
- Renters needing one-time snow shovelling or lawn mowing
- Landlords and property managers maintaining multiple properties
- Real estate agents and their clients preparing a listing or managing a vacant property
- Vacation rental hosts (Airbnb/VRBO)
- Anyone who wants reliable, affordable, on-demand yard care
TAKE BACK YOUR TIME
Skip the shovelling. Skip the mowing. Skip the stress.
With MowSnowPros, professional snow removal, lawn mowing and yard care are just a few taps away.
Download the MowSnowPros app today and book your first on-demand yard service in minutes.

Trusted by frequent flyers, airport pickup pros, and aviation lovers worldwide, Flight Tracker delivers accurate, real-time updates using advanced flight radar 24 and plane tracker technology. Whether you're monitoring international airspace or just checking a domestic departure, we’ve got your sky covered.

▶ Track flights live around the world using high-precision fly radar and plane tracker maps
▶ Check real-time flight status - know about delays, gate changes, or cancellations instantly
▶ Search flights quickly with smart flight finder tools (by number, airport, or route)

▶ Access airport insights including terminal maps, baggage claim info, and local weather
▶ Explore aircraft data - see models, altitude, speed, and route history
▶ Use delay predictions powered by historical data to anticipate disruptions before they happen
WHY CHOOSE FLIGHT TRACKER?
▶ FLIGHT TRACKER LIVE FREE: Access global tracking without paying a dime - ideal for casual and daily travelers alike.
▶ REAL-TIME ACCURACY: Stay ahead of any update with lightning-fast data.
▶ PLANE TRACKER TOOLS: Visualize air traffic, track my flight status, and explore aircraft movements like a pro.
▶ USER-FRIENDLY DESIGN: Made for everyone - from the average traveler to aviation professionals.
WHY FLIGHT TRACKER STANDS OUT: 
▶ Combines top features from flight tracker apps similar to flightradar24, flightstats, and flightview 
▶ Great for casual travelers and flight schedule pros alike 
▶ Built for speed - faster load times, smoother interaction, and live updates without lag
DESIGNED FOR EVERY TYPE OF TRAVELER:
▶ BUSINESS TRAVELERS: Stay on top of flight status changes and manage tight connections.
▶ FRIENDS & FAMILY: Coordinate pickups with exact timing using airline flight status tracker tools.
▶ AVIATION ENTHUSIASTS: Enjoy deep dives into aircraft stats, flight paths, and global activity.
DOWNLOAD FLIGHT TRACKER TODAY!
Join thousands using our free flight tracker app to monitor real-time air traffic with ease. Whether you're searching for flight tracker 24 accuracy, live flight tracker performance, or tracking with the flight radar experience - Flight Tracker brings it all together.
PRO FEATURES INCLUDE:
▶ LIVE Tracking Without Limits – Follow any flight, anywhere, anytime.

bluejetty:00132881:ios.description:
Step into the perilous world of 'Rise of Necromancer,' a 2D action-adventure RPG that brings elements of battle, survival, strategy, and dark magic to your fingertips. Command a horde of undead minions, cast spells, and embark on a thrilling journey filled with fast-paced battles and unforgettable challenges.
Intense Battle Royale Experience:
Immerse yourself in battle royale-style challenges where you must exterminate waves of mobs, monsters, and enemies in intense, stage-based conflicts. Each battle offers unique strategic options, power-ups, and rewards, enhancing the experience with every stage you conquer.
Survive & Thrive in 2D RPG Arena:
Survival is key as you face relentless attacks in immersive arenas filled with challenges. Your ability to strategize, master the art of battle, and overcome unique levels of difficulty and peril will define your success.
Customizable Hero & RPG Elements:
Skills & Spells: Choose from over 50 unique spells and abilities, each with strategic uses and stunning visual effects.
Equipment & Weapons: Equip your necromancer with a range of magical staffs, robes, and accessories, each enhancing specific powers.
Leveling & Progression: Progress through a complex skill tree, unlocking new abilities, and enhancing your necromancer's strengths.
Character Appearance: Customize the appearance of your necromancer with various skins and visual effects.
Roguelike & Roguelite Challenges:
Face unexpected twists, power-ups, and relentless foes in roguelike levels filled with excitement. Your ability to adapt and strategize will be tested to the limit.
Stunning Visuals & Mobile Game Excellence:
Experience 'Rise of Necromancer' in beautiful 2D graphics, optimized for a smooth and responsive mobile gaming experience.
Skills, Strategy & Tactical Combat:
Master the wide range of skills, strategies, and tactical combat techniques to dominate the battlefield. Your decisions will shape each battle's outcome in this fast-paced arena.
Achievements, Rewards & Daily Quests:
Unlock achievements, earn rewards, and complete daily quests to gain valuable perks. Engage with unique events and challenges to progress through the game.
Updates & Future Plans:
Stay tuned for regular updates, new content, and exciting additions to the game. We're committed to keeping 'Rise of Necromancer' engaging and fresh for players of all lev
'Rise of Necromancer' offers a unique blend of battle royale, action, adventure, survival strategy, leveling up, skill development, equipment customization, and more. Download now and embrace the ultimate thrill of being a master of the undead! Your dark adventure awaits.

bluejetty:00017750:ios.name: Commercial Bank KS
bluejetty:00017750:ios.summary: The Commercial Bank KS App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can
bluejetty:00017750:ios.description:
The Commercial Bank KS App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Commercial Bank KS customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Commercial Bank KS App, you must be enrolled as an Commercial Bank KS Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00034423:ios.description:
Unleash the Power of Merged Crafting!
Dive into the thrilling world of Merge Craft Robot, where your tactical skills and crafting prowess will be put to the ultimate test. Gather an unstoppable army of crafters, shark robots, and even fearsome minicraft, and lead them to epic victory on the battlegrounds.
Craft Your Destiny
Combine your resources strategically to merge crafting blocks & shark robots to create a powerful lineup of warriors. From humble beginnings, watch as your troops evolve into mighty champions capable of crushing the enemy's defenses. Will you raise an army of crafting robots, lethal archers, or even colossal dinosaurs? The choice is yours!
Real-Time Strategy Mastery
Merge Game: Merge Craft Robot is a true test of your real-time strategy skills. Carefully place your merged crafts on the battlefield, reacting quickly to enemy movements and making split-second decisions. The higher the enemy's level, the stronger their attack and defense - only the most skilled tacticians will emerge victorious.
Your opponents in this epic battle are no pushovers - they come in the form of mighty crafting dragons, bloodthirsty monsters, massive T-Rexes robots. Caution - if you don't merge your crafting robots units quickly enough, your crafting enemies will defeat you in the final battle mini game. Merging swiftly is crucial to emerging victorious versus shark robots
Key Features
- Craft, merge, and evolve a diverse range of robots, craftman warriors, and prehistoric beasts
- Devise winning strategies by intelligently combining robots units with complementary merge skills
- Immerse yourself in stunning 3D crafting graphics and satisfying merge robots mechanics
- Compete against craft robots opponents in fast-paced, real-time mini game battle
- Unlock new, increasingly powerful units to add to your customizable crafting army
Be the first player to achieve Merge Master: Craft Robo status and collect the complete robo craft set! Merge craft robo together to unlock powerful abilities in this merge-based minicraft battle game.

bluejetty:00023652:ios.description:
The fastest way to know when the earth moves. Get real-time earthquake alerts from 10+ official seismic networks worldwide — free, focused, and built to respect your privacy.
Trusted by millions since 2010. 4.7 stars from thousands of users who count on us when it matters.
WHY EARTHQUAKE:
- Real-time data from 10+ official sources (more than any other app)
- Fast, focused, and lightweight — under 50 MB
- No location tracking required to get global alerts
- Built for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
FREE FEATURES:
- Live worldwide earthquake data delivered in seconds
- Data from 10+ official agencies: USGS, EMSC, GeoNet (New Zealand), Natural Resources Canada, British Geological Survey, GFZ (Germany), INGV (Italy), KNMI (Netherlands), MNSS, OVSICORI (Costa Rica), and GeoScience Australia
- Global alerts for any earthquake magnitude 5.0+
- Tsunami warnings
- Volcanoes on the map
- Sort by magnitude, location, or time
- Search any earthquake in the list
- Detailed map with color and size-coded pins
- Map clustering for cleaner views during seismic swarms
- Direct links to official reporting agencies
- Optimized for iPhone, iPad, iPod Touch, and Mac
PREMIUM:
- Track individual earthquakes — get notified when shake maps are released, when magnitudes are revised, or when new aftershock data comes in
- USGS Shake Map overlays on major quakes
- Fine-tuned filtering by source, magnitude, distance, and time
- Localized alerts customized to your region
PRIVACY MATTERS:
- No ad tracking SDKs in this app
- No location required to use the app
- You control what data is shared and when
- Full privacy policy: https://static.app.mobeezio.com/earthquake/privacy.html
WHO USES EARTHQUAKE:
Geologists, geophysicists, first responders, expats with family in seismic regions, residents of California, Japan, Indonesia, Turkey, Italy, Chile, Mexico, the Philippines, and anyone who's ever asked "was that an earthquake?"
WE LISTEN:
Got a suggestion? We read every email and ship updates monthly. Reach us at support@mobeezio.com — usually within 24 hours.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS:
Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings. Payment is charged to your iTunes account on confirmation of purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://static.app.mobeezio.com/earthquake/privacy.html

bluejetty:00096477:ios.description:
Try a refreshing mahjong match game designed with special tap-and-slide mechanic. Calm yet engaging, this mahjong for seniors turns every tile match into a moment of peace.
ABOUT THE GAME
Mahjong Match Game brings a new life to classic mahjong games, offering an easy yet meaningful way to relax your mind. Designed for clarity and comfort, this match puzzle encourages players to think calmly and enjoy simple satisfaction. Each tap and slide connects pairs smoothly, making it the perfect game for seniors who love mindful entertainment and beautiful visuals. With a mix of traditional charm and modern touch, this sliding puzzle creates a relaxing tile match saga that keeps your brain active.
HOW TO PLAY
- Choose Your Mode: Relax, Normal, or Expert - start simple or test your sharp thinking across different match game levels.
- Tap or Slide to Match: Observe the board carefully, find identical mahjong tiles, and eliminate them by tapping or sliding to make pairs.
- Match in All Directions: Pairs can be vertical or horizontal, giving you more freedom to plan each tile move.
- Clear the Board: Match all tiles to complete the level and reach your best score as the next match master.
KEY FEATURES
- Fresh Tap & Slide Mechanics: A new twist on the mahjong match game formula — every move feels smooth, interactive, and deeply satisfying.
- Designed for Seniors: Large tiles, gentle colors, and intuitive controls create a calm, stress-free experience for every player.
- Offline Anytime: Enjoy relaxing tile match puzzles wherever you are — no Wi-Fi, no pressure, just pure relaxation.
- Many Levels & Modes: Progress through hundreds of match puzzle stages across Relax, Normal, and Expert modes for endless fun and focus.
- No Timer, No Rush: Take your time, plan each move, and enjoy every match at your own pace — perfect for mindful play.
Ready to unwind your mind and train your focus? Tap, slide, and match your way through hundreds of beautiful puzzles. Start your journey in Mahjong Match Game today - tile matching game that combines classic relaxation with a modern slide game twist. Play anywhere, anytime, and enjoy the most peaceful game for seniors experience made for you.
Note: This puzzle game is inspired by the look and style of mahjong tiles. It doesn’t include gameplay of traditional Mahjong or other types of solitaire or card games.

bluejetty:00020987:ios.description:
MX Video Player HD – All Format Video Player & Media Toolkit
MX Video Player HD is a complete, high-performance video player and media converter designed for iOS. It plays all your videos in high-definition, supports every popular video format, and gives you powerful tools like video editing, audio extraction, video reverse, and much more – all in one fast and easy-to-use app.
Whether you're watching downloaded movies, managing your personal video collection, or converting clips for social sharing, MX Video Player HD offers unmatched control and smooth playback with zero quality loss.
 All-in-One Video Tools:
 - Video Converter: Convert between formats like MKV to MP4, AVI to MOV, and more.
 - Video to MP3: Extract audio from any video in high-quality MP3 format.
 - Reverse Video: Create fun or creative reversed playback videos easily.
 - Video Editor: Trim, cut, and merge videos with simple tools for quick edits.
 - Compress Video: Reduce file size while maintaining quality – perfect for sharing.
 Smart Video Player Features:
 - Supports ALL formats: MP4, AVI, MKV, 3GP, FLV, MOV, WMV, MPG, TS, RMVB, etc.
 - Full HD and Ultra HD (4K) playback without buffering
 - Automatically scans all videos from device and SD card
 - Organizes videos in folders for easy access
 - Lock screen feature to prevent accidental touches while watching
 - Swipe controls to increase/decrease volume, brightness, and seek position
 - Options to change aspect ratio, zoom mode, and auto-rotation
 - Quick load and resume playback where you left off
Extra Highlights:
Fast video loading and smart gesture support
Lightweight and smooth performance, optimized for iPhone and iPad
View videos by folder, format, or custom list
Privacy protection with screen lock and app lock features
Simple and beautiful UI for a great viewing experience
Bonus Entertainment:
MX Video Player also brings you popular Bollywood movies, and action films directly in the app. Watch, organize, and enjoy HD content on the go.
Whether you're at home or traveling, MX Video Player is your entertainment companion — powerful, reliable, and built for all types of users.

If you are an avid fan of cooking games, then Little Panda's Restaurant is perfect for you! Here you will realize your dream of becoming a chef step by step! Ready to put on an apron and cook mouth-watering treats in this cooking game? Let's get started!
UNLOCK INTERNATIONAL MENU
There are lots of dishes in the restaurant: over 30 types of desserts and dishes from different cultures, including salads, juices, donuts, sandwiches, cakes and more. In this cooking game, you can show off your cooking talents and cook any food you want!
ENJOY COOKING
In the restaurant, you will find that cooking games can be easy and fun! Just select any ingredients and tap the screen to slice, mix, boil, fry or bake! Unleash your culinary creativity and discover your passion for food!
RUN A BUSY RESTAURANT
You can run various restaurants, such as the salad store, Chinese restaurant, barbecue store, and cake store! You can ask your customers what they like and keep developing new cuisines to satisfy them. Well-fed customers will bring you many coins! You can use these coins to unlock new restaurants!
Go and immerse yourself in a real cooking game craze!
FEATURES:
- A cooking game that all kids love;
- Chinese restaurant, BBQ shop, cake shop and more;
- About 30+ recipes to choose from;
- 40+ types of food to cook: beef, eggs and more;
- 19 types of kitchenware to help you cook better, such as frying pans and blenders;
- Try all kinds of cooking: grilling, frying, baking and more;
- Various sauces: paprika, seafood sauce and more;
- Serve customers and run the restaurant!
About BabyBus

At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own.
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 400 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have released over 200 children's educational apps, over 2500 episodes of nursery rhymes and animations of various themes spanning the Health, Language, Society, Science, Art and other fields.

bluejetty:00018217:ios.description:
Send money abroad fast with low fees, great rates, and real-time tracking, while easily managing the money you send back home.
Pangea is more than a simple money transfer app. You get built-in tools to organize your sending history, track family goals, and see your total impact over time without keeping spreadsheets or doing mental math.
Why Choose Pangea?
 • Instant transfers: Send money in minutes†. Skip the bank and credit union lines.
 • Low fees & great rates: No hidden costs. First transfer is fee-free.**
 • See your money at a glance: Your personal Dashboard groups transfers by month, year, or person so you can see your total impact over time.
 • Turn transfers into completed goals: Set custom targets in your receiver’s local currency for tuition, home projects, or savings, and watch your progress bar reach 100%.
 • Know where every dollar goes: Add optional labels like Groceries, Medical, or Rent with one tap, or split transfers into multiple categories.
 • Get smart updates and savings insights††: Tap the sparkle icon in the app anytime to track sending patterns, celebrate milestones, and view exchange-rate savings.
 • Flexible, and secure delivery: Send to bank accounts, debit cards, mobile wallets or cash pickup at over 40,000 partner locations, all backed by bank-grade security.
 • Bilingual support: Get support in English and Spanish whenever you need it.
Send to 24 Destinations
Mexico · Guatemala · Colombia · El Salvador · Honduras · Dominican Republic · Philippines · India · Thailand · Vietnam · Indonesia · Singapore · Malaysia · Bangladesh · Nepal · Kenya · Ghana · Uganda · Senegal · Côte d'Ivoire · Burkina Faso · Italy · France · Germany
Download Pangea today to send money home and manage it with total clarity!
Disclaimers:
*Images are for illustrative purposes. Offers and rates subject to change. Terms: pangeamoneytransfer.com/terms.
**Waives transfer fee on qualifying first transactions. Credit card fees and FX margin still apply.
***New Customer Rate: Offer available only in select countries and for new users or users who have created an account with Pangea but have not completed a transfer before the launch of this promotion. The promotional rate applies to the first $500 USD transferred, whether in a single transaction or across multiple transactions totaling $500 USD. Any amount beyond this will be subject to the standard (non-promotional) rate. Rates are subject to change. See terms for the list of participating countries and other restrictions.
†Delivery time: Processing times may vary due to security checks, receiver bank policies, or other factors.
††AI Insights: These insights are generated automatically using your transfer activity and are not reviewed by a person. Savings are estimated based on historical exchange-rate data from a comparable provider and may differ from actual rates available at the time of your transfer. Estimates exclude fees, promotions, delivery speed, and other service differences.

Bank of the Plains is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Bank of the Plains:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Bank of the Plains app, you must be enrolled as a Bank of the Plains Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00019258:ios.summary:

MouseH
bluejetty:00019258:ios.description:
The Kingdom of Gnawnia needs MouseHunters! Choose from dozens of unique mousetraps with their own elements and powerups. Arm your trap with magical cheese from all over the world, and end Gnawnia’s pest problem - one hunt at a time!
MouseHunt is an award-winning Idle RPG Adventure you can play anywhere, anytime. Check your trap throughout the day (and secretly while at work) or join friends and hunt together. 
*PLAY THROUGHOUT THE DAY*
Your trap will passively catch mice for you every hour, all day and night, or sound the Hunter’s Horn to begin a hunt every 15 minutes. Friends adventuring with you can also sound the Horn on your behalf; hunting is always easier in teams!
*CRAFT POWERFUL TRAPS*
Mix and match your cheeses, weapons and bases to make a winning mouse-catching combination! Mice from all around the Kingdom have different preferences, weaknesses, and behaviours. Study the enemy, craft the perfect mousetrap, and set your bait! Maximize your trap power to catch rare and elusive mice while on adventures!
*WORKIN' AS A TEAM*
MouseHunt is the only Idle RPG Adventure where teamwork goes all the way! Join multiplayer treasure map hunts and win rare and limited-edition hunting tools and mouse bait. 
Compete in tournaments and climb the leaderboards with your allies and become a tournament champion! Cover more ground when you hunt mice with your friends! 
*REGIONAL FRIEND HUNTING*
Don't worry if you need to dip away from the adventure while hunting with friends. With Regional Friend Hunting, your friends can sound the Horn on your behalf in nearby regions. 
Don't be idle in an Idle RPG - sound the horn and help your friends with their adventures!
*SEASONAL HUNTING EVENTS*
Something exciting is always afoot in the Land of Gnawnia. Your RPG is idle, but that doesn't mean your calendar has to be! Join us for the winter holidays for the Great Winter Hunt, or brew up creepy concoctions during our Halloween event. Check back regularly for new events, updates, multiplayer events and more!
And that’s not all! MouseHunters also enjoy:
● Over a thousand ridiculous, fantastical mice to catch, from the mundane Grey mouse to fire-breathing dragon-mice and much more!
● Dozens of unique locations spanning the depths of the Sunken City to the Floating Isles, each with its own ecosystem, puzzles, and progression to explore.
● Hundreds of trap combinations. Mix and match trap types and baits to catch different breeds of mice.
● Frequent community and seasonal events, quests, and minigames. There’s always something new to explore.
● An incredible player community of hunters, traders, and cheesemongers to play, trade, and swap hunting tips with!
Check back every 15 minutes for a new surprise! Can you rise to the challenge and be a Legendary MouseHunter?
--
Follow us on Facebook for frequent updates and links to FREE LOOT! https://www.facebook.com/MouseHuntTheGame
Join the Fan Discord for hunting strategies, or to make friends with your fellow Hunters! https://discord.gg/mousehunt
--

bluejetty:00065801:ios.summary: Over 4 millions users rely on BetMines. Follow our daily betting tips for football, get notified by our Live and Prematch scanners, look at statistical trends for the main betting events, analyse team statistics, follow other tipsters bets,
bluejetty:00065801:ios.description:
Over 4 millions users rely on BetMines. Follow our daily betting tips for football, get notified by our Live and Prematch scanners, look at statistical trends for the main betting events, analyse team statistics, follow other tipsters bets, test your strategy by creating free virtual football bets, follow livescore and much more!
BetMines is a totally free football betting support application that offers several tools to help you increase your success rate and teach you how to bet!
--- DAILY TIPS ---
We are the best football predictions and football tips app. We provide FREE and accurate daily football betting predictions and tips for each match elaborated by an artificial intelligence algorithm constantly evolving.
The algorithm takes into account the history of the results of the teams, the state of recent form, head-2-head matches, home and away performances, statistical data of the reference league, any sidelined player, the fluctuation of odds (provided by an important bookmaker) and on the basis of these and other data elaborates the most likely outcome of each match.
In addition to the football tips of the algorithm, we also provide two bets of the day elaborated by our team of football betting experts: Doubling and Risk of the Day.
All the bet predictions are free!
--- LIVE AND PRE-MATCH SCANNER ---
BetMines scanners scan every second all football matches and send you alerts every time a match meets your criteria
--- TRENDS ---
Find statistical trends for the main events - like 1X2, Total Goals, Both team to score - for teams with matches in the coming days
--- SOCIAL FOOTBALL BETTING ---
Football betting becomes social!
You can follow the best tipsters in the application, copy their bets and become yourself a reference point for the community .
When you sign up you will receive 1000 virtual diamonds with which you can create virtual bets , both to test your gaming strategies and to challenge other tipsters and climb the rankings of the best tipsters of the day, week, month and ever.
The ranking is based on the profit generated by the tipster in the concerned period , so you can easily identify the best BetMines's tipster!
The best daily bets will be published on our social channels.
NB: You don't win any cash prizes, these are virtual bets ( and not real money ) with the aim of testing your gaming strategies and having fun at the same time!
--- TEAMS STATISTICS ---
For each team involved in the match we provide the results of the last 5 matches in general, the last 5 at home and the last 5 away games.
For the last 10 matches of each team we also provide:
- the percentage of results 1.5+,2.5+ and 3.5+ goals, Both team to score, 3 Way Result
- the mean of the corners
- Total goals
- Clean sheet matches
--- LEAGUE STATISTICS ---
For each league we supply:
- Standings
- Percentages of 1.5+,2.5+, 3.5+ goals and both team to score outcomes
- The minutes of the goals
- Average goal per game
- Average of yellow and red cards
--- BETMINES MACHINE ---
It is a tool that allows you to generate bets with a high probability of success taking into account the selected criteria.
You choose the leagues you want to bet on, the type of event (1X2, double chance, under/over , combo and both team to score), the desired odds range, the number of matches and BetMines will generate for you the most likely bet based on the criteria you have chosen.
--- OTHER FEATURES ---
- possibility to choose your favorite leagues
- possibility to follow the results live thanks to a livescore service
- possibility to access the best odds for each event
- possibility of receiving push notifications when our suggested bets are published, when a tipster you follow posts a bet or when the bet you placed is winning.
Follow BetMines football predictions, analyse the statistics provided, follow the best tipsters and create your own winning football bets for FREE!
Please have a look at our Terms of Use:
https://betmines.com/TermsOfUse.html

bluejetty:00017264:ios.description:
Enter a legendary fantasy world where your defense towers are living monsters, and each hero commands the power of ancient magic.
Prepare to defend your kingdom against relentless invasions from four powerful enemy clans:
– creatures from the underground caves, including dragons and horned beasts,
– the undead from cursed wastelands,
– demons from fiery infernos,
– and elemental spirits from a realm of pure magic.
In this epic tower defense strategy game, your decisions shape the battlefield. Build your defenses, summon your champions, and unleash spells from the Book of Magic.
Features:
• Two story campaigns filled with dangerous enemies — dragons, vampires, demons, and more.
• Over 50 unique enemy types, each with their own abilities and tactics.
• Six defender races, including noble knights, mystical mages, forest guardians, wild beasts, and elemental creatures.
• 80+ battle towers inspired by mythical beasts and arcane constructs.
• Legendary heroes with unique skills: strategists, spellcasters, warlords.
• Powerful ancient artifacts: swords, shields, rings, scrolls, and magical armor.
• Elemental magic system: Fire, Water, Air, and Earth.
• Dozens of battle spells: Fireball, Lightning, Summon Elementals, Haste, Slow, and more.
• Three difficulty modes — including a Hardcore challenge for true tacticians.
• Endless Deathmatch mode for non-stop defense action.
• Fully offline gameplay — no internet required.
Why You’ll Love It:
If you enjoy classic fantasy strategy, rich world-building, and tactical tower defense gameplay — this adventure is for you.
Gather your forces. Choose your hero. Save the realm.

Everything is designed to take just a few minutes a day.

TRANSFORM YOUR MINDSET WITH HABITS THAT LAST

Lasting Change is a modern mental-wellness and habit-building app designed to help you reduce stress, build emotional resilience, and create routines that genuinely last. Get daily tools, guidance, and support designed to help you grow from the inside out.

1. PLAN TAILORED TO YOUR MIND & GOALS

Whether you want to feel calmer, build confidence, break old patterns, or develop healthy habits, Lasting Change adapts to your needs.

Lasting Change helps you:

Reduce stress & emotional overwhelm
Build stronger self-esteem and clarity
Understand your triggers and patterns
Replace unhelpful habits with supportive ones

2. BUILD HABITS THAT LAST
At the center of Lasting Change is the power of consistency:
Daily habit reminders
Emotional check-ins
Lifestyle challenges for growth
Gentle guidance to help you stay committed
You’re not forcing a change – you’re building a foundation that lasts.

3. GUIDED SESSIONS YOU’LL ACTUALLY USE
Explore practical tools rooted in psychology and mindfulness:
Short audio sessions for stress, grounding & motivation
Breathing exercises
Journaling prompts for clarity
Mini-lessons for long-term behavior change
Everything is designed to take just a few minutes a day.

4. UNDERSTAND YOUR EMOTIONAL PATTERNS
Track your mood, stress levels, sleep, habits and progress.
See what supports your well-being – and what drains it – with simple trend insights that help you stay aware and empowered.

5. SMART TRACKING FOR REAL PROGRESS

Lasting Change includes:

Mood and stress tracking
Habit streaks and consistency insights
Sleep & wellness logs
Milestones, breakthroughs & reflections
Small steps become real transformation over time.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE LASTING CHANGE

Practical emotional tools for everyday challenges
Short sessions that fit any day
Better sleep, clarity, and calm
Habit-building structure that actually sticks
Personalized mindset support
Coach guidance and consultations to help you stay on track and overcome dips in motivation
Private, safe, user-controlled data
Your data, your control

Your personal data is encrypted and protected.
You can delete your account and all associated data anytime directly in the app.

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS

Lasting Change offers flexible auto-renewing plans.

PAYMENT & RENEWAL
You can download and use the app for free. Continued access to all features requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in account settings. Prices apply to U.S. customers; international pricing may vary by currency.
For support or questions, contact us at hello@lastingchange.app

Privacy Policy: https://lastingchange.app/privacy 
Terms of Use: https://lastingchange.app/terms
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Start your transformation today

Download Lasting Change and discover how small daily habits, mindset tools, and emotional clarity can help you create real, lasting change – one day at a time.

bluejetty:00062275:ios.description:
GuitarTuna is your go-to guitar app, with over 100 million downloads and counting! Tune your guitar in seconds with the free guitar tuner, explore guitar chords & tabs for 20,000+ songs, and learn how to play guitar songs you love with trainers, tutorials & personalized feedback.
Why you’ll love GuitarTuna
• Tune any guitar, ukulele, violin or bass perfectly with easy-to-use tuning
• Switch seamlessly between guitar tuner, ukulele tuner, bass tuner & more
• Get guitar tabs & chords for your favorite songs
• Learn guitar songs with trainers, tutorials & personalized feedback
• Practice like a pro with essential tools for guitar
• Play songs you love at any skill level – guitar beginners included!
• Become a better guitar player with an all-in-one guitar app in your pocket
How it works
• Just pluck a string on your instrument and GuitarTuna detects the sound using your device’s microphone.
• You’ll get instant visual feedback while tuning. No cables needed.
• With our audio recognition technology, you’ll get insanely accurate tuning. Noise cancellation technology eliminates background noises while you tune.
Learn songs with guitar tutorials
• Learn guitar songs with video tutorials & interactive trainers
• Get personalized feedback to improve your guitar playing
• Create your own personalized learning path
• Get tips from expert guitarists
Play songs with guitar tabs & chords
• Explore guitar tabs for 20,000+ popular songs by top global artists
• Get pro-quality guitar chords & guitar tabs
• Choose guitar tabs & chords for your skill level
• Play at your own pace while chords & tabs sync with you
• Request guitar tabs & chords for your favorite songs
• New guitar songs & tabs added weekly!
Tools to practice guitar like a pro
• Metronome: Set your tempo & customize your time signature with the metronome tool
• Chord games: G chord giving you trouble? Learn, practice & master guitar chords with customizable games.
• Ear trainer: Improve your music skills & recognize chords by ear
• Chord library: Explore guitar chords with diagrams & audio
• Left-hand mode: Easily switch between right & left hand modes
Instruments
• Guitar
• Guitar 7-String
• Guitar 12-String
• Ukulele
• Cavaquinho
• Bass
• Bass 5-string
• Violin
• Viola
• Cello
• Fiddle
• Mandolin
• Balalaika
• Banjo
• Banjo 5-String
We’ve put a lot of love and effort into making GuitarTuna the tuner it is today. Your feedback is valuable to us, and you can be sure we’re listening. We recently added pro-quality guitar song chords and lyrics to the app because of the sheer amount of requests for them. Play your favorite songs anywhere, anytime, with our entire song library produced by professional musicians.
GuitarTuna Pro subscription: Subscribe for unlimited access. Subscriptions are monthly. Prices may vary in different countries. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s iTunes Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
GuitarTuna is developed by Yousician. Check out Yousician’s apps to learn and master guitar, ukulele, bass, piano or singing!
It’s pretty cool you actually read this far! Here’s a joke for you: What’s the difference between a bass and a tuna? You can tuna bass, but you can’t bass a tuna!
Now download the app and see how it is.
Send us your feedback on the joke and the app to support@guitartuna.com!

https://yousician.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00159511:ios.name: Codebook Password Manager
bluejetty:00159511:ios.summary:
Codebok Password Manager provides powerful and complete data encryption, a flexible data model, automatic sync with Codebook Cloud, and Password AutoFill.
Codebook is free to download and use. Automatic sync with Codebook Cloud requires a
bluejetty:00159511:ios.description:
Codebok Password Manager provides powerful and complete data encryption, a flexible data model, automatic sync with Codebook Cloud, and Password AutoFill.
Codebook is free to download and use. Automatic sync with Codebook Cloud requires a subscription.
Codebook has been protecting sensitive information on mobile devices since the days of the Palm Pilot! It protects your passwords and personal information from unauthorized access by would-be crackers, malicious thieves, and snoopy coworkers. Stop using the same password for all your accounts! Codebook generates strong, random passwords and keeps them for you, protected by your master password and powerful encryption.
With a subscription to Codebook Cloud, Codebook will keep your passwords and other sensitive data in sync across all your devices.
Features:
* Fast login with Face ID and Touch ID
* Full support for AufoFill Passwords in iOS
* Designed to work on iPhone *and* iPad
* Automatic background sync with Codebook Cloud
* Support for user-initiated sync over Dropbox, Drive, and Desktop WiFi (w/ Codebook for macOS and Windows)
* Full text search as you type across all your records and fields
* Auto-lock timer allows you to keep Codebook temporarily unlocked while you switch apps
* Configurable field masking to hide sensitive data from view
* Erases clipboard when information is copied to be pasted in other apps after two minutes
* Supports both portrait and landscape device orientation
* Includes 200 gorgeous color icons for personalizing your records
* Generates two-step verification (TOTP) codes
* Scans QR codes with main camera
* Store sensitive Image files and PDF documents (10MB max)
* Scan and save data from QR codes directly to your entries
* The Password Review feature checks a password for breaches in the HaveIBeenPwned.com database of over half a billion hacked passwords
Use Stronger Passwords:
* Codebook helps you remember stronger passwords, but also to generate them
* The password generator allows you to generate random passwords from several common character sets, and adjusts for bias
* The password generator also supports Diceware passwords, both the Reinhold and Electronic Frontier Foundation variants
Customize Away:
* Personalize categories to match your organizational style
* Customize your entries including usernames, passwords, websites, notes and create your own fields and labels
* Note records can be created in any category to store free-form text
* Store any information you want--no restrictive templates!
* Store URL connection strings (e.g. SSH, AFP, SFTP) to launch other applications directly
* Star your Favorites to get at them quickly and sort them to the top of search results
Encryption and Password Protection:
* Uses the open source, encrypted database engine SQLCipher for all data storage
* The encryption used is 256-bit AES in CBC mode
* Master Password key derivation uses 256,000 rounds of PBKDF2 SHA-256
* Every encrypted database has its own random initialization vector
* Every page of storage has its own random initialization vector and HMAC protection
* Hardware-accelerated using CommonCrypto for speed and reduced battery consumption
* All sync data is encrypted with a completely random Sync Key
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Baixe agora e conheça uma nova experiência em leitura. Venha para o Claro banca!

bluejetty:00070342:ios.description:
Get an expert answer to every question—right on your phone with the JustAnswer app. Chat with 12,000+ verified Experts on demand, 24/7. Since 2003, we've helped more than 10 million people get instant access to professional help.    
APP FEATURES 
- Ask questions in 700+ professional specialties including legal, medical, pet care & more. 
- Save your favorite Experts so you can ask for help again and again. 
- Get notified the instant an Expert replies to your question. 
Rated 4.1/5 by customers on TrustPilot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.justanswer.com  
HOW IT WORKS 
Ask as many questions as you want with a monthly membership: 
Step 1—Tell us your situation. Ask any question, 24/7. Chat with Experts like lawyers, doctors, veterinarians, mechanics, computer techs, electricians, plumbers, tax accountants, and more. 
Step 2—We’ll connect you in minutes with the best Expert for your question. 
Step 3—Talk, text, or chat till you have your answer.
ASK TRUSTED PROFESSIONALS 
JustAnswer connects you with real Experts, so you can feel confident in the answers you get. Every Expert on JustAnswer is vetted through a Multi-Step Expert Quality Process, including license verification and peer reviews. 
Experts join JustAnswer from some of the world’s most trusted institutions, including Harvard lawyers, UCLA doctors, Microsoft-certified computer techs, Christie’s appraisers, UC Davis vets. 
CONVENIENT ONLINE HELP 
Discuss your individual situation with an Expert who specializes in your topic, 24/7. 
LAW: Lawyers specializing in immigration law, family law, employment law, real estate law, criminal law, landlord-tenant law, education law, IP law, estate law, personal injury law, traffic law, and more. 
HEALTH: Doctors and specialists for OB-GYN, dermatology, neurology, urology, pediatrics, dental health, eye health, cardiology, oncology, mental health counseling, and general wellness. 
PETS: Vet care for all pets, big or small, including dogs, cats, birds, reptiles, horses, rabbits, fish, rodents, exotic pets, and farm animals. 
TECH: Support for computers, laptops, mobile phones, email, Microsoft Office, printers, WiFi networking, TVs, and consumer electronics. 
CARS: Most domestic and foreign car brands, motorcycles, trucks, RVs, heavy equipment, and even boats. 
HOME IMPROVEMENT: Appliance, heating, ventilation, air conditioning, plumbing, electrical, pool and spa, landscaping, home renovation, and general maintenance. 
AND MORE: Appraisals, small business help, tax advisory, relationship counseling, job counseling, firearms, and dream interpretation. 
CONTACT US  
If for any reason you’re not satisfied, our Customer Care team is ready to help 24/7. Please contact us directly at AppSupport@justanswer.com or call 800-941-1229 so we can help resolve your concerns. 
Use our live chat for an instant response: 
https://www.justanswer.com/help/contact-us
