bluejetty:00013886:ios.description:
Bringg is the leading customer-centric logistics solution for enterprises, with customers from more than 
50 countries including some of the world's best-known brands. Using our powerful SaaS platform, companies in the logistics, retail, food, CPG, and services industries can achieve logistical excellence across every aspect of their complex delivery ecosystems while balancing their various needs - from management and marketing at headquarters, through dispatchers and drivers in the field, and all the way to the customers who are at the heart of the entire operation. Bringg provides our customers with strategic value by helping them create optimal delivery experiences and streamline their operations for peak efficiency, all in real-time.
The driver app is an integral part of the Bringg platform, providing everything drivers need to efficiently manage their deliveries, completely hands-free:
- Communicate and share location with managers, dispatchers and customers
- Receive tasks and detailed order info and easily navigate to delivery destinations
- Maintain proof of delivery and chain of custody for full control of the supply chain
- Collect barcodes, information, payments, photos, forms, comments and signatures
*Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00014292:ios.description:
IDTheftDefense helps you protect your identity and online privacy. You must be an IDTheftDefense member to use the IDTheftDefense app. IDTheftDefense® is a product offered by Pre-Paid Legal Services, Inc. ("LegalShield") through contractual agreement with Primerica Client Services, Inc.
With IDTheftDefense you receive identity and online privacy protection services so you can monitor more of what matters and receive consultation and restoration services in the event of identity theft.
MONITOR — More of what matters
The IDTheftDefense® plan monitors your Personally Identifiable Information (PII), not just your Social Security number, credit cards and bank accounts. It monitors much more. If any change in your status is detected, you receive an alert.
CONSULTATION — When you need it
IDTheftDefense identity specialists are available to provide consultations on an unlimited number of identity-related issues or concerns. You don’t have to be a victim of identity theft to take advantage of consultation services. Talk with an identity specialist when you have questions about a recent data breach or receive a suspicious email or phone call. You can even get tips for proactively protecting your personal information.
RESTORE — Your identity
IDTheftDefense members have access to consultation services provided by our licensed private investigators if an identity theft event does occur. The investigator will do whatever it takes for as long as it takes to restore your identity to its pre-theft status.
IDTheftDefense® is a product offered by Pre-Paid Legal Services, Inc. ("LegalShield") through contractual agreement with Primerica Client Services, Inc. Neither Primerica Client Services, Inc., nor its officers, employees or sales representatives directly or indirectly provide identity theft protection, restoration services or advice. LegalShield provides access to identity theft protection plans. Identity theft protection plans provide access to monitoring, consultation, and restoration services. An Identity Fraud Protection Plan is underwritten and administered through American Bankers Insurance Company of Florida, an Assurant company. LegalShield is not an insurance carrier. Please refer to the actual policies for terms, conditions, and exclusions of coverage. Coverage varies by plan and may not be available in all jurisdictions.

bluejetty:00061596:ios.name: Dext: Expense Tracker
bluejetty:00061596:ios.summary: Dext is the best expense tracker app that effortlessly extracts data from receipts or invoices, regardless of their size or quantity, ensuring you remain in control of your expenses wherever you are. It meticulously itemizes and categorizes
bluejetty:00061596:ios.description:
Dext is the best expense tracker app that effortlessly extracts data from receipts or invoices, regardless of their size or quantity, ensuring you remain in control of your expenses wherever you are. It meticulously itemizes and categorizes this data, offering valuable insights into your business. By leveraging Dext, you can make informed decisions, save time, and seamlessly integrate expenses into your accounting systems.
As a cloud-based easy expense management solution, once you sign up for Dext through the app, you gain access to various expense management features and submission methods across different devices.
- Submit receipts via Mobile app
- Upload expenses from your computer
- Email Invoices via your dedicated Dext Prepare email-in address
- Set up a Fetch connection with a supplier
Key Benefits:
* Expense data extraction with a simple snap: Our Optical Character Recognition, with 99.9% accuracy and combined with AI, digitizes any receipts, bills, and invoices, decoding even handwriting.
* Experience even faster, automated integration with your suppliers and accountants: Your expense data seamlessly travels from 1,400+ suppliers – such as Xero, Sage and QuickBooks. We manage expense tracking, reconciliation, categorization for a simplified tax compliance.
* Trustworthy data & receipt tracker: We excel in bookkeeping automation, ensuring reliable extraction and reconciliation of item transactions. No glitches, just an easy flow of expense data that enables faster business decisions.
Key App features:
- Camera modes: Single mode to extract a single receipt, multiple mode to capture several expenses (Dext separates each photo into a separate item), and combine mode to capture expense data spread over several pages or for very long receipts (Dext combines photos into one item).
- Connect to QuickBooks (QBO) and Xero from the app: This new feature integrates software with just a couple of taps, enabling you to start tracking and sending expenses automatically to your accountant. If you work with other software like Sage, you can still connect your expenses via our cloud system on the web.
- Expense itemization across all submission methods: Your data will then be categorized by industry type, expense category, document type (receipt, invoice, bank statement, credit note), owner, submission details, supplier, currency, tax amount, payment status, and more. Each of these fields can be easily edited and managed with a single tap.
Three different bookkeeping workspaces:
Cost data to keep track of the receipts, invoices and other expenses that your business uses to purchase goods and services.
Sales workspace to track the invoices and other financial documents that your business issues to its customers for payment.
Expense reports to collate an individual’s reimbursable payments.
REASONS TO TRY DEXT
Save hours each month by streamlining expenses, data entry, reconciliation, and categorization.
Facilitate real-time submission of expense reports by employees. Whether they are on a business trip or dining out.
Centralize all your documents on Dext (invoices, expense reports, bank statements, bills, receipt data, etc.)
As the best bookkeeping app in the market, Dext ensures your receipt data is safely stored using bank-level encryption and fully GDPR compliant
Start your 14-day free trial today!

Xero 
QuickBooks online
Sage accounting
FreeAgent
KashFlow
Gusto
Dropbox
& More

* 2023 Winner - ‘Best Accounting Cloud-Based Software Company’ (SME News - IT Awards)
* 2023 Winner - ‘Best Accounting Pre-Accounting Automation Specialists 2023’ (Acquisition International)

bluejetty:00015513:ios.description:
*** Pay once & Play forever + receive FREE updates! No ads and no IAP ***
Let’s go on a trip in the NEW My Town : Airport! Buy your tickets and SURPRISE! You’ve got a first class seat! We bet the pilot will see how special you are, and invite you into the flight control room! What’s that? He’s offering to teach you how to fly the plane? WOW! Maybe you’ll even get to check out the duty-free shop before going through security!
My Town : Airport has more than NINE new locations to explore! There are places to shop, an airport lounge and more! You can dress up your favorite characters in NEW costumes or meet new characters to add to your current My Town games!
We’ve got a few secrets in this game…what happens when you skydive? What are these new MINI GAMES? You’ll have to search for them to find out!
FEATURES
* New Characters – If you have any of the My Town dollhouse games, you can bring your characters from those games over to My Town : Airport to join you on your travels! 
* If you are just starting out with My Town, no worries! You can create your own characters inside My Town : Airport
* We update our older games every month, so please wait for the updates to connect these games to My Town : Airport
* The ability to save your progress and pick up where you left off next time you open the app
* Multi-touch Feature: Play with your friends and family on the same device!
If you can imagine it, you can make it. Everything is possible in My Town : Airport!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. Younger kids will enjoy playing together with there parents while the older kids can play alone or with a friend using our new multitouch feature!
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com or visit us on the MY TOWN Facebook page and twitter!

bluejetty:00119156:ios.description:
Genius Sign is the best app to sign, date, and annotate your documents.
“Genius Sign shaved off about 30 min of my daily routine.” – Jane D., realtor
“I wish I had known about this app before” – Mike C., business owner.
Have you ever had to print a contract you received by email, to be able to sign it and scan it before sending it back? Well, Genius Sign is now going to save you a lot of time, trouble, and paper.
With Genius Sign, import any document, insert your signature, some text, the date, and export it wherever you need to.
To sign, draw your signature on the screen with your finger. You can also scan your actual handwritten signature with our award-winning scanning technology for a realistic rendering.
Genius Sign features two smart technologies that save you tons of time:
“Sign Here” magically detects the pages you need to sign, avoiding you to browse through the entire document.
“Auto Repeat” enables you to repeat your initials on all the pages.
Genius Sign is free to use and has no limit on the number of documents or signatures that you can manage. Should you be interested in the premium features, you can decide to upgrade to Genius Sign+.
FEATURES:
- Create and save new signatures, either by drawing or scanning them.
- Import PDF, Word or image documents.
- Insert text and date, change their format, color, style or size.
- Precisely position your annotations.
- Quickly locate the signature fields with our Sign Here feature.
- Import documents from Genius Scan, your Photos library or any cloud service.
- Export your documents by email or to other apps.
PREMIUM FEATURES:
+ Have guests sign documents without keeping their signature in the app.
+ Flatten annotations so that no one can modify them.
+ Repeat your initials on every page of a document.
+ Export to your favorite cloud service (Box, Dropbox, Evernote, FTP, Google Drive, OneDrive, OneNote, SugarSync, WebDAV).
+ Print documents with AirPrint.
+ Duplicate documents with or without their annotations, to reuse them as templates.
+ Password-protect and encrypt your PDF files.
+ Protect Genius Sign with Face ID, Touch ID, or with a passcode.
We read and reply to every support email that we receive, and we are looking forward to your feedback. Contact us at any time at support@geniussign.com.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00071495:ios.description:
Better Half: Celebrate Every Moment with Your Loved One
Are you looking for the perfect app to keep track of all your special days, from birthdays to anniversaries, right at your fingertips? How about finding the perfect message for any occasion easily? Whether it’s an apology, a sweet good morning note, or a romantic message to show your love, Better Half has you covered with over 650 unique messages across 9 categories. Everything you need to make your relationship even more memorable is just a tap away.
Features You’ll Love:
• Personalized Profile: Create a unique profile for you and your partner to celebrate your love.
• Love Tracker: Celebrate your love journey by easily tracking every special moment, from your first kiss to anniversaries and beyond. Keep a record of all the meaningful milestones that make your relationship unique, ensuring no important date is ever forgotten.
• Countdown: Set and track custom dates for events, holidays, plans, and more! Whether it’s an upcoming vacation or a special celebration, keep track of the countdown in days, weeks, months, or even hours, ensuring you’re always prepared for your important occasions.
• Smart Notifications: Get reminders for those important moments so that you can plan the perfect surprise or celebration.
• Express Your Love: Send heartfelt, thoughtfully crafted messages filled with beautiful words, designed to make your partner feel deeply cherished, appreciated, and truly special in every way.
• Horoscope Compatibility: Understand how your zodiac signs align in different aspects of your relationship, from communication and sexuality to common interests.
• Apple Watch Integration: Stay connected with your love on the go by tracking your special dates right from your wrist.
• iPhone Home Screen Widget/Today’s Extension Widget: Quickly check your love milestones right from your home screen!
• iMessage Ready: Send sweet, romantic, funny, and more messages across various categories via iMessage directly from the app.
Message Categories to Make Every Moment Memorable:
• Love
• Yearning
• Funny
• Birthday
• Anniversary
• Quotes
• Apologies
• Good Morning
• Good Night
Why Better Half?
Whether you’re celebrating a first date or a 10th anniversary, Better Half has everything you need to make those moments unforgettable with ease. Download now, and make every day with your loved one even more special.
No internet? No problem! Enjoy full functionality offline.
Have suggestions for us? We’d love to hear from you! Reach out via email at info@mobilegion.com.tr

bluejetty:00122128:ios.name: Sueca Multiplayer Game
bluejetty:00122128:ios.summary: Sueca is a thrilling point-trick game that has captured the hearts of players in several countries including Portugal, Brazil, Angola, Macao, Mozambique, Nagasaki, and Goa. It's a team-based multiplayer game for four players, with each team
bluejetty:00122128:ios.description:
Sueca is a thrilling point-trick game that has captured the hearts of players in several countries including Portugal, Brazil, Angola, Macao, Mozambique, Nagasaki, and Goa. It's a team-based multiplayer game for four players, with each team consisting of two players.
The goal of Sueca is to capture as many tricks as possible, using a deck of 40 cards without the 8's, 9's, and 10's. The cards are ranked from highest to lowest in the following order: Ace, 7, King (K), Jack (J), Queen (Q), 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. The cards are assigned a specific point value, with the Ace being the highest at 11 points, followed by 7 at 10 points (known as "manilha" in Portuguese), K at 4 points, J at 3 points, Q at 2 points, and the rest of the cards at 0 points.
In Sueca, the player who wins a trick takes the total value of the cards in that trick. The highest card in the trump suit always wins.
For players seeking a similar experience, Bisca is also available in this app. It's a two-player variant of Sueca, with similar rules and gameplay.
Whether you're a seasoned player or a newbie, you can play Sueca online with friends and family on your mobile phone or tablet, with no bots allowed! Experience the excitement of playing against real people and hone your Sueca skills.
Terms and conditions of use: https://conectagames.com/terms_policies/

bluejetty:00116767:ios.summary:
Dropped your phone in water or noticed muffled sound from your speakers?
 Water Eject: Speaker Clean helps restore clear audio by safely removing trapped water and moisture from your device’s speakers using specially designed sound frequen
bluejetty:00116767:ios.description:
Dropped your phone in water or noticed muffled sound from your speakers?
 Water Eject: Speaker Clean helps restore clear audio by safely removing trapped water and moisture from your device’s speakers using specially designed sound frequencies.
The app generates precise audio waves that vibrate the speaker membrane. These vibrations help push out water droplets stuck inside the speaker grill, improving volume and sound clarity after water exposure. It’s a simple and effective solution for low volume, distorted audio, or muffled sound issues.
In addition, the built-in decibel (dB) meter allows you to measure ambient noise levels and check your speaker output easily.
How Water Eject Works
Water Eject uses optimized sound frequencies to create controlled vibrations inside the speaker.
 These vibrations help force out water and moisture that may remain after exposure to rain, spills, or accidental drops.
After cleaning, you can use the speaker test and decibel meter to check sound performance and output levels.
Key Features
• Water Eject Mode – Remove water from speakers using optimized sound waves
 • Speaker Cleaning Sounds – Multiple frequency options for different situations
 • Restore Sound Clarity – Reduce muffled and distorted audio
 • Decibel (dB) Meter – Measure ambient sound and speaker output levels
 • Speaker Test – Check speaker performance after cleaning
 • Quick & Easy to Use – One-tap operation with fast results
 • Works with Most Devices – Compatible with devices that have external speakers
When Should You Use It?
• After dropping your phone in water
 • When speaker sound becomes low or unclear
 • After rain, liquid spills, or moisture exposure
 • To test speaker performance
 • To measure environmental noise levels
Auto-Renewable Subscription Terms:
•⁠ ⁠Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase.
•⁠ ⁠Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
•⁠ ⁠Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
•⁠ ⁠You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00120290:ios.name: Car Games For Toddlers FULL
bluejetty:00120290:ios.summary:
*Full Version- no additional purchases required*
Vehicles are everywhere you look, and if you want to know about all the different cars, trucks, boats, and planes then it’s time for some vehicle fun with the Car Games for Toddlers Full App
bluejetty:00120290:ios.description:
*Full Version- no additional purchases required*
Vehicles are everywhere you look, and if you want to know about all the different cars, trucks, boats, and planes then it’s time for some vehicle fun with the Car Games for Toddlers Full App! This educational and entertaining app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. With over 40 vehicle flashcards including the sound the vehicle makes, and an ABC book with cool facts, this app will get everyone thrilled to learn about transportation! 
Easy Driving Games
Hop into a vehicle and have a blast driving and jumping! With 6 different vehicles including a race car, tractor, mail truck, construction truck, school bus and a car that drives in the night there is tons of fun for little drivers. And the best part is each vehicle is collecting different educational items as they drive which encourages learning through play! For example the race car collects numbers and when you collect all 50 the reward is counting along from 1 to 50, and the tractor collects shapes on the farm and when you collect them all you can tap and hear all the names of the shapes. And of course there is the alphabet also, when the dump truck drives he collects letters and when you collect them all you get to say the ABC's. It's an interactive and fun way to learn shapes, numbers, and the alphabet!
Vehicle Flashcards
If you love vehicles and transportation then delve into the vehicle sounds flashcards! With over 40 different interactive flashcards you’ll learn about cars, trucks, and all other modes of transport including a hot air balloon and a spaceship. And not only will you hear the name you will also hear the sound each vehicle makes, so it’s more enriching and fun! 
ABC Transportation Book
This entertaining and educational ABC book is sure to delight all vehicle lovers, and everyone that wants to know more about transportation! Each interactive page features a letter so you will hear the sound of the letter and the word it starts with. Studies have shown that this kind of associated letter recognition is the key to starting to read and essential for learning the ABC’s. The last page of the book features the entire alphabet to further enhance letter recognition, and it also has the traditional ABC song as well!
And along with learning the alphabet each of the 26 vehicles also have a fact that you tap to hear. These facts are very interesting and informative, and will keep you interested with each vehicle. It’s a fun and easy way to learn more about transportation and vehicles! 
Beep your horn and sound the sirens of fun when you delve into the Car Games for Toddlers Full App, where learning through play encourages everyone to have fun with flashcards while sharpening their knowledge about vehicles and transportation!

Research: Scan files to unlock powerful new technologies via the research tree. There you will find game-changing nodes, innovative systems, and scientific milestones, all critical for achieving your ultimate goal.

bluejetty:00123003:ios.description:
Neteller is your digital wallet for fast payments and money transfers. Quick, easy to use and secure, your Neteller digital wallet lets you send money and receive money without the need for a bank account.
Download the Neteller app today and look forward to*:
· Secure transactions at thousands of websites.
· A prepaid card to pay in-store and withdraw cash.
· Loyalty points you can exchange for funds in your account.
Want to learn more? Here’s why thousands send money with NETELLER every day…
SECURE PAYMENT
· Enjoy quick money transfers to and from the world’s leading gaming and trading sites.
· Pay without sharing card numbers and personal information.
· Fund your account by card, bank transfer, or local payment options.
· Withdraw funds directly from your NETELLER digital wallet to your bank account.
FAST MONEY TRANSFER
· Transfer money globally in 40+ currencies, including the US dollar, Brazilian real and Indian rupee.
· Send money to an email address or phone number. 
· Send money abroad with great exchange rates.
· Request and receive money easily.
PREPAID CARD
· Pay online, spend in-store, or withdraw cash with the Net+ Prepaid Mastercard®.
· Add your card to the Apple Wallet® to make fast payments with a tap of your phone.
· Get a virtual card for free and pay securely online.
· No credit check needed.
CRYPTO
Don’t invest unless you’re prepared to lose all the money you invest. This is a high-risk investment and you should not expect to be protected if something goes wrong. Take two minutes to learn more at www.neteller.com/cryptocurrency-risk-statement/.
· Trade Bitcoin, Ethereum and more than 30 other cryptocurrencies. 
· Track price movements with an easy-to-use dashboard.
· Take advantage of helpful features like crypto price alerts and automated orders.
· Withdraw your funds to crypto by sending them directly to a cryptocurrency address.
LOYALTY REWARDS
· Join the Knect loyalty program and earn points when you pay.
· Exchange your points for money in your account.
· Look out for exciting gaming and forex offers exclusive to NETELLER customers.
CURRENCY CONVERSION
· Use our currency converter to check rates and exchange one currency into another.
· Hold a balance in multiple currencies at the same time.
PROTECTING YOUR MONEY
· The NETELLER digital wallet is trusted by thousands of customers around the world. 
· Security features such as two-factor authentication and secure socket layer (SSL) encryption help to keep your money transfers safe.
*Some features are subject to jurisdictional limitations and may be accessible only in select territories.
NETELLER’s offering of and support to the Net+ Prepaid Mastercard® Program is limited to residents of the European Economic Area and UK. 
Visit www.neteller.com to review the Cryptocurrency Terms of Use and Cryptocurrency Risk Statement.

Wanna live in your dream house? Help princesses restore their island after a storm, merge items, collect materials, craft furniture, and design your perfect home.

Grow crops and collect ingredients to cook dishes that boost your progress.
Join alliances, compete in events, and play with friends worldwide.
Frequent events and updates keep the island fresh and exciting.

- "Une application parfaite, qui nous aide à apprendre le code sans avoir recours à un professeur."
- "J'ai obtenu mon code en seulement 7 jours grâce à cette application."

bluejetty:00185101:ios.description:
Have you been dreaming of getting a cat? Your dream is coming true. Get a cat right now.
Meet your new virtual friend that looks and feels like a real cat. Just look at these cute eyes and listen to the happy purr-purr. It will melt your heart and make your day. Play with your kitty, give it the most delicious yummies, take it for a walk, and have fun all day long. Love your cat, and it will love you back.
My Cat features will bring your pet-owning experience to a whole new level:
AUGMENTED REALITY
Use your smartphone camera, and the kitty will appear in your house.
FUNNY MEMORIES
Take cute photos of your virtual cat and share them with friends or show off on social media.
EXTRA ITEMS
Take care of your kitty, play with it, and enjoy extra items as a reward.
SO REAL
Kitty reacts to your every touch. Stroke it or scratch its cute little nose with your finger. It is so easy to turn on your kitty’s purring engine.
MORE FUN
While your kitty is asleep or occupied with some important cat business, you can set new records in an exciting Summer Job merge game with more than 400 levels or play fun mini-games.
It is your time to get a cat. Give it all your love, and you will have the most faithful fluffy friend ever. 
Subscription options:
Weekly Membership offers weekly subscription after a 3-day free trial for unlocking all content and features.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://docs.appsyoulove.com/policies/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://docs.appsyoulove.com/policies/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00016763:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00016763:ios.description:
Single Player:
De-stress with a relaxing word game all to yourself. We’ve added hundreds of non-timed puzzles and new daily challenges so the fun never has to end! Complete levels on the adventure map one-by-one, play all the daily challenges in a given month to earn badges, or try Quick Play to jump right into your favorite difficulty mode. Some of our top players have reached up to level 300, how far can you get? 
Multiplayer:
Why play against one person in a turn when you can play against thousands at once? Wordament® is a real-time continuous word tournament. Players compete on the same board with everyone at once. Rounds offer challenges such as two- and three-letter tiles, themed words, speed rounds and more. You can be a champion in many ways: find the most words possible, earn the best score, find the longest words, best your Frenemies, or beat your top score. How you win is up to you.
Wordament tracks your progress by maintaining rich statistics about your gameplay including your best word found, total score, best word count, first place finishes and more. Leaderboards show you who's rocking it for the day, hour and overall. Climb the ranks and earn achievements and bragging rights along the way. Will you be our next champion?
Xbox Live Support:
Sign in with your Microsoft account to earn Xbox Live achievements and save your progress in the cloud across all your Apple devices.
You can now get the Microsoft Wordament Premium Subscription for $1.99 per Month or $9.99 per Year. With Premium Subscription you get these great features:
• No Advertisements
• More coins for completing Daily Challenges
• Double experience points in all game modes
• NOTE: this will not grant Premium on other platforms
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account on confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews monthly or annually depending on the subscription type purchased. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period ($1.99 monthly, or $9.99 annually, depending on the subscription type purchased). You can turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. If auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period, you will not be charged for the next period. All cancellations will take effect at the end of the current period.
For more information visit: https://aka.ms/wordamentiossupport/

All other trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Acceptance of Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statement are required to play. (https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/servicesagreement, https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/privacy/privacystatement) Microsoft account registration required for cross-platform play. Game offers in-app purchases. Persistent internet connection required. Features, online services and system requirements may vary by country and are subject to change or retirement over time.

bluejetty:00149413:ios.description:
WISHEW is the social network for who you’re becoming.
Most social platforms are built around what gets attention. WISHEW is built around where you’re going.
Start with a Goal — something you want to achieve, build, change, or become. Put it out there, honestly, and share your Moves along the way: the small moments of Progress, the Milestones that matter, and the Obstacles that can feel like anything but progress.
Your Moves build a Journey. Not a feed of finished moments, but a living, unfiltered record of who you’re becoming — one Move at a time. A Journey the community can follow, support, and help you move forward through.
Need something along the way? Add to your Move what you’re looking for — advice, skills, motivation, contacts, or anything that could help you get unstuck and take the next step.
And when you can help someone else, step in. Share what you know, offer support, open a door. Every bit of help that moves someone forward earns you Reputation Points — a credibility system built on what you actually do for other people, not on how many followers you have.
Download WISHEW and make your next Move.

bluejetty:00162272:ios.name: PewPee: Music Player Offline
bluejetty:00162272:ios.summary: FEATURE-RICH: PewPee has a lot of useful features. Download music; create your own playlists; add playlists, albums, songs, artists to your library; request music; follow friends; check new releases, top charts, popular playlists, artists;
bluejetty:00162272:ios.description:
FEATURE-RICH: PewPee has a lot of useful features. Download music; create your own playlists; add playlists, albums, songs, artists to your library; request music; follow friends; check new releases, top charts, popular playlists, artists; find music by genres; listen in a shuffle mode; set up a sleep timer AND SO ON!
ZERO ADS: Yeah, we don’t have any ads.
MILLIONS OF SONGS: We have a huge music catalogue including more than 150 million songs from YouTube too.
LYRICS: It’s always easier to jam out to your latest favorite song when you know the words. See the lyrics of many of your favorite tracks as they’re sung right from the player or by tapping on View Lyrics in the context menu of a song.
FEED: Just bring your friends and start sharing your activity with each other. You can not only see the updates of your friends but also open new songs for yourself or maybe a new taste in music.
IMPORT YOUR MUSIC: PewPee delivers its own library to you (and we increase the number of songs every day). However, if you can’t find something you want, with the subscription you are able to import any music (MP3, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, etc.) from your device or use cloud services such as Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.
PRIVACY: We don’t provide your data to third-party services. We only store the data that PewPee needs to function as a feature-rich music streaming service.
SIMPLE: We believe that apps must have a large number of features and save simplicity in design. PewPee takes care to keep the UI clean and good looking.
MORE: PewPee is actively continuing to make the service better and better. We have big plans to improve and create an array of features. Stay tuned by following us on social networks.
Terms of Service: https://pewpee.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pewpee.com/privacy
Telegram: @pewpee_music
Twitter: @PewPeeMusic
Instagram: @pewpee.music

bluejetty:00017710:ios.description:
Avec notre application mobile CFG Bank, nous vous proposons une expérience nouvelle totalement orientée client pour vous faciliter la banque au quotidien
Une application, toujours à portée de main, pour gérer tous vos comptes de manière totalement sécurisée, en toute autonomie et en toute simplicité 24h/24 & 7j/7
Dorénavant connectez-vous en quelques secondes grâce à votre empreinte digitale !
► VOS COMPTES : Toutes les informations utiles sur vos comptes en un coup d’œil !
•Consultez le solde de vos comptes et le solde disponible tenant compte des opérations en cours
•Accédez au relevé détaillé et clair de vos comptes avec la possibilité de filtrage
•Visualisez l’image de tous vos chèques émis ou encaissés
•Suivez vos portefeuilles d’avoir détaillés et valorisés en temps réel
•Gérez plusieurs comptes (compte courant, compte sur carnet, …) à travers un accès unique
•Accédez et partagez votre RIB
► VOS DEPENSES : Une fonctionnalité exclusive CFG Bank pour le suivi et la gestion de vos finances personnelles !
•Pré-catégorisation automatique de vos dépenses et de vos revenus identifiables 
•Catégorisation manuelle facilitée de vos dépenses en espèces ou par chèques
•Suivez et analysez vos habitudes de dépenses avec des graphiques de répartition 
•Accédez au relevé des opérations d’une catégorie de dépense
► VOS OPERATIONS : Vos virements, vos mises à disposition, vos paiements de factures et votre e-dotation facilités !
•Gérez les bénéficiaires de vos virements en temps réel
•Effectuez vos virements, programmer vos virements permanents et suivez leur exécution
•Bénéficier de virements instantanés
•Effectuez vos mises à disposition sur le canal de votre choix (agence ou GAB)
•Gérez facilement vos facturiers (télécom, impôts, eau & électricité, …) et payez vos factures
•Activez votre dotation touristique depuis l’appli 7j/7
► VOS CARTES : Pilotez vos cartes en toute autonomie, simplicité et temps réel !
•Augmentez temporairement les plafonds avec prise en compte immédiate
•Modifiez les plafonds de paiement et de retrait 
•Désactivez et réactivez, instantanément, votre carte pour bloquer toute opération de retrait ou de paiement
•Autorisez ou bloquez les paiements sur Internet pour plus de sécurité
•Visualisez les plafonds et les encours de votre carte
•Récupérez votre code PIN en un clic
•Faites opposition sur votre carte en cas de perte ou de vol
•Visualisez les opérations de paiement et de retrait avec votre carte
•Gérez simplement votre e-dotation et suivez votre solde
► VOS CREDITS : Suivez vos engagements !
•Accédez aux caractéristiques de votre crédit immobilier (taux du crédit, taux d’assurance, montant de l’échéance, …) et suivez l’avancement de son remboursement 
•Consultez votre potentiel de crédit lombard ou de découvert et faites une demande en ligne à votre conseiller
► VOTRE CONSEILLER : Accessible à tout moment !
•Accédez à la carte de visite de votre conseiller attitré
•Echangez avec votre conseiller au travers de la messagerie sécurisée intégrée
► ENCORE PLUS DE SERVICES : Plus de services pour vous faciliter la banque !
•Commandez vos chéquiers
•Géolocalisez vos agences CFG Bank et vos GAB
•Consultez toutes les notifications transmises
•Restez informés des nouveautés et des produits de votre banque
► UNE CONNEXION FACILITEE ET SECURISEE : Enregistrez-vous avec vos identifiants habituels Internet et définissez un code confidentiel qui facilitera votre accès.
Vous n’êtes pas client CFG Bank, rendez-vous sur la rubrique «devenir client» de notre site pour ouvrir un compte !
En cas de difficulté ou pour toute suggestion, contactez-nous sur : AppMobile@cfgbank.com

bluejetty:00187689:ios.description:
Mentorist is an AI mentor that turns the best books on leadership and personal growth into one practical step you can take today.
You've read the books. You've highlighted the good parts. And on Monday morning you walk into the same meeting the same way as last week. Mentorist closes the gap between knowing and doing.
HOW IT WORKS
• Start with a one-minute conversation. Tell your mentor whether you lead people, what's weighing on you right now and how much time you have on a normal day.
• Get one step for today. Your mentor picks a concrete action from a named book, explains why it fits your situation and keeps it small enough for a busy day.
• Ask about your real situation. A difficult 1:1, feedback you keep putting off, a new team, a decision you're stuck on. Your mentor answers with ideas from the books and tells you where each one comes from.
• Your mentor keeps your context. Your goals, the tone you prefer and the notes you write on insights shape every answer, so you don't start from zero each time.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• An AI mentor you can talk to any time, grounded in 700+ books
• A daily step matched to your goal, from authors like James Clear, Brené Brown, Simon Sinek, Kim Scott and Cal Newport
• Curated collections such as First 90 Days as a Manager, Delegation and Feedback, Deep Focus and Calm the Noise
• Every insight in text and audio: read at lunch, listen on your commute
• Notes on any insight, which your mentor takes into account
• Light and dark mode
ESPECIALLY USEFUL IF YOU LEAD PEOPLE
New managers, team leads and founders get steps for 1:1s, feedback, delegation and difficult conversations. Not leading a team? Mentorist works just as well for focus, habits, confidence and career growth.
NOT ANOTHER SUMMARY APP
Summary apps help you read faster. Mentorist assumes the problem isn't too little knowledge but too little action. You get one thing to do, not fifteen more minutes to read.
WHAT USERS SAY
"I have been looking for an app like this for ages! I'm an avid reader and implementer of business management books and this app has digested everything for me and put it into an actionable format. I have only been using the app for 10 days, but I am already noticing a shift in mindset and daily practices." – DCBKK2017, Business Manager
JOIN 1.3 MILLION PEOPLE WHO ACT ON WHAT THEY READ
Rated 4.5 on the App Store, with over 2.6 million steps completed. Your mentor is ready whenever you are.
SUBSCRIPTION
Some features require a Mentorist subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.
Terms of Use: https://www.mentorist.app/termsandconditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.mentorist.app/termsandconditions/#privacy
License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Ideas or questions? Write to support@mentorist.app. We read every message.

bluejetty:00130959:ios.description:
Do you Love playing modern robot wars with big battle mech machines? You should definitely try this robot war game with unlimited transformation in this robot transforming game. 
Action, adventure and thrill; this game will never disappoint you. A vast selection of robot warriors in different battle modes will boost your playing experience.
There are variety of robot parts are avaialable and you can make robot of your choice in this robot game with multiple robot transformations, you can choose your battle machines. You can choose the guns of your choice in this robot battle games and customise the guns according to your choice to feel the unique experience of shooting in this robot game.
Robot War: The Ultimate Robot Simulator" is a cutting-edge open-world robot game that immerses players in a thrilling robot war. Players take control of a variety of unique robots, each with their own special abilities and weapons. From bus robots that can transform into monster trucks to bee robots that can fly, there is something for every player.
The game features a robust robot simulator that allows players to fully customize their robots with a wide range of weapons and upgrades. Players can choose from a variety of robot types, including robot cars and transforming robots, to create the ultimate war machine. Each robot has its own strengths and weaknesses, and players must strategize and adapt to different situations in order to be successful in battle.
The open-world game play allows players to explore and battle across a vast and varied landscape. From city streets to rugged mountains, players must use their robots' abilities to navigate and overcome obstacles in order to defeat their enemies. Players can also come across other robots in the open world, and they can choose to battle them or ally with them. The open world also provides players with a wide range of resources to scavenge, that they can use to upgrade their robots.
The game also features a variety of different game modes, including robot fights, robot shootouts, and robot wars. Players can compete in intense one-on-one battles or join together to take on massive enemy hordes in epic robot wars. The game has a multiplayer mode as well, players can join or create a team and compete with other players from around the world in epic robot wars. The game also has a leaderboard where players can track their progress and compete with other players globally.
The game's cutting-edge graphics and realistic physics engine create an unparalleled sense of immersion, making players feel like they are truly in the middle of a robot war. Players can feel the impact of every hit, see the sparks fly as robots collide, and hear the roar of the engines. The game also features an adaptive AI that reacts to the player's actions, making the gameplay challenging and unpredictable.
In "Robot War: The Ultimate Robot Simulator", players can also create their own robots and share them with the community. The game has a built-in editor that allows players to design their robots, and they can share them with other players, who can then use them in their own battles. This adds an extra layer of depth to the game, as players can experiment with different designs and strategies to come up with the ultimate robot.

The open-world game play allows players to explore and battle across a vast and varied landscape. From city streets to rugged mountains, players must use their robots' abilities to navigate and overcome obstacles in order to defeat their enemies. Players can also come across other robots in the open world, and they can choose to battle them or ally with them. The open world also provides players with a wide range of resources to scavenge, that they can use to upgrade their robots.

The game also features a variety of different game modes, including robot fights, robot shootouts, and robot wars. Players can compete in intense one-on-one battles or join together to take on massive enemy hordes in epic robot wars. The game has a multiplayer mode as well, players can join or create a team and compete with other players from around the world in epic robot wars. The game also has a leaderboard where players can track their progress and compete with other players globally.

The game's cutting-edge graphics and realistic physics engine create an unparalleled sense of immersion, making players feel like they are truly in the middle of a robot war. Players can feel the impact of every hit, see the sparks fly as robots collide, and hear the roar of the engines. The game also features an adaptive AI that reacts to the player's actions, making the gameplay challenging and unpredictable.

In "Robot War: The Ultimate Robot Simulator", players can also create their own robots and share them with the community. The game has a built-in editor that allows players to design their robots, and they can share them with other players, who can then use them in their own battles. This adds an extra layer of depth to the game, as players can experiment with different designs and strategies to come up with the ultimate robot.

bluejetty:00135779:ios.summary:
Welcome to the Ultimate Police Chase Experience!
Step into the shoes of a fearless law enforcer in this action-packed open-world game, where crime never sleeps and the chase is always on. Explore a vast, living city teeming with dangerous
bluejetty:00135779:ios.description:
Welcome to the Ultimate Police Chase Experience!
Step into the shoes of a fearless law enforcer in this action-packed open-world game, where crime never sleeps and the chase is always on. Explore a vast, living city teeming with dangerous gangsters, high-speed pursuits, and intense police-versus-criminal confrontations. This immersive urban playground is the most detailed and dynamic digital city you’ve ever seen, designed to deliver endless thrills and adrenaline-pumping moments.
Dive Into a City of Crime and Chaos
This city is your battlefield — a sprawling metropolis plagued by notorious gangs and ongoing turf wars. Danger lurks around every corner, and every chase is a fight for justice. From dark alleyways to bustling downtown streets, navigate through a highly interactive environment where your every move matters. With hundreds of vehicles at your disposal, ranging from sleek sports cars to powerful tanks, plus helicopters that soar above, you’ll experience the freedom to explore and control the city like never before.
Master a Variety of Vehicles and Weapons
Choose your ride and your arsenal wisely. This game boasts an impressive collection of vehicles including cars, motorcycles, helicopters, tanks, and boats — each with smooth, intuitive controls that make every chase and escape thrilling. Equip yourself with a diverse range of weapons featuring realistic sounds and effects to take down criminals efficiently and stylishly. Whether you prefer high-speed car chases, tactical helicopter interceptions, or heavy artillery on tanks, your options are limitless.
Engaging Story-Driven Missions
The game combines open-world exploration with a gripping narrative that pits you against ruthless criminals in a series of daring story missions. Each mission is carefully crafted to challenge your driving skills, shooting accuracy, and strategic thinking. Uncover the secrets behind the gang wars and bring justice to the streets by completing high-stakes pursuits, undercover operations, and explosive confrontations.
Stunning Visuals and Immersive Sound
Immerse yourself in a fully realized 3D police city environment with detailed graphics and smooth animations. The vibrant cityscape is brought to life with dynamic weather effects, realistic traffic patterns, and day-night cycles that affect gameplay. High-quality background music and ambient sounds intensify the atmosphere, making every chase and encounter feel cinematic.
Key Features:
Massive open-world city: A living, breathing metropolis filled with missions, gangsters, and random events.
Diverse vehicle lineup: Drive cars, bikes, helicopters, tanks, and boats with realistic physics and controls.
Wide arsenal: Multiple weapons with unique firing sounds and effects for tactical combat.
Dynamic police chases: High-speed pursuits with drifting, evasive maneuvers, and strategic tactics.
Story-driven gameplay: Exciting missions that reveal the dark underbelly of the city’s criminal underworld.
Realistic environments: Fully 3D city with day/night cycle, weather effects, and authentic urban sounds.
Immersive audio: Action-packed soundtrack and realistic sound effects enhance gameplay intensity.
Customizable gameplay: Upgrade vehicles and weapons to suit your playstyle.
Are you ready to take on the challenge? Download now and become the ultimate police enforcer in this thrilling open-world crime simulator. Chase down criminals, dominate the streets, and bring order to the chaos!

Log every beer you try and turn it into your beer passport.
YOUR BEER LIST
• Over 33,000 beers from 110 countries, with instant search that works offline.
• Scan the label and the app finds the beer in seconds.

CHECK-INS
• Log where you had it, how it was served and what it tasted like.
YOUR YEAR IN BEER
• Every December, your year in review, ready to share.
PREMIUM

bluejetty:00184372:ios.description:
Make the move towards digital banking. 
The ABN AMRO app is for everyone, beginners and professionals alike. Children are able to use the app, and business clients can easily use it to do lots of their banking. Thanks to the app, you can always see all your everyday banking affairs at a glance and you can bank quickly and securely, wherever you are. 
Get started with ABN AMRO too. Open a personal account in the app - it’s a breeze! You can even open a current account in the app using your international passport in many cases. No need to go to a branch.
You can do more with the app than you may know, like:
• log in to Internet Banking and confirm orders securely there
• get connected immediately with the right customer service representative
• change your personal details and settings
• block or unblock your debit card or request a replacement
• manage your digital debit cards
• send a Tikkie payment request
And of course you can also:
• do your banking right in the app and pay using iDEAL
• view your transactions, balance and bank accounts
• transfer money and schedule payment orders
• get notifications about deposits, withdrawals and direct debit transactions
• make investments, add to your savings, and view and take out a mortgage or insurance
• add accounts held at other banks to your overview
Doing your banking using the ABN AMRO app for the first time
If you already have a personal or business ABN AMRO current account, you can start using the app right away. 
Secure banking
Once you’re logged in to the app, you can confirm transactions using the 5-digit ID code, and often with your fingerprint or Face ID. Be sure to keep your personal ID code secret. Just like your PIN it’s meant for you alone. Also only register your own fingerprint or face on your device. You can read more about secure mobile banking at abnamro.nl/veiligmb.

bluejetty:00119857:ios.summary:

Besides simulating space flig
bluejetty:00119857:ios.description:
Advanced Space Flight is a realistic space simulator for interplanetary and interstellar travel. It is the only space simulator available that takes into account relativistic effects during interstellar flight.
Besides simulating space flight, this app can also be used as a planetarium, with all known planets shown in real scale with their accurate keplerian orbits. It can also be used as a star chart and exoplanet explorer, showing all solar systems with confirmed exoplanets within 50 light years from the Sun.
This is the only app where you can get a sense of the true scale of the Universe, zooming out through thousands of galaxies and galaxy clusters until you see the entire observable universe in your screen.
Locations with full access:
- All inner planets in the Solar System and its moons: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Moon, Mars, Phobos, Deimos, Ceres
- Nearby star systems: Proxima Centauri, Alpha Centauri, Sirius, Epsilon Eridani
Locations with partial access:
- All solar system planets plus 5 dwarf planets.
- All confirmed exoplanetary solar systems within 50 light years.
- Experience the full scale of the Universe: you can zoom out from a few meters to billions of light years, until you see the entire observable universe in your screen.
Flight Modes:
- Realistic Flight: Travel using optimised trajectories, calculated based on the orbital parameters of the origin and destination planets to minimise fuel usage. These are the kind of trajectories that would be used in a real space mission.
- Free Flight: Take manual control of a spaceship in space, activating the engines as you see fit to achieve your goals.
Spaceships:
Advanced Space Flight features several spacecraft, but only one in available in this free version:
- Space Shuttle (Chemical Rocket): Designed in 1968-1972 y NASA and North American Rockwell. It has been in service from 1981 to 2011, making it the most successful reusable spacecraft ever built.
- Falcon Heavy (Chemical Rocket): Designed and manufactured by SpaceX, made its first flight in 2018.
- Nuclear Ferry (Nuclear Thermal Rocket): Designed in 1964 by Ling-Temco-Vought Inc.
- Lewis Ion Rocket (Ion Drive): Designed in a 1965 study by the Lewis Research Center.
Artificial Satellites:
Several human-made satellites are present in the app:
- Sputnik 1
- Hubble Space Telecope
- Internation Space Station
- Kepler Space Observatory
- Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS)
- James Webb Space Telescope
Join our discord community for discussions or suggestions about the app:
https://discord.gg/guHq8gAjpu
You can also contact me by email if you have any complaint or suggestion.

bluejetty:00159797:ios.description:
Play puzzles and brain-teasers in adventure games! In this one of the top hidden object games, your goal is to find visual clue and suspects needed to become a hero!
You're an F.B.I.S.K. detective who investigates particularly serious crimes connected with serial killers. Audrey Parker, a police officer, tells you that there is a serial killer in the city: several corpses wrapped in plaster were found recently and all of them were in the form of sculptures. The main suspect is Chad Hill whose sculpture gallery was burned and the truth about the arson is being concealed for it's connected with the local authorities and, of course, money. Now he wants to avenge it. Will you manage to break off the chain of vengeance murders and stop Chad, or not?

· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE WALLPAPERS, MUSIC, VIDEOS, AND CONCEPT ART!
Our hidden object games for iPhone & iPad have tons of bonus content for you to enjoy! More suspects need to be found!
· REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE HOPS AND MINI-GAMES AND EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Replay your favorite search & find games to earn as many achievements as you can to brag to your friends!

Stuck on any seek & find games? No problem - our built-in walkthrough will always help you to!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00064137:ios.name: SoundHound∞ - Music Discovery
bluejetty:00064137:ios.summary: Hey, what song is that? SoundHound makes it simple to identify music playing around you. Whether you’re in the car or out and about — open the app, hit the big orange SoundHound button, let your phone listen for a few seconds, and we’ll tel
bluejetty:00064137:ios.description:
Hey, what song is that? SoundHound makes it simple to identify music playing around you. Whether you’re in the car or out and about — open the app, hit the big orange SoundHound button, let your phone listen for a few seconds, and we’ll tell you exactly what’s playing! It's been called pure magic — and with 300M+ downloads and billions of songs discovered — we tend to agree.
SoundHound comes equipped with “Hey SoundHound…”, an incredibly powerful way to interact with the app using your voice. “Hey SoundHound…” can help you navigate the app, activate the orange button, and playback songs hands-free. Simply say ‘Hey SoundHound...’ from any screen and say a command!
Discovering new music is only half the fun of SoundHound. We’re music lovers too, so we’ve created an incredible experience for you to relive your discoveries with our music player. Connect your Apple Music or Spotify account to listen, build playlists, explore music across genres, and find new favorites - all with real-time, karaoke-style lyrics using LiveLyrics®. Don’t have an Apple Music or Spotify subscription? No sweat, we have you covered with our free, built-in YouTube player. This is your music journey.
Curious to know more? Here’s everything you need to know!
DISCOVER
• Tap the SoundHound button in the app, in the notification center widget, or via 3D touch on the app icon to discover music playing around you! We’ll let you know everything about the song including title, artist, album, and lyrics!
• Have a song stuck in your head? Press the SoundHound button, sing or hum the tune, and we’ll do the rest!
• Keep track of all your discoveries in your own personal history
• Use the Apple Watch app to quickly identify music and sing-along with LiveLyrics. Users with a cellular-enabled Apple Watch can use the app without being connected to an iPhone
PLAY
• Listen to songs and view lyrics in our free, built-in YouTube player
• Simply say ‘Hey SoundHound....’ from any screen or tap the microphone on the play page. Once you see the listening panel, you can follow up with commands including:
App Navigation: ‘Hey SoundHound… Show me my discoveries’
Help/Questions: ‘Hey SoundHound… Show me what I can say’
Music Discovery: ‘Hey SoundHound… What’s that song?’
Song Playback: ‘Hey SoundHound... Play Hello by Adele’
Lyrics Search: ‘Hey SoundHound... Show me lyrics to Castle on the Hill’
Top Charts: ‘Hey SoundHound...Play today’s top songs’
Playlists (Spotify account & registration required): ‘Hey SoundHound… Play my Discover weekly playlist on Spotify’
Add to Spotify Playlist (Spotify account & registration required): ‘Hey SoundHound… Add this song to my playlist’
CONNECT AND SHARE
• Build personalized playlists through Apple Music or Spotify (SoundHound account and music subscription required)
• Access Spotify playlists for a richer playback experience through SoundHound
• View and interact with real-time, moving lyrics for your songs with LiveLyrics
• Keep all of your discoveries synced across multiple devices
• Share your music discoveries to Facebook, Twitter, messaging services, and email!
SoundHound is powered by Houndify, an independent voice-enabled AI platform that enables natural, conversational intelligence on any product.

bluejetty:00036035:ios.description:
AI Chatbot: Ask AI Anything - Your Powerful iOS & iPadOS AI Assistant Powered by OpenAI ChatGPT GPT-5 API
AI Chatbot is a powerful and intelligent iOS & iPadOS application built using the official OpenAI ChatGPT API. It leverages state-of-the-art AI models, including GPT-5, GPT-4, and advanced multimodal capabilities, to deliver fast, accurate, and highly contextual responses. Designed for natural human like interaction, the app provides a seamless native iOS & iPadOS experience for writing, research, image generation, photo analysis, problem solving, and everyday productivity, making it a reliable all in one AI assistant for your iPhone and iPad.
Key Features:
- Smart AI Writing Assistant
Write emails, essays, blog posts, speeches, poems, lyrics, and professional documents. Improve grammar, rewrite content, brainstorm ideas, and receive intelligent follow up suggestions.
- Real-Time Web Search & Up-to-Date Answers
Research topics, verify facts, and get up to date information directly inside your chat.
- Advanced Reasoning & Problem Solving
Solve math problems, logic puzzles, coding questions, and complex assignments with clear step by step explanations.
- AI Image Generation & Editing
Create original artwork, illustrations, and designs from text prompts. Edit or transform existing images for creative projects.
- Photo Upload & Visual Analysis
Upload images to extract text, read handwritten notes, identify objects, recognize landmarks, analyze scenes, and gain detailed visual insights.
- Creative & Personalized Assistance
Generate gift ideas, greeting cards, travel itineraries, recipes from ingredients, and creative concepts tailored to your needs.
- Business Work & Everyday Help
Draft professional replies, marketing copy, business plans, social media content, and get quick productivity tips.
- Learning & Simple Explanations
 Understand complex topics, refresh knowledge, or get explanations designed for beginners students or kids.
- Multi-Language Support
Chat, write, translate, and communicate fluently in multiple languages.
- Searchable Chat History
Easily find and revisit previous conversations and AI responses.

Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase. Read our terms of service and Privacy Policy for more information.

bluejetty:00061996:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00061996:ios.description:
• Learn To Play Your Favorite Bass Lines on the Bass Guitar.
• Learn Scales and Jam to a Click/Backing Tracks. Save Riffs.
• Learn typical patterns (e.g. reggae, walking bass, hard rock).
• Highly configurable. Resizeable fretboard suitable for all devices and tablets. Choose between acoustic, fingered or slap electric guitar bass. 
• For beginners to advanced bass players, this app combines high-quality realistic bass sounds with low-latency, responsive playing.
• Use on the go as a simulator or with your Real Bass Guitar.
• With over 1 million downloads it is one of the most popular apps of Bass Guitarists.
*****Features*****
Choose between Precision Bass, Jazz Bass or Slap Bass.
5 String Bass Option
Left Handed Support.
Focus on sections of the song to master those bass lines, patterns and scales.
Adjust the speed and volume for playing along.
Highlight notes on/off to play by ear.
Adjust the width or height of the fretboard to suit your playing style or device. Go smaller to see the whole fretboard or go larger for a real life size.
*****Bass Lines*****
Over 600 Songs that cover all genres: Rock, Indie, 60s, 70s, 80s, 90s, Naughties, Modern, Latin, Classical, Film Themes, TV Themes, Traditional. The always expanding catalog of bass lines which include: 
ACDC, Aerosmith, Alice Cooper, Axel F...and more
*****Scales*****
Select a scale from the extensive list. 
Listen and watch the notes being played through highlights and then try to play it back. Check your answers. Start with just a few notes and then work up until you've mastered the notes in the scale. 
Change the position.
Repeat scales ascending or descending.
View scale patterns as a reference. 
*****Jam*****
Select the scale in which you wish to solo in. This will highlight all the right notes within the selected key on the whole fretboard. Then jam to it by aiming to play from the highlighted keys. You'll be surprised how good you'll sound just by hitting a few of the right notes! 
Record and Save your favorite jam sessions.
Play along to a click or backing track.
*****Bass Patterns*****
Learn to provide the bass in any key for any genre. Patterns include: Alternative Rock, Barrelhouse, Blues Boogie Woogie ...and more.
*****Scales Game*****
Exercises to test your knowledge of scales and view your progress over time.
***** Notes Game *****
Interactive exercise to learn the notes on the fretboard. 
Choose which strings, frets and keys to focus on.
See how you are progressing over time.
***** Learn Chords *****
Learn all the main chords including intervals and which fingers to use.

bluejetty:00062190:ios.name: Learn English Course: Articles
bluejetty:00062190:ios.summary: Learning English can feel like a journey filled with curiosity, inspiration, and small victories every day. Whether you're just beginning or picking it up again, there's always something new to explore—and it all starts with strong grammar
bluejetty:00062190:ios.description:
Learning English can feel like a journey filled with curiosity, inspiration, and small victories every day. Whether you're just beginning or picking it up again, there's always something new to explore—and it all starts with strong grammar and confidence in articles.
This app helps make sense of one of the most essential parts of English grammar: articles. It brings together clear explanations, real-world examples, and engaging practice, so you can grow your understanding naturally and enjoyably.
Explore grammar in an easy-to-follow format, enriched with examples to show how English articles work in real sentences. After each topic, test what you've learned through a variety of exercises designed to reinforce your knowledge and improve retention.
– In the grammar section, dive into explanations with 15+ types of exercises that support your understanding.
– Learn through practice by reading articles from magazines and newspapers covering various topics.
– Read books that showcase how language flows naturally and how articles are used in context.
– Review sentences from texts with missing articles and select the correct one, sharpening both recognition and usage.
Interactive exercises help you stay engaged and focused. Sentences appear on the screen with missing articles, and you choose from multiple options. An answer-checking system lets you instantly see how you're doing—turning each session into meaningful progress.
– Simple design that makes learning feel fun and relaxed
– Works perfectly for both short daily practice and longer, focused learning
– Great for studying on breaks, during travel, or in the classroom
– Suitable for anyone preparing for IELTS or TOEFL exams
– Ideal for those attending a course, using an assistant, or learning English independently
– Builds vocabulary and reading skills naturally over time
– Encourages attention to pronunciation and speaking through better grammar understanding
Whether your goal is to improve your language for work, study, or everyday use, this tool supports you along the way. By learning through articles and reading books, you not only strengthen grammar but also connect more deeply with English as a whole.
Feel confident knowing that your English is improving with every session—one article at a time, one sentence at a time.
Support: appsfenls@gmail.com
Terms of use & Privacy policy: https://apps.fenls.com/legacy.html

The National Review app delivers the best conservative writing, reporting, and analysis available anywhere. Download the app for free to sample our latest articles, podcasts, photo galleries, and more, or unlock full access, including our latest opinion content and digital issues of the magazine, with a monthly or annual subscription.
National Review App Subscription Features:
GREATER ACCESS: Access all app content, including all the latest news and commentary found on the National Review website.
MAGAZINE: Access the National Review magazine and archives (online and downloadable PDF).
MEDIA: Access the latest National Review podcasts, photo galleries, and videos.
Please note: An app subscription does not include National Review website access, article commenting privileges, access to the NRPLUS Facebook group, or exclusive invitations to National Review conference calls and events. For access to all these features, you can purchase an NRPLUS subscription directly through the National Review website.
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
Full app access to all content is only available with an app subscription purchase or by logging into the app using NRPLUS credentials.
National Review App Subscription Pricing:
• 1 Month - USD 9.99*
• 1 Year/Annual - USD 99.99*
* For non-US app stores, the equivalent currency charges will apply.
*These subscriptions are not NRPLUS memberships, which can only be purchased through the National Review website.
Additional Subscription Information:
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Settings on their phone after purchase.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Privacy Policy - https://www.nationalreview.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use - https://www.nationalreview.com/terms-of-service/
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00166805:android.description:
Get the financial help you need today. We make getting an online loan fast and easy as possible in Dubai, UAE. Apply once and borrow cash with confidence. Pay it off and lend again as often as you need to.
OUR LOAN REQUEST FEATURE.
- Easy loan application process — takes less than 5 minutes.
- Quick and easy approval process.
- Paperless application process on your mobile phone.
- No credit history required.
- Fast credit limit growth — increases every time you repay on time.
HOW IT WORKS
• Easy Sign up
 Download the app and create a profile within minutes.
• Request a Loan
 Choose the desired cash amount and how long you want to borrow.
• Loan Repayment Calculator
 Check the interest rate of the borrowed amount. No other fees are charged.
• Receive Money
Once your loan is confirmed, the money is transferred straight to your line of credit speedily.
• Repayment
 Make full or spread repayments over up to 12 months.
 Remember the more you payback on time, the more you can borrow.
WHO CAN APPLY
Any person 18+ years old holding a valid ID and a mobile number. 
A citizen of United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Qatar.
Have ability to repay.
• Loan Amount: AED 1000 – AED 6000
• Tenure: 91 - 365 days
• Maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 24% per year
We provide unsecured mobile loans from AED 200 toAED 2,000 with flexible payback period from 91 days to 365 days and interest rate from 3% to 18% per year. The minimum Maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is 20 % and maximum APR is 24% per year. 
Representative Example:
Apply for a loan of AED 400 with period 120 days and Interest Rate is 15%. 
- Loan Principal: 400 (120 days)
- Total Interest Fee: 60 ( 400 * 15%)
- Repayment Amount: 460 ( 400 + 60 )
PRIVACY AND PERMISSION
Trusted to keep your information secure. Your data is safe with us. We take your privacy very seriously and promise to never share your information with third parties.
CONTACT US
If you have questions regarding a loan inquiry, approval, payments or feedback, please e-mail us at klikcredit@gmail.com
DISCLAIMERS
We are not a bank or a personal loan app. Instead, we provide personal lines of credit.
We do not ask the applicant to pay advance money for a loan. 
We have provided guideline on how to apply for a loan.

bluejetty:00022137:ios.summary: Mappls App offers you the most precise and accurate navigation experience, with uniquely useful navigation features not provided by other maps apps, powered by the world’s most advanced mapping technologies and highly accurate, detailed and
bluejetty:00022137:ios.description:
Mappls App offers you the most precise and accurate navigation experience, with uniquely useful navigation features not provided by other maps apps, powered by the world’s most advanced mapping technologies and highly accurate, detailed and hyper local map data from our parent company, MapmyIndia, which pioneered digital mapping in India since 1995. And we’re proud to say that Mappls MapmyIndia is India’s own maps app, being 100% Swadeshi. 
We have several exciting and useful features, perfectly suited for the Indian Traveller: 
 • 3D Junction View to avoid confusion at flyovers and complex junctions
 • Landscape Mode for convenient navigation at any angle
 • Mappls Camera to find, share and save specific locations with geotags and timestamps
 • Trip Cost Estimation to successfully budget any journey or road trip
 • Safety Alerts to steer clear of road hazards and unsafe areas
 • Speed and Traffic Monitoring Alerts to help you avoid potential fines and violations
 • Different Modes of Travel to optimize your route plans
 • Mappls Pin to condense any complex address into just 6 characters
 • Hyperlocal & Precise Maps that allow you to navigate down to house numbers
 • RealView to explore places of interest in immersive 3D
Apart from this, Mappls App also allows users to:
 • Discover restaurants, malls, and events near their location
 • Find directions to places nearby such as banks, pubs, cafes, parking lots, pharmacies, and other Points of Interest with just one click
 • Create trails of their favorite places for easy revisiting and access 
 • Share live locations with your friends and family for seamless tracking
 • Track vehicles and assets, and ensure the safety of loved ones using Mappls IoT Gadgets for 2-wheelers and 4-wheelers
We also have a robust community, and highly encourage users to make use of our Post On Map feature to further enhance their experience with us! You can view posted events and stay up to date with a live feed of reports, reviews & check-ins, report traffic and safety issues and discover what others have to say about the places around their locality (as well as add your own reviews, of course!). 
Switch over to Mappls App today for safe and easy navigation! 
See something you like? Want something more on the app? We would love your feedback! Please drop us a message at feedback@mappls.com
Learn More: about.mappls.com/app

bluejetty:00079054:ios.description:
Love real-estate and landlord games? Build a money empire in this idle property-tycoon simulator and collect rent even while you’re offline.
Start as a rookie landlord, hire an elite team, and turn a single rundown office into a skyline-spanning business empire.
Build, Flip, Profit.
Design cosy homes, luxury condos, office-tower floors and boutique hotels. Every upgrade—layout, décor, rent level—boosts portfolio value and lifts you up the global leaderboard.
Hire a Five-Star Team.
Recruit executive assistants, brokers and PR managers, each with unique salaries, skills and ROI bonuses. Unlock full departments—IT, marketing, legal—to close deals faster and cut overhead.
Choose Offices, Conquer Cities.
Compare suburb lofts with downtown plazas: location, capacity and monthly rent shape your cash-flow curve. Expand city by city on a living map where taxes, land prices and tenant demand shift every block.
Idle Cash, Active Decisions.
Rent rolls in 24/7, but true moguls jump in to refinance loans for lower interest, snap up distressed assets at auctions, diversify into bank-lobby branches and premium office suites for fresh revenue streams.
Mentors & Live Events.
Advice from experts like Alex Vanguard boosts market trust, while weekly Money Clicker Cups and Hotel Simulator Seasons award rare buildings and décor sets—if your strategy holds.
Key Features:
- Engaging interactive storylines that weave strategy, design and business management into one experience.
- Extensive design tools for home, house and interior makeovers—shape any space your way.
- Deep renovations & flexible décor let you transform properties into luxury assets.
- Strategic idle-tycoon and finance gameplay: income flows automatically, but the key decisions are yours.

- Real Estate Tycoon: The Game fuses simulation, creativity and strategy—perfect for designers, savvy investors and interactive-story fans alike.

bluejetty:00076967:ios.description:
Discover smart heating solutions and save energy without giving up your comfort!
This application requires a Netatmo Smart Thermostat or a Netatmo Smart Valve starter pack. Visit www.netatmo.com to learn more!
SAVE ENERGY WHILE HEATING YOUR HOME
The Thermostat & the Valves set a programme based on your daily routine, so that you heat your home only when needed. Use the graph in the App to track your consumption.
MANAGE YOUR HEATING REMOTELY AND WITH VOICE CONTROL
Change the temperature remotely from your smartphone, tablet or computer. Schedule your heating to ensure you come back from your holidays to a warm home.
ROOM-BY-ROOM COMFORT
Fine-tune your ideal temperature room-by-room. Control the heating in one room or the entire home in one gesture. 
Smart Regulation: the Smart Radiator Valves analyse the room environment in real time and adjust heating according to sunshine level and room use.
Manual Boost: when needed, the temperature can be temporarily raised in a specific room.
SMART HEATING FOR BETTER HOME COMFORT
Auto-Adapt function: uses your home’s insulation and the outdoor temperature to programme when your heating should switch on.
Open Window Detection: when the Smart Radiator Valve detects a window is open, it temporarily switches off the heating in the room to prevent energy waste.
