bluejetty:00029815:ios.summary:
fresh is a modern news app that makes it easy to access your favorite news coverage anytime and anywhere. Whether you're looking for local breaking news during your morning brew or just daily news in your RSS feed, it's easy as ABC. 
Want
bluejetty:00029815:ios.description:
fresh is a modern news app that makes it easy to access your favorite news coverage anytime and anywhere. Whether you're looking for local breaking news during your morning brew or just daily news in your RSS feed, it's easy as ABC. 
Want specifics such as what the economist is saying about your country or trending politics worldwide? fresh has you covered with the latest finance news and world news. You choose and fresh delivers everything from the Washington Post, New York Yimes, Newsmax to CBS news and many more!
But that's not all. With fresh, you get more stuff than what other news apps offer. Screen for trusted sources such as NBC news, Reuters, the Associated Press, to get only unbiased news about the latest events, tech news or viral videos. 
The top reasons people love fresh news aggregator include:
- Easy menu configuration to get just the news you want.
- Bundle preferences in one app with just a few clicks.
- Light and powerful. You won't have to worry about extra memory.
- Easy installation possible without your private data.
- Access a wide range of trusted sources from the Guardian, Breitbart news, Bloomberg, Newsnation etc. to regular street news. We've compiled different sources, so you never get bored.
- Access to the most popular social media networks so that you can share what matters the most to you. 
Getting started to access the main news can be done in three easy steps:
- Download fresh app on your phone and provide the necessary permissions 
- Customize your news aggregator according to your main news preferences 
- Enjoy the latest news anytime and on your terms!
Why people love fresh?
- Simple to use for even the most complex topics. Just categorize your preferences to filter topics that matter the most to you. You can create as many preference lists as you wish. There're no limits!
- No need to burden your mobile with numerous downloads. fresh is your one-stop-news-app. Your RSS reader will deliver the newest updates in your news feed with local news, business news, sport news, or smart news.
- Get news on the go or sent daily. Mail your friends to share what you've found.
- See something interesting, but don't have time to read it? Bookmark is easy for people on the go. You can bookmark written content or videos with just a few clicks. 
With various sources to choose from, your news feed will be alive with topics that matter to you. You'll be in full control of the content you see and can opt-in and out anytime according to your changing preferences. This way you only get fresh, good news that adds value to your day.
Once you have the news app, you don't have to worry about ever missing. The news application comes compact with a wide range of sources to give you a unique news experience in just a few clicks. Take a break and find out what happens in the world or in your home town!
As a standalone news app, we have gone above and beyond to deliver a high-quality product. Found something in the app or an experience you'd like to share? Reach out and share your ratings so that others can also have a unique news experience.
Terms of use: https://myfresh.app/rules.html

4000 mini skins for Minecraft PE + editor!
Diversify your game with unusual skins. Surprise your friends and show who has the coolest skin on the server. Boy and girl - this is ideal for lovers of rare skins.

There are regular skins in the application if you didn’t like the mini skins, then you will still like this application!

bluejetty:00063081:ios.description:
Calm Radio offers over 800 channels of music and sounds designed to help you relax, focus, and sleep better. Our carefully curated genres include Easy Listening, Pop/Rock, Wellness, Sleep, Classical, Nature Sounds, Christian Music, and Audiobooks—each offering a diverse selection of channels tailored to your needs.
Whether you're looking for meditation music, sleep sounds, or soothing classical melodies, we have the perfect channel for you. Enjoy the relaxing ambiance of smooth jazz, focus-enhancing music, and calming soundscapes that bring peace to your day.
Explore Our Music Genres:
• Easy Listening: Unwind with acoustic melodies, focus & relaxation music, smooth jazz, world music, and festive holiday tunes.
• Pop/Rock: From lounge music and contemporary mixes to country blues, folk, and vintage classics, enjoy an uplifting listening experience.
• Wellness: Find balance with guided meditation, mindfulness music, stress relief melodies, guided affirmations, and even unique sounds created from plants.
• Sleep: Drift into deep rest with sleep inducers, bedtime stories, binaural sleep music, and calming sleep sounds.
• Classical: Experience the richness of classical music through different moods, instrumental compositions, and legendary composers from Baroque to the modern era.
• Nature Sounds: Immerse yourself in the sounds of nature—birdsong, flowing water, white noise, gentle creatures, and atmospheric motion.
• Christian Music: Tune in to inspiring Christian music for spiritual peace and connection.
• Audiobooks: Enjoy fiction, non-fiction, children’s stories, wellness books, and poetry narrated beautifully for a soothing listening experience.
It’s no secret that calming music can reduce stress and enhance daily harmony, that’s why you need Calm Radio — the world’s largest selection of relaxing melodies, including sleep sounds, guided mindfulness meditations, nature-fusion, classical music, and the calming sounds of smooth jazz and pop. Whether you seek relaxation, stress relief, or deep sleep, Calm Radio is the perfect app to help you unwind.
What Our Listeners Say:
Described by The New York Times as “The most popular spiritual author in America,” Eckhart Tolle is just one of our loyal listeners, stating: “I very much enjoy listening to Calm Radio. It’s my favorite station.”
Key Features of the Calm Radio App:
• Sleep Timer: Program your calming music in intervals.
• Equalizer Tone Controls: Ensure you get the best out of music, just the way you like it.
• Favorites List: Easily access your preferred relaxing melodies.
• Three-Layered Nature Sound Channels with Music: Enjoy calming nature sounds mixed with any channel you like.
• Track-Skip: Easily switch between your favorite music.
• Unlimited Listening: Relax all day with no interruptions!
Let the Facts Speak for Themselves:
• Nearly six million monthly listening hours
• Over one million unique monthly users
• Over 800 channels of calming sounds and music
• 4.6-star rating on Apple’s App Store
• “Best New Update” — Apple 2025
Membership Features:
With a premium membership, you unlock a world of relaxation and immersive listening experiences:
• Access to over 800 relaxing music channels, including sleep music, meditation music, and classical compositions.
• Ad-free listening, so you can enjoy uninterrupted moments of peace.
• A soundscape mixer that allows you to blend soothing nature sounds with your favorite music.
• High-definition audio for the ultimate listening experience.
• Extended playlists for continuous relaxation and focus.
• The ability to skip channels effortlessly, ensuring you always find the perfect sound for your mood.
Balance both your mind and body with sleep melodies — download Calm Radio now to experience relaxation, meditation, and stress relief like never before.

Privacy Policy: https://calmradio.com/en/privacy

bluejetty:00019405:ios.description:
Max is in trouble. He pissed off his cat Lula and now she’s out to get him. And Lula is far from sweet. She is viscous, cold and unforgiving. More dangerous than Lula are her traps – deadly and brutal killing contraptions with Max’s name written all over them.
SHE WANTS ME DEAD is a side-scrolling platform game, released along megastars CAZZETTE’s new hit single with the same name. 
Your job is to help poor Max, whose only hope is to get through Lula’s deadly gauntlets in one piece. This might sound easy, if it weren’t for the fact that Lula really, really wants Max dead. But there is help.
CAZZETTE’S NEW HIT SONG plays a major role in the game. Lula’s traps and other things in the environment move in rhythm with the music. Are you groovy enough to help Max find safe passage? Or are you as stiff as the corpse he’ll be when the traps hit?
Content:
- Crazy hard platform levels
- Deadly traps
- Gold frame achievements 
- A bunch of silly cat pictures
- Awesome clothes and accessories

bluejetty:00182671:ios.summary:

Will you help our heroes sav
bluejetty:00182671:ios.description:
Calling all strategic tower defenders! Are you a fan of epic online tower defense games? Download now to join fantasy heroes like Smoulder the Dragon and many others in their ongoing quest to defend the realm! 
Will you help our heroes save the turrets and towers from invasion? Do you have what it takes to engage in realm defense? 
This real-time kingdom rush castle defense game needs your help to battle and conquer! We need your skills to defend the tower – The Allied Kingdoms have one choice in this TD game: defend, defend, defend! Battle with Death Knights and fight alongside dragons, wizards, ice queens, knights and other ancient gods in our magical fantasy adventure field! You can acquire gems, potions, elixir, and even spells while working your way up to become a champion and hero! Are you ready to save the kingdom and be the best realm grinder out there?
Realm Defense is an ultimate tower kingdom defense game that challenges skilled players like you! 
Use our huge variety of powers and abilities to overcome obstacles in over 300 levels. By being a part of our kingdom rush frontier, you will travel through lush forests, snow covered mountains, and epic deserts as you use YOUR strategy to face off against enemies! The opportunities are endless – YOU will oversee the building a heroic team, discovering secret challenges, and upgrading your towers! 
Deploy rapid-fire archers! Carve walls on the map with magic beams! Fire roaring cannons! Summon allies! Realm Defense offers variety and challenge. Overcome incredible odds with strategy and wit! Rescue helpless villagers, collect important resources, and recruit legendary heroes with deadly abilities along the way to stop evil in this standout tower defense game. 
• 300+ levels with various game play modes
• Multiple worlds and realms to play with – Each having four different towers 
• Compete in tournaments to display your tower defense skills and win big prizes
• Powerful heroes with unique abilities to aid you: Fee the Archer launches a deadly Kill Shot, Lancelot the Knight unleashes the Fist of Justice, Smoulder the Dragon rains down Heat Seeker fireballs and many more
• Face off against epic bosses including a Skeleton Mage that rides a giant slime and zaps your heroes and a bomb tossing, mammoth riding Goblin King, and smolder your enemies to victory
• Huge variety of enemies offer multiple challenges: Burn your enemy, freeze them, and more with 4 spells to cast in battle
• Beautiful landscapes and character animations
• One of the best tower defense games free on the App Store
• Fun strategy games and royal challenges
PLEASE NOTE! This online game is free to play and made by people who love tower defense games. We sincerely hope you enjoy our work!

bluejetty:00069673:ios.description:
Listen to websites, PDFs, EPUBs, any text using text to speech.
Perfect for Web Novels & Fanfiction.
Includes premium voices from Amazon Polly, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and others.
Custom pronunciations, AI summaries, PDF text-to-speech, offline capabilities, desktop integration, iCloud sync and Dark Mode.*
You can save articles, e-novels, PDFs and EPUBs to read later, or listen to them one after another in a playlist.
Includes Safari extension where you can listen to websites without leaving the browser.
No Longer Limited to Websites!
- Use WebOutLoud to listen to EPUBS and PDFs*. It highlights words as it reads and remembers where you left off.
- Use WebOutLoud to read aloud any text on your device.
- Organize your saved content into collections.
- Custom substitutions including regular expression support
- AI content summaries & chat. Instantly summarize and ask questions about documents and websites up to 300 pages in length.*
About WebOutLoud's Leading Website Reader:
It's simple! Just navigate to any web page using the in-app web browser and touch play. Web Out Loud will read web pages using a wide selection of voices, from those freely available on your device to the high quality premium voices from Amazon Polly, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and others.
Reading requires way too much of your attention. Multitask like a champ! Listen to articles in your car or while you work.
- Reads any web page, PDF or text document
- Highlights words as it reads
- Scrolls the page automatically as you follow along
- Tell the app where to begin reading using Touch Assist, or enable the powerful Reader View to eliminate ads and isolate readable content automatically.
- Dozens of supported languages, each with their own unique voice
- Chrome and mobile Safari browser integration
- Custom pronunciations and word substitution
- AMP link blocking
But how does it know what to read!?!? WebOutLoud uses hand-crafted AI to read web pages to you Out Loud.
----------------------
* PLEASE NOTE:
PDF Text to Speech requires, and custom substitutions require a Basic subscription.
A Premium subscription is required for AI content summaries and premium voices (i.e. voices by Amazon Polly, Microsoft Azure and others).
Listening to web pages and text using the voices that are built-in to your device is free with an occasional ad.
----------------------
WebOutLoud Full Version is a 1-year auto-renewable subscription
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can turn off auto-renew up to 24 hours before your next subscription payment is due via your App Store settings page.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Service
http://wol.bretlester.com/terms_of_service.html
Privacy Policy
http://wol.bretlester.com/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00071211:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00071211:ios.description:
Unlike other Soccer apps SoccerTrackr doesn't require any 3rd party hardware. All that you need is an Apple Watch and an iPhone. 
SoccerTrackr turns every iPhone into a sophisticated soccer tracking computer.  Start SoccerTrackr before a game and track your favorite performance stats, and afterwards, dive deep into your data. 
SoccerTrackr tracks just about any performance metric you can imagine, plus a few exclusive to SoccerTrackr.
Key Features:
• Dedicated Game, Pick-up, Practice, Goalie and Ref modes
• Game Scores
• Goals and Assists
• Shots Against and Saves (Goalie Mode) 
• Calories Burned
• Distance Ran
• Heat Map showing zones of the field a player spent time in 
• Heart Rates (including Max and Average)
• Max and Average Running Speed
• Speed Charts (showing you when you ran faster during the game) 
• VO2 max**
• Heart Rate Recovery
• Maximum Capable Speed
• Effort Level
• Soccer Fitness Ratio 
• Max and Average Running Efficiency
• Historical graphs of all your metrics over time to see whether you're improving
• Share your stats via text, email, Twitter, Facebook, Slack! 
• The notes section lets you keep track of how you played or describe goals, penalties, saves etc.
• Custom heart rate filtering algorithm that will filter out falsely high heart rate values. 
SoccerTrackr lets you record a full workout, from start to finish, without a phone.
**Note that in order to calculate VO2Max, SoccerTrackr uses your resting heart rate (as is set by Apple during period of inactivity). Series 0 Apple Watches are not capable of resting heart rates therefore VO2Max cannot be calculated at this time on Series 0 Watches.
Notes:
• SoccerTrackr requires an Apple Watch to collect the data it displays
• SoccerTrackr integrates with the Health App on your iPhone to retrieve the data it displays. It will request permission to access the relevant data types associated with a workout.
Information about SoccerTrackr subscriptions:
- Subscribers will receive 1 week free of SoccerTrackr
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
- Read our terms of service (https://www.hockeytrackerapp.com/terms-of-service/) and privacy policy (https://www.hockeytrackerapp.com/privacy-policy/) for more information.

- Voice Boost makes every podcast the same volume with a broadcast-quality remastering engine.

Survive, please! Mini Hero! 
Waking up from a nap, the world became so strange. “Where am I? Who am I?” You murmur. Suddenly you realize that you have accidentally strayed into a bizarre nightmare. The nightmare is full of vicious monsters. The only way out is to become an invincible warrior and kill all monsters!

Waves of monsters are coming up. Will you become the only legend of that world?
🎮Features:
- Merciless Killing: Attack with powerful weapons. Fight with 1000+ monsters & zombies at once and eliminate them!
- Simple Play: Clear all chapters with one-hand control!
- Ultra-Strong Skills: Unlock infinite Roguelite skills and combinations.
- Random Combination: Skills are recommended randomly. Please defeat enemies in your fighting style. 
- Brand-new Experience: Different stage, different difficulty. All-new experiences await.
Be unrivaled, and the world is your oyster!
All feedbacks are welcome! We will do our best to make you have a better gaming experience!
Contact us: mini_hero@noxgroup.com

bluejetty:00141270:ios.description:
Become a CEO and Build Your Trucking Empire Today!
Embark on an exciting journey as the ultimate Truck Manager! Strategize, manage, and conquer the roads in this immersive truck manager game. Whether you dream of running a small fleet or ruling a global logistics empire, you create your adventure yourself. Prove yourself in one of the best free truck manager sim games in the world, and beat your friends and other real life managers to top the leaderboards by controlling highway routes.
Key Features
- Realistic 3D truck models: Indulge yourself in trailer and vehicle models similar to Mercedes, Peterbilt, Mack, Western, Ford, Volvo, Man, Mitsubishi, Scania and Iveco while you journey the highway from rest area to city. Choose vehicles from nine different types.
- Manage Your Fleet: Own and operate a variety of vehicles. Expand your fleet to handle route and cargo diversity while you schedule vehicle repairs and maintenance.
- Global Connections: Track your trucks live between each city on the interactive map via satellite GPS.
- Advanced Route Planning: Plan the most efficient route for optimal cargo delivery to every city.
- Dynamic Gameplay: Experience realistic economic scenarios and market fluctuations.
- City Expansion: Build your logistics manager hub and grow it into other cities, expanding your trade network far and wide.
- Customizable Trucks: Upgrade and personalize your 3D trucks to suit your style and enhance performance.
- Achievements & Rewards: Unlock exciting rewards as you progress.
- Real-Time Economics: Adapt to changing market conditions. Monitor fuel prices, staff wages, and shipping rates.
- Keep your staff happy: Recruit and develop a high-caliber executive team and staff to maximize your company's potential and gain boosts.
Whether you're delivering goods across a single town or creating a multinational supply chain, Truck Manager lets you take control of every detail. The immersive graphics, engaging gameplay, and realistic mechanics make this the ultimate trucking simulator strategy game enthusiasts. You can train and hire a great crew and incredible drivers, but only you, the manager, can become the CEO of an empire of cargo and travel routes and utilize your complicated strategy to be the new boss of logistics.
Note: An online internet-connection is required to play this game.
Please see the Trophy Games Privacy Statement to know more about your data protection at: https://trophy-games.com/legal/privacy-statement
Terms of use: https://trophy-games.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00152121:ios.summary:

Idle Cash Run is a satisfying idle money game where every number is a runner. Tap to add digits to the track, merge equal digits into bigger values and earn cash every t
bluejetty:00152121:ios.description:
Merge digits, race them around the track and watch your cash pile up!
Idle Cash Run is a satisfying idle money game where every number is a runner. Tap to add digits to the track, merge equal digits into bigger values and earn cash every time they pass an income gate. Upgrade, expand and grow from a few coins to billions, even while you're away.
HOW IT WORKS
• Tap to add new digit runners to the track
• Merge equal digits into bigger, more valuable numbers
• Open income gates and new lanes to earn more on every lap
• Tap the track to speed your runners up
• Come back later and collect your offline earnings
EXPLORE 5 WORLDS
Start on the classic Oval and race your way through a castle kingdom, a golden desert, the ocean floor and outer space. Every world has its own track and its own currency: Cash, Silver Coins, Gold Bars, Pearls and Crystals. Earn enough in one world to unlock the next, and convert the earnings of your old maps into your new currency.
START A NEW SEASON
Ready for a bigger run? Start a New Season: you begin again at Map 1, but you collect stars that boost your income forever. The more you earn in a season, the more stars you get, and every new season goes faster than the last.
REWARDS EVERY DAY
• Daily Tasks: complete 5 tasks every day for free gems, plus a bonus when you finish them all
• Ads Quest: watch videos to fill your quest and win gems
• Offline earnings: your runners keep earning while you rest
BOOSTS AND DIGIT PLINKO
• Boosts: multiply your income, speed up your runners, switch on auto tap or skip time to collect money instantly
• Digit Plinko: drop your digits on the board and multiply them up to x32
WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT
• Easy one-thumb gameplay, perfect for short breaks
• A true incremental game: watch the numbers climb from thousands to billions and beyond
• Satisfying merges and big payouts
• Bright 3D tracks full of racing digits
If you love idle games, merge games, money clickers and tycoon games, start your run and become a cash tycoon in Idle Cash Run!
Terms of Use: https://twiceapps.co/privacy?lang=en

bluejetty:00134062:ios.summary: Welcome to the "Supermarket Shopping Game," where you can immerse yourself in a virtual world of supermarkets and shopping malls. Step into a vibrant and bustling environment, filled with endless aisles of products and exciting challenges,
bluejetty:00134062:ios.description:
Welcome to the "Supermarket Shopping Game," where you can immerse yourself in a virtual world of supermarkets and shopping malls. Step into a vibrant and bustling environment, filled with endless aisles of products and exciting challenges, all designed to test your shopping skills!
In this thrilling game, you become the ultimate shopper, navigating through a realistic virtual supermarket. Explore the aisles, shelves, and displays as you search for the items on your shopping list. From fresh produce to household essentials and everything in between, this game offers a wide variety of products to discover and collect.
As you progress through different levels, you'll encounter various obstacles and time constraints, requiring quick thinking and strategic decision-making. Your goal is to complete your shopping efficiently and accurately, earning points and rewards for your performance. Become a master shopper by finding the best deals, comparing prices, and making wise choices to optimize your shopping experience.
Step into the future of shopping as you unlock special features and power-ups that enhance your abilities. Experience the thrill of futuristic shopping technology, such as virtual shopping assistants and augmented reality displays, making your virtual shopping spree even more exciting and immersive.
The game takes place within a vibrant shopping mall, where you can explore different stores and departments, each offering unique products and challenges. Interact with virtual shopkeepers, fellow shoppers, and mall employees, creating a realistic and dynamic shopping environment.
Sharpen your reflexes and multitasking skills as you race against the clock to complete your shopping tasks. Navigate through the aisles with precision, avoiding obstacles and other virtual shoppers along the way. The game provides a realistic simulation of a shopping experience while incorporating elements of strategy and time management.
Earn virtual currency as you successfully complete shopping challenges, allowing you to unlock new levels, upgrade your shopping cart, and customize your avatar with fashionable clothing and accessories. Show off your style and expertise as you compete with friends and players from around the world on the online leaderboard.
Whether you're a seasoned shopper or new to the world of supermarkets, the "Supermarket Shopping Game" offers endless fun and excitement. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable shopping adventure where the future of shopping is in your hands. It's time to fill up your virtual cart, race through the aisles, and become the ultimate shopping champion in this thrilling shopping game!

bluejetty:00033756:ios.description:
Color Block Jam: A Fun & Challenging Puzzle Adventure
Get ready for an exciting block puzzle game where your creativity and logic skills are key to unlocking new levels! In Color Block Jam, your mission is to send colored blocks to their matching doors and watch them disappear in a satisfying burst! With simple yet captivating gameplay, the challenge escalates as you progress through increasingly tricky levels.
Game Features:
Easy to Play, Hard to Master: Slide the blocks freely, but be mindful of obstacles that can block your path. Plan your moves carefully to clear each puzzle!
Unique Puzzle Mechanics: Combine your logical skills and strategy to clear levels and unlock new challenges.
Smooth Controls: The intuitive sliding mechanic ensures a fun and seamless gaming experience.
Colorful Visuals: Enjoy a vibrant game environment that makes your puzzle-solving experience even more enjoyable.
How to Play:
Slide the blocks to match them with the colored doors.
The goal is simple: clear the blocks and use strategic thinking to work your way through each level.
Think ahead! You’ll be given new blockers as you progress—plan your moves before running out of time.
Tips for Becoming a Puzzle Master:
Focus on clearing larger areas by strategically positioning blocks.
Use each block’s shape to your advantage and try to maximize your space for better moves.
Think carefully and plan your strategy to rack up points and clear levels.
Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or challenge your mind with exciting puzzles, Color Block Jam will keep you engaged for hours. Download NOW and test your puzzle-solving skills today!

bluejetty:00073057:ios.description:
Your goal is to make as much money as you can in 14 or 30 days by selling lemonade at your lemonade stand, Can you sell $1,000 of lemonade?
Buy cups, lemons, sugar, and ice, then decide your recipe based on the weather and how much cash you want to charge customers. Start with the given basic recipe, then try to change the recipe and see if you can make the recipe better to make more cash. Try to change your lemonade sale price based on the weather conditions. If you get good reviews and have happy customers even more people will shop up to your stand. If you make enough cash you can upgrade your stands location to the Park or the City to sell Lemonade for up to 4x more cash! At the end of the game, you'll see how much money you made.
Compare your scores against all the entrepreneurs in the world, are you in the top 10% of the lemonade market?

bluejetty:00079569:ios.description:
We Together is a relationship counter and calendar created for couples. The application reminds couples of important events and anniversaries and a handy love widget allows you to see how many days you have been together in a matter of seconds.
Application capabilities.
Personalized love counter
Set the relationship beginning date in the calendar, set a photo as a background and find out how many days you have been together or how many days there are until the anniversary. Choose your favorite design options for the love counter to make it unique.
Anniversary tracker
The anniversary of the first meeting or kiss, the beginning of a relationship or a wedding - in the We Together app you can follow all the dates at once and receive reminders of them.
Customizable love widget
Choose a day that is convenient for you - see the counter of days or days until an anniversary and install a beautiful love widget on your desktop.
Photo album
Save personal and family photos of your couple in a secure album.
Love compatibility
Find out your compatibility with your partner based on your zodiac sign, your partner’s character traits, as well as the positive and negative factors in your future relationship.
Gifts withlist
Save and share gift ideas for your partner right in the app to please your partner on their big day.
Moments and calendar of love
Write history by saving moments in the relationship calendar. A date, a surprise or a sudden gift - all the most pleasant days of your couple will be captured.
Notifications
Turn on notifications and get reminders of upcoming anniversaries so you never miss an important date.
Are you puzzled each time with what to give to your loved one for an anniversary?
Use a gift wishlist and two taps to save links to ideas.
The relationship counter and love widget will help you find out in a matter of seconds how many days you are with the person you really care about!

bluejetty:00145692:ios.description:
The comprehensive ShiaMuslim App provides every Muslim with various unique features necessary for daily life.
The main difference between this App and other similar applications is that we strive to supply all contents and features in a single application for shia Muslim Community which is innovative, user-friendly, and can be enjoyed by all Muslims regardless of their various cultural backgrounds.
Main Features
• More than 140 translations in 20 languages.
• Access to translation and transliteration concurrently.
• Access to audio translations while recitation of the Holy Quran is played.
• Recitations of more than 18 favorite Quran reciters.
• Subject based categorization of Surahs and Verses of the Holy Qur’an. 
• Customized daily Quran reading section to create the daily Quran habit.
• A collection of more than 6000 documented Ahadith with a new categorizing method.
• A very comprehensive collection of Duas, A’amals, Ziarah, Salat in Mafatih 
Section
• Making a Personalized Mafatih including selected duas, a’amals, etc. …
• More than 1200 free books and papers in 9 categories
The Holy Qur’an, Hadith, Beliefs
Ethics, Infallibles, Figh
History, Spirituality, Philosophy
• Access to full version of Nahj al-Balagha: sermons, letters, sayings. 
• Sahifah in its full version is available 
• Qibla is shown in this section on map and by direction
• Virtual live Ziarah to different holy places 
• Dhikr Counter available in Tasbih section
• Ability to record qadha prayers and fasts in Qadha Tracker section
• Gregorian and Hidjry calendar types 
• Adjustable Hidjry calendar based on the fatwa of the great scholars 
• Access to the most popular Adhans and pre-adhan alarms for download
• Various Azan and pre Azan chants available
Online Istikhara
ShiaMuslim App is delighted to present an online Istakhara service in this platform. Through this service, you are connected to a scholar from howza of Qom or Najaf. You may submit your istikhara request directly on the application, and a scholar from Qom or Najaf will conduct the istikhara for you. Thereafter, you will be informed of the result of your istikhara on the application as early as possible
Media
In the Quran Media in Today section, you will have easy access to beautifully displayed Ayaat of the Holy Qur’an which have been arranged according to various Surahs.
Also in the Hadith Media section you will have access to the most useful ahadith of the prophet and his progeny from Imam Ali until Imam Mahdi (AS)
And in the Dua Media section you will have easy access to the most useful phrases from various Important Duas which have been illustrated using beautiful designs. 
These designs and this photography helps us better appreciate and implement the content of these divine teachings in our lives

bluejetty:00131150:ios.summary:
BeeWallet produced by Beesoft Inc. is designed to manage all your financial needs on the go. BeeWallet is designed with a user-friendly interface and sleek design, it is your ultimate financial companion.
With all kind of features in the a
bluejetty:00131150:ios.description:
BeeWallet produced by Beesoft Inc. is designed to manage all your financial needs on the go. BeeWallet is designed with a user-friendly interface and sleek design, it is your ultimate financial companion.
With all kind of features in the app, you can do anything you want. For example, manage your accounts, record your daily expenses, monitor your budgets, keep you reminded of your bills. What’s more important, the system is stable and secure enough. We will never leak your data or share it with anyone on the internet. Whether to keep track of your revenue and expenditure or do the statistical analysis, BeeWallet is trustworthy. 
• In spite of so many features we have, it is extremely handy to use: 
 ◦ Step 1, create an account. 
 ◦ Step 2, put in your expense/income/transfer transactions to the account. 
 ◦ Step 3, with continuous inputting, you are able to stay in control of your personal finance for the long-term. 
KEY FEATURES IN THE APP 
• Manage Your Accounts - Account can be built easily with entering account name, account type(each type has its unique icon) and start balance. You can build accounts with no limitation in one place where you can organize their sequence. Two kind of balance statistics will be list for each account—Balance and Available Balance. 
 ◦ Balance means Account Balance, it include all of your money, including all available transactions and transactions that are held. 
 ◦ Your available balance is the amount you can spend right now, not including the transactions that are held.
• Monitor Budgets - Keep your money under control and save money with the help of this budget feature. Whatever goal you want to achieve, like saving for a new iPhone or cut the diet expense to have a happy trip, the budget module will offer a integrated plan with simple steps. Variety of categories is offered and whatever budget time period is accessible. If necessary, you can adjust the budget flexibly whenever you want. 
• Keep Track of Bills - Never worry about forgetting any of your bills, as reminder is customizable for different reminder alert periods. When paying the bill before the due date or overdue, you can choose to pay fully or partially for installment or other purpose. After paying the bill, the paid bills will be put in together for future review. Furthermore, calendar for bills helps you check all your bills from the start to the end at a glance.  
• Intuitive Charts - Insightful finance statement will be placed in the Charts View, where divided into four parts—the Summary, the Category, the Cash Flow and the Net Worth. It is easy to understand your finance overviews through the Charts, from expenses and incomes, budgets, bank accounts, to categories and bills etc. Reports of all your transactions is available, which can be exported via Gmail, Google Drive, Dropbox and so on. 
OTHER KEY FEATURES 
• Backup all your data to Google Drive or Dropbox whenever you want, and restore it if you change phone or for other reasons. 
• Quick search for transactions 
• Passcode protection 
• Complete world currency support 
• Select the start date of week 
• Payers & payees management 
• Category management 
YOUR SUGGESTIONS MEANS A LOT 
• If you have any suggestions or problems, please feel free to send us a mail. We are glad to offer any help. Your feedback is the driving force for our improvement.   
Privacy Policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/26338091
Terms of Use: https://apps.beesoft.io/bWallet/TermsConditions.html

bluejetty:00039839:ios.description:
DroneDeploy is the leading flight app for drones with millions of missions flown by over 130,000 pilots. 
DroneDeploy is the leading cloud software platform for commercial drones, making the power of aerial data accessible and productive for everyone. The free DroneDeploy app provides easy automated flight and data capture, and enables you to create, explore and share high-quality interactive maps, orthomosaics and 3D models directly from your mobile device. 
Fly your DJI drone autonomously with just two taps on your iOS device. Quickly process your imagery with DroneDeploy to generate accurate, high-resolution maps and 3D models. Analyze, annotate and share your maps with others directly from within the app. Extend your capabilities and take your analysis to the next level with AI reporting and over 80 best-in-class apps available for install within DroneDeploy’s App Market. 
DroneDeploy is the ultimate app for a wide range of high-accuracy aerial imaging and mapping applications in construction, solar, agriculture, surveying, mining, insurance, inspection and more. DroneDeploy has empowered users to map and analyze over 30 million acres in more than 160 countries.
DRONE SUPPORT
• Mavic 2 Pro / Zoom / Enterprise / Dual (thermal)
• Mavic Air 2
• DJI Air 2S
• Phantom 4 Pro V1 / V2
• Phantom 4
• Inspire 2
• Matrice 200 / 210 / 210 RTK V1 / V2
• Matrice 300 RTK
Not compatible with the following hardware:
• DJI Mavic Mini series
HIGHLIGHTS
• Easily plan and schedule repeatable flights
• Fly and capture massive areas
• Disable auto-flight with a single tap
• Includes a full featured manual flight mode
• Film professional quality video hands-free
• Create automated spherical panoramas
• Record all your flight logs in one place
• Measure elevation, distance, volumes, surface area and roof geometry (roof reports)
• Quickly create survey-grade maps and models with ground control points
• Collaborate with teams through shared maps, annotations and comments
• Wirelessly upload images from the drone
• Export data in the format you need - JPG, Geotiff, OBJ, XYZ, LAS
• Explore orthomosaic, NDVI, VARI, digital elevation maps and 3D models
- - -
Find out more at www.dronedeploy.com 
Please join us in improving and discussing the app at http://forum.dronedeploy.com

bluejetty:00145595:ios.summary: 《Block Puzzle Pudding》: This is an innovative take on the classic puzzle game. Players need to place various shaped blocks into a 9x9 grid, focusing on eliminating the blocks. Enjoy an unrestricted, timeless gaming experience. At the same t
bluejetty:00145595:ios.description:
《Block Puzzle Pudding》: This is an innovative take on the classic puzzle game. Players need to place various shaped blocks into a 9x9 grid, focusing on eliminating the blocks. Enjoy an unrestricted, timeless gaming experience. At the same time, you can create deliciously colorful puddings to satisfy the appetite of your green-hued customers!
Game Challenges
Challenge: This game is not only the best choice for passing the time but also effectively trains your brain. The unlimited gameplay allows you to keep challenging yourself until you decide to stop. Each round offers three different shaped blocks (such as squares, T-shapes, I-shapes, etc.) waiting for you to place, solving the puzzles of the block world!
Puzzle: This user-friendly game with a simple interface is suitable for people of all ages. Use the block puzzle game to keep your mind sharp and improve your logical thinking skills.
Timed: The game innovatively adds tasks that require eliminating a specific number of colored blocks. Completing these tasks within a limited time will earn you extra rewards, and even if you don't complete them, you won't be penalized. Enjoy a relaxed and leisurely game time!
Innovative Gameplay
· Delivery Mode: Eliminate the specified number of colored blocks within a limited time to satisfy the appetite of the green monster and earn more rewards! Experience exciting and fun challenges.
· Elimination Skills: Use tools to solve elimination puzzles, and experience new gameplay with strategic skills, speeding up the production of the desired puddings.
Basic Rules
· Drag and drop blocks into the 9x9 grid.
· Fill an entire row or column to eliminate the blocks.
· The game ends when there is no space to place new blocks.
· You earn points for each placement and elimination of rows/columns.
· Eliminate according to the color and marked number of the puddings to earn more rewards.
Key Features
· Minimal Time Restrictions: The game won't end when time runs out, enjoy a relaxing elimination process!
· Crisp Sound Effects: Accompanied by pleasing background music, enhancing the game experience!
· Simple Controls: Easy to pick up and play.
· Exquisite Design: Beautiful interface design and vivid characters.
· Addictive Mechanics: Simple yet addictive game mechanics.
· Fresh Interface: Clean and simple interface design, making it irresistible to play!
Come and experience this casual and brain-training puzzle game! Whether you're passing the time or exercising your brain, 《Block Puzzle Pudding》 is your best choice!

bluejetty:00091726:ios.summary:

RuckWell counts the load — and it counts what you do to recover from it. Tell it what you're carrying and the weight becomes part of every number: calorie
bluejetty:00091726:ios.description:
Rucking is walking with weight on your back. Most fitness trackers log it as a walk.
RuckWell counts the load — and it counts what you do to recover from it. Tell it what you're carrying and the weight becomes part of every number: calories, ruck work, ruck power, and your training load over time. No running required.
WEIGHT-ADJUSTED FROM THE FIRST STEP
Save the packs and vests you actually use, pick one, and go — carrying weight raises the energy cost of every mile, and RuckWell scores the effort accordingly instead of handing you the numbers from an unloaded walk.
GPS BUILT FOR LOADED MOVEMENT 
Filtered distance and pace, mile and kilometer splits, auto-pause for lights and rest breaks, and barometric elevation gain — because the hills are the point.
GUIDANCE FOR YOUR DAY 
Home opens on a Today card that reads your week so far and points you toward what will move you forward: a ruck, some mobility, or a rest day. One tap starts it with your pack and settings already loaded.
EVERY METRIC AT A GLANCE 
The live workout screen puts distance, pace, heart rate, elevation, splits, and load metrics in one full-screen, scrolling view. No paging around to find your pace mid-step.
RUCKLOAD™ TRAINING LOAD 
RuckLoad™ quantifies your recent training stress from intensity, volume, ruck weight, and elevation gain — across everything you do, not just rucking. Runs, walks, hikes, and lifting all count toward it.
RECOVERY IS PART OF THE TRAINING 
Wake up to a daily Recovery Score built from overnight HRV, resting heart rate, respiratory rate, sleep, and your current RuckLoad. Log the other half of the work too — sauna sessions, mobility, and easy movement — so what you do to recover shows up in the picture instead of disappearing from it.
ON YOUR WRIST 
A full Apple Watch app that records on its own, with or without your phone nearby, and syncs back when you're done. Live Activities on the Lock Screen, Smart Stack and Home Screen widgets, and metrics that stay readable on the Always-On display.
INDOOR AND TREADMILL 
Set speed and incline in the app, up to 40% grade. Pace comes from belt speed, so treadmill rucks land in your history with real numbers.
TRAILS AND ROUTES 
Import a GPX route and follow it with breadcrumb navigation on iPhone and Apple Watch, with audio turn cues and off-route alerts. Keep your head up instead of on your phone.
HEART RATE, YOUR WAY 
Apple Watch or a Bluetooth chest strap, with time-in-zone for every workout. Use the heart rate zones you set up in Apple Health (iOS 27), a standard formula, or thresholds you set yourself, zone by zone.
SYNCS WHERE YOU ALREADY ARE 
Two-way Apple Health, plus automatic upload to Strava with your training data intact.
HISTORY THAT ADDS UP 
A calendar of everything you've carried, with splits, route maps, elevation profiles, nutrition and macros, and 7-, 30-, 90-day and all-time trends.
YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE 
No account. No sign-up. Your workouts, routes, and health data live on your device and sync through Apple Health — not through us. RuckWell works fully offline, and nothing you record is ever sold. Strava upload happens only when you connect it.
Whether you're training for an event, building a habit, or just getting stronger under load, RuckWell tracks the work and the recovery it takes to keep doing it.
Requires iPhone on iOS 18 or later. Apple Watch app requires watchOS 10.4 or later.
RuckWell Plus is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://ruckwell.com/pages/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00179421:ios.summary: This app provides different plank variations to help you lose weight, gain strength and get a stronger core. The mixing of static and dynamic planks really helps you burn fat fast. Take only 7 minutes a day to burn calories and get in bette
bluejetty:00179421:ios.description:
This app provides different plank variations to help you lose weight, gain strength and get a stronger core. The mixing of static and dynamic planks really helps you burn fat fast. Take only 7 minutes a day to burn calories and get in better shape!
With 3 difficulty levels, the 30-day weight loss plan perfectly fits all fitness levels, and it suits both men and women. You can customize your training plan according to your own preferences. There's no equipment or gym needed; you can do plank workouts anywhere at anytime.
Why plank workout?
Planks are the most popular and effective fat burning exercise. They can be easily performed and activate all your muscles, including your core, shoulders, glutes, etc. Planks are the best choice for people with weak knees because they put no pressure on knees.
Maximize the belly fat burning: Planks are more effective than crunches at burning belly fat. Planks activate 100% of your abs, while crunches only involve 64% of them.
Strengthen your core: Plank workout fires up all your core muscle groups, enhances your core strength, and helps you get a strong core.
Reduce back pain: Plank workout can strengthen your back muscles, reduce back pain and lower the risk of back and spinal column injuries.
Improve your posture & balance: Plank workout requires your head, back and feet to be in a straight line. Regularly doing this will improve your balance and posture when sitting and standing.
Accelerate your metabolism: Doing planks keeps your metabolism high for the whole day; this dramatically boosts the fat burning process.
Improve your flexibility: Plank workout stretches all your posterior muscle groups, such as your shoulder blades, glutes and hamstrings, thus improving your flexibility and lowering the risk of injury.
Features:
- On "Settings" page, turn on the "Apple Health" switch to sync the information of your height, weight, calories to Apple Health
- Sync data to Apple Health
- Different forms of planks provided
- Customized workout reminders help you make planking a daily workout routine
- Detailed instruction, animation, and video guide you through every workout
- Workout duration and difficulty increase step by step
- Track your weight loss progress automatically
- Track your burned calories automatically 
Subscription Terms and Details
- Get unlimited access to all features for USD $59.99/year. 
- The payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Privacy Policy: https://period-calendar.com/ios_privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use: http://pay.period-calendar.com/app/plank.html

Never let the weather catch you by surprise again. FOX 11's trusted Severe Weather Team delivers Northeast Wisconsin's most accurate hour-by-hour forecast for the next day and for the week ahead. Unlike other weather apps, you'll get a local forecast that is customized for you.

- The latest video forecast from the FOX 11 Severe Weather Team
- Current weather conditions for Green Bay, Northeast Wisconsin, and anywhere in the United States
- Share the weather conditions via text message, email, Facebook, Twitter or our Report It feature
- You can set multiple custom locations to track forecasts, alerts, radar, and more

bluejetty:00119670:ios.name: ThinkSpace - Mind Map & Notes
bluejetty:00119670:ios.summary:
Too much on your mind, and no idea where to start?
AI chats, posts you saw, books you read, things people told you. There is more to think about every day.
ThinkSpace is a thinking notebook: put your thoughts on cards, then arrange and conn
bluejetty:00119670:ios.description:
Too much on your mind, and no idea where to start?
AI chats, posts you saw, books you read, things people told you. There is more to think about every day.
ThinkSpace is a thinking notebook: put your thoughts on cards, then arrange and connect them as you think. As you move cards around and put ideas into your own words, your understanding deepens.
■ How it works
Start with a single card: whatever is on your mind.
1. Collect: AI chats, web pages, photos, passing thoughts, via the Inbox or by pasting.
2. Write it down: turn them, and what is in your head, into handwritten or text cards.
3. Arrange and see the big picture: move, group, and connect cards. Step back, and unexpected connections, next questions, and next actions appear.
4. Explain: say what your cards or map mean, out loud, in your own words. Read the transcript back to check what you really understand.
■ Great for
- Clearing your head when AI chats pile up
- Making sense of books and videos, and turning them into questions and actions
- Connecting ideas from research papers and textbooks so you can explain them in your own words
- Creating nursing concept maps and connecting conditions, symptoms, and care
- Bringing a story's world, characters, timeline, and ideas into one structure
- Journaling: writing out tangled feelings and worries
- Designing your career in the AI era, a social media strategy, or a product
- Connecting visions and goals to concrete actions and reviews
- Working through problems at work: causes, solutions, validation, results
■ Start from a purpose-built map
No need to stare at a blank canvas wondering where to begin.
- Concept map
- Problem-solving map
- Pathophysiology map
- Career map for the AI era
- Worldbuilding map
- Social media strategy map
- Habit-building map
- Product design map
- Vision map
and more — start from a foundation that fits your topic.
■ Turn AI chats into a growing map
Ask AI about a card and add the answers to your map. Break answers into ideas, connect them, and make sense of them in your own words; looking over the map sparks new questions to dig into. Your AI inputs are never used for training.
■ Key features
- Infinite canvas: place cards anywhere, half-formed thoughts included.
- Handwriting and text: Apple Pencil supported. Jot down ideas on cards and move them around with your finger.
- Mind maps, flowcharts, groups, and connections: radial thinking, steps, cause and effect.
- Send from AI chats: send a conversation from Claude or the share sheet to the ThinkSpace Inbox, then drag it in as a card.
- Explain out loud: describe a card or map in your own words; it is transcribed and saved. You notice where your understanding is thin, and can read it back later.
- Ask AI: ask about a card and add the answer as a new card.
- Extract key-point cards from long notes and web pages.
- AI brainstorming: branch a topic card into angles and questions.
- Paste into cards: copied text, photos, or URLs become cards.
- Add web pages, images, and screenshots to your canvas.
- Search and reuse cards across maps.
- Link canvases: big themes and subtopics in layers.
- Export to image, PDF, and text.
- Local-first: saved on your device, works offline.
- Sync across devices (Pro): iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Turn scattered information and AI answers into understanding you can explain and act on.
■ Pro access
- Unlimited canvases
- Unlimited cards and groups
- Expanded AI usage limit
- Full feature access
———
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal fee is charged to your iTunes account within 24 hours before the period ends. You can turn off auto-renewal anytime in your App Store account settings.
———

bluejetty:00122839:ios.description:
HODL is the crypto tracker for real-time prices, charts, news and your portfolio, with stocks in the same watchlist. New: Hermes, your own AI agent, in HODL Pro.
HERMES – YOUR AI AGENT (HODL PRO)
• Chat with Hermes about coins, stocks and markets; research answers come with tables and sources.
• Hermes can update your watchlist, portfolio, transactions and price alerts for you.
• Set up your own automations, for example a daily market summary.
• Talk by voice or have answers read aloud.
• Your own isolated Hermes workspace, with your normal HODL account.
Hermes provides information, not investment advice.
TRACK CRYPTO & STOCKS
• Real-time prices for cryptocurrencies across many exchanges and for US stocks
• Charts with adjustable time ranges, chart types and indicators
• Portfolio tracker: holdings, transactions, value and performance
• Coin and company profiles
• Top gainers, losers and trending assets
• Home screen widget
NEWS, SOCIAL & RESEARCH
• News for your coins and stocks
• Social posts and trending discussions for each asset
• Daily summaries of Wall Street research (Premium)
PRICE ALERTS (PREMIUM)
• Alerts for any price target or percentage change
• Smart bracket alerts: HODL resets your alert targets above and below the price automatically
PLANS
• Free: watchlist and portfolio with up to 10 symbols, prices, charts, news, social posts and the widget
• HODL Premium: unlimited symbols, unlimited price alerts with smart brackets, Wall Street research. USD 6.99 per month or USD 59.99 per year
• HODL Pro: everything in Premium plus Hermes, your own AI agent. USD 39.99 per month or USD 344.99 per year
Eligible new subscribers get a 7-day free trial.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
HODL Premium and HODL Pro are auto-renewable subscriptions with a monthly or yearly period. The prices above are US prices; your local price is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase or at the end of the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Email us for help, questions or feedback: support@hodlfinance.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.hodl.mobi/privacy.htm
Terms of Use: https://www.hodl.mobi/terms.htm

bluejetty:00137168:ios.summary: Combine your perfect outfit in no time. Be inspired by your style peers, discover the latest fashion trends and find your new favourite items from over 800 brands and online shops. Share them with your followers and get their instant feedba
bluejetty:00137168:ios.description:
Combine your perfect outfit in no time. Be inspired by your style peers, discover the latest fashion trends and find your new favourite items from over 800 brands and online shops. Share them with your followers and get their instant feedback.
combyne is creativity 
Find your individual look by combining all items in our unique combyner, your personal virtual dressing room. Whether you're looking for tops, dresses, shoes, jeans, skirts, accessories, etc, you'll find them in over 35 categories. Search for your favourite fashion designers, brands, or items on sale. Once you've created an outfit, share it with your friends and followers and get their instant feedback.
combyne is communication
Follow your friends, favourite bloggers and style icons, or any other user. Share your outfits with them or comment on their outfits. The combyne feed will keep you up to date on what the people you follow have been combining and you can tell them what you think of it.
combyne is inspiration
Our fashion team carefully curated a selection of fashion trends, must-haves, outfits and looks. With combyne you'll never miss the latest trends, always get great fashion advice and browse every day for new clothes. 
combyne is Community
Get matched and find your fashion soulmate, who thinks and dresses just like you! The chat feature lets you share your looks immediately with your friends and receive quick feedback. 
combyne is a fashion challenge
Our users create Outfit Challenge every day. Create your look following the rules of the challenge, rate the others' looks, get the most likes. 
combyne is online shopping
You can buy every item or outfit directly via the app at over 50 partner shops and brands. With one click, we will forward you to your favorite item in the online shop or current sale.
combyne is your virtual wardrobe
Save your favourite items and outfits, name them by event or style and never lose track of your wardrobe again.
combyne Features:
- Combine personal outfits and find new looks
- Get new fashion tips und share them with friends
- Follow friends, bloggers and style icons and comment on their outfits
- Create an individual looks
- Save your favourite outfits
- Get fashion-matched with your style-soulmate
- More than 50 online shops
- More than 1.000 fashion brands
Some feedback from our users:
Restore your faith in fashion!!
Love love LOVEEEEEEEE this app!! ….By far the best, most interactive fashion/styling app available!! And trust me I’ve tried all!!
_by Hannahkristal
Finally, everything in just one app!!!
Great, finally everything I need in regards to fashion all in one app:
1. Inspiration from other users that I can use. 
2. Generate and save (or post) outfits or pieces of clothing from my own wardrobe and pair them with pieces from other users or one of the many shops in the app.
3. Super chat function - so many useful tips about things I have searched for.
4. Great overview and all information and categories clear at first glance. 
And since the backgrounds can be loaded individually, it is really creative! 
Attention: Take into account that the app should be updated regularly, because they keep adding new features!
WhatsApp for fashion!
A lifesaver! Finally. Now I don’t have to take awkward selfies in the changing room anymore and send them via WhatsApp. I love the new update! Well done @comybne!
Our Partners:
About You, Armani, Choies, Farfetch, Mango, Miss Selfridge, MyTheresa, New Look, Pinky Laing, River Island, Topshop, Urban Outfitters.
How do you like the app? Rate us in the App Store or drop us a line at ilove@combyne.com.
Download combyne for iPhone now!

Sí. Personaliza alertas de Miami, el sur de Florida, inmigración, clima, tráfico, huracanes, elecciones y noticias urgentes.

listings.name: Telemundo 51 Miami: Noticias
listings.description:
Telemundo 51 Miami es una app de noticias, clima y alertas para la comunidad hispana de Miami, Fort Lauderdale y el sur de Florida. Mantente informado con noticias de última hora, pronósticos del tiempo, radar en vivo, alertas meteorológicas, cobertura electoral y transmisiones en vivo.

Recibe cobertura local confiable en una sola app. Sigue noticias de Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Hialeah y Hollywood, además de inmigración, política, elecciones, tráfico, seguridad pública, entretenimiento, huracanes y clima severo.

Personaliza tus alertas de noticias, clima y elecciones según tu zona.

¿Por qué usar la app de Telemundo 51?

Si vives en Miami, Fort Lauderdale o el sur de Florida, Telemundo 51 te ayuda a estar informado de noticias locales, clima, inmigración, elecciones, huracanes y radar en vivo.

¿Qué puedes hacer con la app de Telemundo 51?

Sigue noticias locales de Miami

* Recibe alertas de noticias locales, nacionales e internacionales
* Sigue inmigración, política, seguridad pública y tráfico
* Lee artículos y mira videos de Telemundo 51

Sigue las elecciones en Miami y Florida

* Obtén cobertura de elecciones locales y estatales
* Sigue elecciones de Miami, el sur de Florida y Florida
* Infórmate sobre primarias, elecciones de medio término y presidenciales
* Consulta candidatos, medidas electorales, información para votantes y resultados

Consulta el tiempo para Miami

* Mira condiciones actuales y alertas meteorológicas
* Accede al pronóstico de 10 días para Miami y el sur de Florida
* Consulta pronósticos por hora

Usa los widgets del tiempo

* Agrega widgets a tu pantalla de inicio
* Ve condiciones actuales según tu zona
* Toca el widget para ver el pronóstico completo

Sigue el tiempo con radar en vivo

* Accede a radar en tiempo real
* Sigue cambios del tiempo en Miami y el sur de Florida
* Guarda zonas y configura alertas meteorológicas
* Consulta alertas de huracanes, tormentas e inundaciones

Mira Telemundo 51 en vivo

* Ve noticieros y cobertura en vivo de Telemundo 51
* Accede a videos locales y entretenimiento
* Mira streams de eventos importantes

Mantente informado durante eventos importantes

* Sigue huracanes, tormentas tropicales, inundaciones y emergencias
* Recibe actualizaciones de tráfico y seguridad pública
* Mira conferencias de prensa y cobertura en vivo
* Recibe lo último de elecciones, inmigración y noticias en desarrollo

Consulta Telemundo 51 Responde

* Accede a investigaciones y reportajes locales
* Sigue Telemundo 51 Responde para ayuda al consumidor

¿Para quién es la app de Telemundo 51?

Telemundo 51 es para personas en Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Hialeah, Hollywood, Doral, Kendall, Coral Gables, Pembroke Pines y el sur de Florida que buscan noticias locales en español, clima, radar en vivo, tráfico, inmigración, elecciones, huracanes y alertas.

¿Cuándo debes usar la app de Telemundo 51?

Usa la app para recibir noticias de Miami, consultar el pronóstico y radar en vivo, seguir huracanes y clima severo, ver noticieros de Telemundo 51, informarte sobre inmigración y seguir elecciones locales, primarias, elecciones de medio término, presidenciales y resultados.

¿Puedo recibir alertas de noticias de Miami?

Sí. Personaliza alertas de Miami, el sur de Florida, inmigración, clima, tráfico, huracanes, elecciones y noticias urgentes.

¿Puedo seguir las elecciones de Miami y Florida?

Sí. Sigue elecciones locales y estatales, primarias, elecciones de medio término y presidenciales. Consulta candidatos, medidas electorales, información para votantes y resultados.

¿Puedo ver Telemundo 51 en vivo en la app?

Sí. Puedes ver noticieros en vivo de Telemundo 51, cobertura urgente, cobertura electoral y videos locales.

Telemundo 51 Miami ayuda a la comunidad hispana del sur de Florida a mantenerse informada con noticias locales en español, clima, radar en vivo, inmigración, elecciones, huracanes, alertas y transmisiones en vivo.

bluejetty:00097189:ios.description:
Skewer Master: Grill Sort – A Delicious Journey of BBQ Fun and Puzzle Challenge!
Get ready to experience the perfect blend of BBQ cooking and brain-teasing puzzles!
In Skewer Master, arrange mouth-watering skewers on the grill, combine flavors with logic, and embark on a fun-filled cooking adventure packed with sizzling excitement.
Unique Gameplay – Become the Ultimate BBQ Master
Welcome to a creative skewer-sorting puzzle game where strategy meets cooking fun!
Slide and match three identical skewers to collect them from the grill. As you progress through levels, unlock a variety of tasty ingredients and powerful cooking tools. Use your smart moves to clear the grill and claim your spot as the ultimate Grill Master!
Game Highlights
Classic match-and-sort with a BBQ twist: Enjoy a fresh take on puzzle gameplay inspired by the joy of grilling.
Easy to play, hard to master: Simple touch controls and progressive difficulty—perfect for all types of players.
Powerful boosters & tools: Collect unique utensils and special bonuses to make every BBQ puzzle more exciting.
Tons of creative levels: Explore diverse challenges and endless fun across hundreds of grill-themed puzzles.
Dynamic order system: Random BBQ food orders keep every session surprising and rewarding.
Relaxing & Addictive Experience
Satisfying sizzle and crunchy sound effects for stress-relieving fun.
Clean and cheerful design – play anytime, anywhere with just one hand.
Cute and cozy visuals create a warm BBQ-party vibe.
Perfect for filling your free moments with relaxing, tasty fun.
Join the Skewer-Sorting Feast Now!
Don’t wait—download Skewer Master today and start your skewer grill sort BBQ food adventure!
Sharpen your mind, master the grill, and build your own delicious legacy in this addictively fun cooking puzzle game.
Unleash your inner chef and turn every match into a mouth-watering success!

Your favorite cuisines delivered in minutes

Food & drink

► Fresh foods & freshly baked: Fresh meats, poultry, fruits, veggies, bread and baked goods.

► Home cleaning: Cleaning supplies, laundry products and other household staples.

bluejetty:00184566:ios.description:
Video Editor & Effects
The easy way to create stunning videos & add subtitles, text, music, stickers, add filters & effects, and much more to attracts customers. Drag audio, videos, photos and titles into the timeline and adjust the position and layout of your video and add special effects to make eye-catching videos.
Collage Photo Video Editor
Create collage video with 50+ layouts in just few taps. Customise grid layout ratio and its background color, also change border position and curve radius.
Video Mixer & Merger
Mix and merge multiple photos and videos together, add music and combine videos without losing quality. It helps to merge video with different frame rate, same frame size and audio rate video files.
Video Tools
Clips on the timeline can be adjusted in multiple ways, including cropping, scaling, trimming, rotation and adjusting. It helps you to trim and crop video, removing unwanted portions. Split your video into 30 sec automatically, customize time duration to be split. Use the power of video to capture the surprising reaction with music OR recording. Convert a video clip OR multiple images into a GIF.

Subscriptions can be weekly, monthly and annual**
The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current billing period
** Subscription amounts are equal to the value that the "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines to be the equivalent of the subscription price of your local currency in $USD.

bluejetty:00142609:ios.name: Online Tambola - Paperless
bluejetty:00142609:ios.summary:
HOST, INVITE, JOIN, PLAY, PARTY
Hosts can organise Tambola party games. Friends, kitty party groups can join directly via multiplayer game invite link or with easy to read invite codes. There is no limit on the number of players who can joi
bluejetty:00142609:ios.description:
HOST, INVITE, JOIN, PLAY, PARTY
Hosts can organise Tambola party games. Friends, kitty party groups can join directly via multiplayer game invite link or with easy to read invite codes. There is no limit on the number of players who can join or the number of games that one can host. Games can also be scheduled in advance for eg. Sunday or evening.
TICKETS, REQUEST, APPROVE, STRIKE
Friends can send requests for any number of tickets. Host can approve(or reject) the tickets. E-Tickets are generated instantaneously, free, to every online player on the app. Hosts can also see how many tickets each player is playing with.
Players can keep track of the matched numbers by striking them directly on their ticket on the app. Ticket generator is based on a random system logic and cannot be manipulated.
Host is also allowed to buy ticket(s) for himself.
REAL TIME, AUTOMATIC NUMBER CALLER
When all players are ready, the host can start the game by drawing the first number. Every number drawn by the host is automatically called on every players' screen. Host has complete control on the pace of calling the numbers. He can pause, go fast or slow the number calling depending on the online group.
Even when the numbers are called by the host, he has no control on what number will actually be called.
NUMBERS BOARD
At any time, players can pull the board from the left side drawer to check all the numbers which have been called till then. This is useful if some numbers on the ticket was not/incorrectly cut or strike.
DIVIDENDS, PRIZES
Housie has multiple combinations or dividends on which prizes can be claimed. Most popular ones being Jaldi 5, Corners, Rows or Lines, Full House. Multiple claims on a dividend like 2 Full Houses are also possible.
The app supports 80+ housie variations including Breakfast, Temperature, Lockdown, 143, CID, Star, Odd/Even.
AUTOMATIC CLAIMS, BOGEYE, RESTORE BOGEY
Online players tap on an available dividend to claim prize. Prize claims are automatically verified. App automatically checks the ticket's number against the called numbers. Player wins the prize if the claim is valid.
In case of an incorrect claim the ticket will be Bogey. Host has an option to restore a bogey ticket.
I-CHAT, AUTO RESPONDERS, INSIGHTS
The app features a smart chat option. Friends can post messages to each other including the host. Message options are powered by our intel system which automatically gives recommendations depending on the game play.
Insights from the game such as 'Player waiting for Full House', 'Player(s) strike at number' are automatically sent to the group to simulate offline game experience.
NO CASH PRIZE, REAL MONEY, COINS
App doesn't reward its users with any cash prizes, earn real money or win tambola coins to play the game. It's a free simulation of the real tambola game and is intended for entertainment purposes only.
IT'S ALL THE SAME
Tambola is also popularly known as Indian Bingo, Housie, Bingo 90 Ball game.
OPEN FOR ALL PUBLIC TABLES
Looking for someone to play with you? Join the public tournament, a new one happening every 10 minutes with players from all across the country.
FACEBOOK OR GUEST LOGIN
UNLIMITED, PAPERLESS, 100% FREE
DOWNLOAD NOW
MADE IN INDIA
With loads of Love

bluejetty:00123689:ios.description:
Archer Heroes!
Enter a world where existence itself is out to eliminate you! You are the Lone Archer, the only force able to resist and defeat the oncoming waves of evil.
Step up, stack up awesome skills and fight like your life depends on it, for the never-ending waves of enemies will never give up. And remember, once you die... the only way is to start all again! So be careful!
Enjoy creating countless combinations of unique skills all designed to help you survive. Crawl your way through different worlds facing relentless monsters and obstacles. 
Key Features:
 • Random and unique skills to help you crawl these dungeons. 
 • Explore beautiful worlds and hundreds of maps in this new universe. 
 • Thousands of never-seen-before monsters and mind-boggling obstacles to defeat
 • Level-up and equip yourself with powerful equipment to increase your stats. 
If you have any questions, feel free to ask us anytime at: archero@habby.fun
Details on Subscriptions
1. Subscription Pricing & Billing
You can subscribe within the game for ‘Subscription Privileges’, for $2.99 a calendar month. 
2. Subscription Content
Subscribers can enjoy the following privileges during the period:
- Daily Quick Raids +3
- Daily BattlePass XP +50
- Daily Bonus Gems +50
3. Auto Renewals
The App Store Subscription feature renews automatically via your iTunes Account. Users can manage the subscription through your iTunes/Apple ID Settings Manager. The subscription will auto-renew for the assigned billing period if the auto-renew feature is not turned off 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
4. User Agreement and Privacy Policy
User Agreement https://www.habby.com/termsOfSubscription.html
Privacy Statement https://www.habby.fun/privacyPolicy.html
5. Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’ and select the subscription for ‘Archero’ to cancel it.

All Cars Crash is a realistic 3D car crash and crash simulator in which you have to go through all the extreme driving lessons. Test the car for strength, take part in cool missions, perform difficult stunts, tune and improve the car, earn experience and become a driving pro. The destruction of cars is as close to real as possible, and all body parts can quickly wrinkle or even fall off from severe accidents.
The biggest locations are already waiting for you. Multi-level roads, giant jumps and ramps, many different traps and obstacles that will meet on your way. We are always trying to make All Cars Crash better and more interesting, and for this, your opinion is very important to us, because perhaps we will implement one of your ideas in the next update. Leave your suggestions and comments in the reviews for the game or to us at zeroonegamescontact@gmail.com
See you in the game!

Vlue ridesharing is making driving on your own time worth it again. Higher earnings. More freedom. With flat fees and a flexible ride system. Drivers can finally choose the eligible tiers that make the most money.
Stop being penalized for rides that cost you money. Stop guessing how much you’ll earn for every ride. Ride fees never change on Vlue - no matter the length or distance.
Ready to drive for more? Just download/install and apply through the Vlue Driver app. Most drivers are approved in minutes.

Why Vlue?
Vlue puts the sharing in ridesharing with a rewarding and affordable experience for our drivers. Our unique algorithm makes ridesharing efficient and easy to pass our savings on to you. By driving with Vlue, you’re supporting a network of riders and drivers who believe in an affordable future for ridesharing.

o Smoother navigation and enhanced search capabilities to easily browse Hot Topic apparel, accessories, collectibles and home décor.
o Improved stability for seamless app experience. 
o Easily add must-have merch to your Wishlist.

o Use HT Reservations to book an in-store shopping reservation and skip the line.
o Score the latest promotions, deals and discounts.
o Keep track of your HT Guest List points and rewards.
o Easily manage your account activity and info, and track your order status.
o Quick access to customer service FAQs.
We'd love to hear from you! Email your feedback about our app or any questions to appsupport@hottopic.com.

bluejetty:00161995:ios.description:
Svelte Fitness: Your Home for MetaBoost Connection, One & Done & More
Hi, I’m Meredith Shirk, founder and CEO of Svelte. Welcome to the Svelte App — the home of MetaBoost Connection, One & Done, and other Svelte fitness and nutrition programs.
If you purchased one of our programs, you’re in the right place. Simply log in to access your workouts, nutrition resources, program content, and more all in one place. Designed to help you feel stronger, healthier, and more confident - the Svelte App gives you the tools and support to keep moving toward your goals, regardless of age, fitness level, or previous injury. 
Inside the Svelte App:
Your Programs: Access MetaBoost Connection, One & Done, and other Svelte programs.
Workouts: Follow low impact workouts designed by a NASM certified expert for different fitness levels and goals.
Nutrition: Access meal plans, recipes, and practical nutrition resources put together by a nutrition specialist. 
Progress Tracking: Track your journey and goals in one place
Community Support: Join a global community of like-minded individuals aiming for a healthier life.
Expert Guidance: Direct access to advice from Meredith Shirk and her expert team – seasoned professionals in fitness and nutrition.
Why Choose Svelte Fitness?
Experience & Expertise: Founded by a top athlete and recognized fitness expert, Meredith Shirk.
Holistic Approach: We focus on sustainable health, not just quick fixes. Our philosophy: "Less is more, small changes make a big difference."
Empowerment: We provide tools for long-term success, helping you regain control of your health.
Innovation: Continuously evolving to meet customer needs with effective fitness programs, practical nutrition resources, informative content, and online coaching.
One App. All Your Svelte Programs.
Whether you’re following MetaBoost Connection, One & Done, or another Svelte program, you’ll find your workouts, nutrition resources, and program content together in the Svelte App.
Log in and continue your journey today.
