bluejetty:00100352:ios.description:
Experience the perfect mix of Jigsaw satisfaction and Solitaire strategy.
Puzzle Solitaire challenges you to slide and combine scattered cards to reveal beautiful hidden photos. With a satisfying "snap" mechanics and smooth controls, it’s the ultimate relaxing brain teaser.
Game Features:
Satisfying Gameplay: Feel the thrill as cards lock perfectly into place. Watch the chaos turn into a masterpiece with every move.
Intuitive Controls: Simply swipe to slide cards. Once matched, connected cards move together, making gameplay smooth and easy.
Strategic Fun: Simple to learn, but hard to master. Manage card layers and board space to solve the puzzle.
Stunning Visuals: Complete a wide variety of themed photos, from nature and animals to art and landscapes.
How to Play:
Swipe: Slide cards horizontally or vertically across the board.
Connect: Match edges to snap cards together into a single group.
Reveal: Combine all pieces correctly to complete the photo!
Ready for a satisfying snap? Download Puzzle Solitaire and start piecing it together!

bluejetty:00155802:ios.summary: The Fashion News Lifestyle Network combines everyone’s favorite things: fashion, film, travel, beauty, health and reality TV. With this TV app, you’ll be able to access all your favorite FNL Network TV shows on the go 24 hours a day 7 days
bluejetty:00155802:ios.description:
The Fashion News Lifestyle Network combines everyone’s favorite things: fashion, film, travel, beauty, health and reality TV. With this TV app, you’ll be able to access all your favorite FNL Network TV shows on the go 24 hours a day 7 days a week for FREE! 
With over 20 TV shows on the network, The Fashion News Lifestyle is on the cutting edge of trends and glamour while continuously pushes the boundaries of modern media. Get insights into the lives of industry professionals; Hear true stories from well-known figures; Watch an array of award-winning films and TV shows and be transported from couch to catwalk within seconds.
What you’ll get:
- Front row access to International Digital Fashion Week
- ALL ACCESS: get exclusive access to our latest TV shows only streaming on FNL Network
- At home or on-the-go experience: Watch while you travel, on your daily commute, or from
the comfort of your own couch.
- The only TV Network that showcases runway shows and backstage interviews at Fashion Weeks and much more from around the world
- Provides award-winning programming for all ages
- The only TV Network and network to provide programming in American Sign Language
- 24/7 access to your favorite programming
FNL Network is your go-to for travel, fashion and beauty coverage with our award-winning series like City Showcase, Fashion News Live, Model Diaries, and Film Corner, as well as behind-the-scenes footage of prestigious Fashion Week events from around the world.
FNL Network goes beyond the glitz and glamour like no other TV network. FNL Network frames the high-profile fashion industry as a relevant and exciting cultural landscape for a global audience by showcasing events, individuals, and brands that advance social and artistic abilities. This multifaceted approach to entertainment offers a comprehensive lineup of shows that excite, inspire, and awe on FNL Network, fashion is only the tip of the iceberg.
FNL Network brings you intimate interviews with a wide variety of fashion-forward personalities like Kim Kardashian, Kendall Jenner, AnnaLynne McCord, Selena Gomez, Cindy Crawford, Paris Hilton, Alan Cumming, Dita Von Teese, Simonetta Lein, Jay Manuel, Gigi Hadid, Rocco Leo Gaglioti and so many more.
Programs such as Carol Alt’s Living Room, a talk show hosted by supermodel Carol Alt, featuring in-depth interviews with fashion and entertainment icons, such as Iris Apfel and Stuart Weitzman.
Start streaming FNL Network on your Apple TV, iPhone, Mac Computer or iPad today!
Subscription:
• The FNL Network app is 100% Free.. No subscription needed. 
• Price of subscription: $0.00 / Month
Terms and conditions: http://fnlnetwork.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy policy: http://fnlnetwork.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00087351:ios.description:
Meet Ask HouGarden — the AI way to find your next home in New Zealand and Australia.
Just describe what you want in your own words: "Three-bedroom with a sea view, under $1.5M, in a good school zone." HouGarden's AI understands and finds it — including the things you could never filter for before.
SEARCH WHAT OTHERS CAN'T
Sea views, subdivision potential, north-facing aspect, walking distance to a top school — ask in plain language and let AI do the searching.
STOP SCROLLING. START ASKING.
No more endless filters and infinite scrolling. Ask a question and get matched homes in seconds.
EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• Buy, rent and recently sold listings across NZ & Australia
• Free property estimates with a low–mid–high range and a 5-year trend
• Interactive map with school zones, new developments and a price heatmap
• Detailed listing pages: photos, video, floor area, open homes and your own viewing notes
• Property news and market insights, in English and Chinese
BUILT FOR EVERYONE
HouGarden is a multilingual platform made for NZ and Australia's diverse communities, with full English and Chinese support.
Describe it. We'll find it. Download HouGarden and try Ask HouGarden today.
Estimates are indicative only and are not a registered valuation.

bluejetty:00176504:ios.summary: Have you ever dreamt of entering a magical wonderland full of adorable Princesses? Do it by exploring the stunning world of the spectacular game Princesses – Enchanted Castle! Play the game and step inside the magical castle – a home for ma
bluejetty:00176504:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamt of entering a magical wonderland full of adorable Princesses? Do it by exploring the stunning world of the spectacular game Princesses – Enchanted Castle! Play the game and step inside the magical castle – a home for many cute and lovely dolls you can play, dress up, and care for! 
LIVE IN THE CASTLE
Grab your magical wand and watch as a unique glass dome opens to reveal the most precious princess waiting for you! Delight your sweet ladies with tasty treats, entertain them with playful games, and explore exciting activities in the magnificent castle under your loving care. 
MEET UNIQUE PRINCESSES
It’s time to meet various Princesses, from the charming Ice and Butterfly dolls to the fantastic Cleopatra. Each doll has her special qualities, making her truly one-of-a-kind. And you know what adds an extra sprinkle of magic? The castle's flowers respond uniquely to each girl they meet. Isn't that just precious? 
DISCOVER ACTIVITIES
Boredom doesn't exist in this marvelous castle! Uncover the wonders of colorful mystery boxes and enjoy various delightful activities! Play the harp, relax on a fluffy cloud bed, admire a beautiful fountain, or hop onto a magical flying carpet – lots of amazing and fun activities await you in this game! 
PLAY MINI-GAMES
Your cute virtual friends adore mini-games, so join in and play with them! Jump and collect gold coins, get creative in a drawing game, explore a magical space, collect shiny black diamonds, and unlock the unique Princess Storm. Want more mini-games? Match dolls and enjoy! 
VISIT MAKEUP SALON
It's makeup time! Get ready to show off your creativity in this cute mini-game. Make the lovely dolls sparkle with vibrant eyeshadows, glittery blush, or colorful face paint. Made a little oopsie? Don't worry, just grab a cleaning wipe and fix it up. Let's make these Princesses shine! 
DRESS UP YOUR DOLL
Turn sweet girls into the most stylish dolls! Discover a vast collection of adorable outfits, accessories, and shoes to unleash your creativity! As you unlock more Princesses, you'll have an even wider selection of items. So, don't keep your charming friends waiting!
UPGRADE TO TUTOCLUB!
Subscribe to enjoy a huge portfolio of games with extraordinary TutoClub features:
- UNLIMITED GAME CONTENT: Exclusive access to complete games.
- NO ADS: Smooth playtime experience with no interruptions.
- SAFE SPACE ONLINE: A 100% family-friendly place with no unwelcome content.
- REGULAR UPDATES: Access to all future updates, new game releases & additional content.
- PREMIUM IN-APP PURCHASES UNLOCKED: TutoClub members enjoy exclusive content.
- FUN FOR ALL AGES: Original TutoTOONS games designed for boys & girls aged 3–8 & up.
- LEARNING THROUGH PLAY: Carefully curated selection of games that cherish creativity, self-expression, responsibility, attention to detail & problem solving skills.
Become a TutoClub member today & ensure enriching playtime experiences for your kids! Find out more: https://tutotoons.com/tutoclub/

→ Inversiones y dólar: comprá dólar oficial/MEP o podés invertir tu plata en plazos fijos, FCI, bonos, CEDEARs y acciones.
→ Cuenta remunerada: más usás la app, más rinden tus pesos.

→ Préstamos: simulá tu crédito a medida y recibí la plata al instante.

⇨ Rendimientos altos: haz crecer tu dinero si traes tu nómina o incrementas tus consumos.
⇨ Portabilidad: pasa tu nómina a Ualá y desbloquea el acceso a mejores beneficios financieros.
⇨ Reserva a plazo: aparta tu dinero desde $10 hasta $3,000,000 y recibe ganancias fijas en la fecha que tú elijas.
Ualá Colombia
⇨ Rendimientos diarios: tu plata no descansa y crece todos los días directo en tu cuenta.
⇨ Consigna, recibe, envía y retira plata, gratis y desde un mismo lugar.
REQUISITOS DE CONTRATACIÓN
Argentina: ser mayor de 13 años y tener tu DNI argentino vigente. Si eres extranjer@, puedes pedirla con tu DNI argentino y CUIL.
México: ser mayor de 18 años y tener tu INE/IFE vigente. Si eres extranjer@, puedes pedir tu tarjeta de débito Ualá con tu tarjeta de residencia. Consulta los requisitos de contratación, comisiones y promociones en Ualá - Tu banco como debería ser hoy. ¡Haz crecer tu dinero!

Depósito de bajo monto sujeto a reglamento. Aplican términos y condiciones. Más información en Ualá - Lo hacemos fácil . Bancar Tecnología CO S.A Compañía de Financiamiento, Vigilada por la Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, inscrito a Fogafin (CO).

bluejetty:00154342:ios.name: Mystery of Myths: Fjords
bluejetty:00154342:ios.summary: "Mystery of Myths: Mystery of the Fjords" - the fate of the world hangs in the balance in this mystery game packed with legendary creatures, Nordic folklore, and mind-bending puzzles! As a top agent in the Ministry of Mysteries, Elijah Reed
bluejetty:00154342:ios.description:
"Mystery of Myths: Mystery of the Fjords" - the fate of the world hangs in the balance in this mystery game packed with legendary creatures, Nordic folklore, and mind-bending puzzles! As a top agent in the Ministry of Mysteries, Elijah Reed has faced many perils, but none quite like this. Ragnarok looms, and only through wit, cunning, and an expert eye for detail can he stop it. Travel through Yggdrasil, meet ancient gods, and uncover the secrets that could save—or doom—humanity. If you love hidden object games, item search games, and thrilling adventure games, this quest is calling your name. Will you rise to the challenge?
Elijah Reed, a seasoned agent for the Ministry of Mysteries, is no stranger to pulse-pounding missions and high-stakes challenges. So when he's dispatched to the quiet Norwegian town of Bergen, he's ready for monsters, mythical creatures, and ancient magic. But what do you pack when you're tasked with saving the world from certain doom? What gift do you bring to a mighty Valkyrie and a magical squirrel? And, most pressing of all, does the Ministry's expense account cover inter-dimensional travel through the realms of Yggdrasil?
· Hidden Objects!
Find hidden objects in breathtaking locations across the realms of Yggdrasil! Search for lost relics in Asgard, track down myths and monsters in Midgard, and uncover powerful artifacts hidden deep within Jotunheim!
· Mind-bending Puzzles!
Solve puzzle adventure games with the intrigue of detective games! Outsmart Loki’s tricks, unlock magical artifacts, and follow an ancient prophecy before time runs out. These immersive challenges make item search games more exciting than ever!
· Explore the mythical World Tree!
Travel through Midgard, Jotunheim, and even Asgard as you gather clues, meet legendary beings, and uncover the truth behind the coming of Ragnarok. With every new location, there are hidden object games moments that require sharp observation and critical thinking!
· Heart-racing Storyline!
Item search games, Norse mythology, and high-stakes espionage! You’ll need to find hidden objects, analyze evidence, and solve complex cases to protect humanity from the wrath of the gods. A must-play for fans of detective games, this epic adventure will keep you on the edge of your seat!
"Mystery of Myths: Mystery of the Fjords" is the challenge you’ve been waiting for! Prepare to find hidden objects in the free trial!

bluejetty:00138366:ios.summary: Discover Auction Values, your essential free resource providing you with the latest auction prices on construction machinery, farm equipment, trucks, trailers, RVs, attachments, and more. Whether you're an auctioneer, equipment dealer, priv
bluejetty:00138366:ios.description:
Discover Auction Values, your essential free resource providing you with the latest auction prices on construction machinery, farm equipment, trucks, trailers, RVs, attachments, and more. Whether you're an auctioneer, equipment dealer, private owner, industry decision-maker, or buyer, Auction Values helps you quickly determine an asset's current market value in live or online auctions.
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF AUCTION RESULTS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
Browse a comprehensive database of auction listings featuring detailed information on equipment, commercial vehicles, attachments, and more. Compare "apples to apples" on machinery with similar feature lists to make informed selling or purchasing decisions.
Use advanced search tools to filter auction listings by keywords, equipment category, industry, auction company, equipment details, and other specifications. Detailed search filters help you hone in on the exact models and options you're interested in, saving time and ensuring accuracy.
WIDE RANGE OF EQUIPMENT CATEGORIES
Access auction results for various equipment types:
- Construction machinery: excavators, wheel loaders, dozers, skid steers, lifts, and more
- Farm equipment: tractors, combine harvesters, hay and forage equipment, planters, livestock trailers, forestry and tree care equipment
- Heavy-duty and medium-duty trucks: day cabs, sleeper trucks, dump trucks, grain trucks, flatbeds, semitrailers
- Livestock, horses, hay/straw, and land values
COMPREHENSIVE INDUSTRY COVERAGE
Although powered by AuctionTime and Equipmentfacts, Auction Values goes the extra mile by including aggregated auction results from other platforms and numerous auction houses across the United States and Canada. This industry-wide approach provides unparalleled access to real-world auction values across agriculture, construction, and transportation markets.
STAY INFORMED WITH MARKET INSIGHTS
View a continually updated calendar of upcoming auctions and sign up for monthly market reports to monitor the latest inventory and value trends and forecasts.
BACKED BY INDUSTRY LEADERS
Auction Values is a product of Sandhills Global, the company behind trusted brands such as Machinery Trader, TractorHouse, Truck Paper, AuctionTime, and Equipmentfacts, serving buyers and sellers in the construction, agriculture, trucking, and aviation industries.
GET THE AUCTION VALUES APP NOW
Join thousands of industry professionals who rely on Auction Values to make informed decisions about equipment and truck values. Download the app today to access free, up-to-date auction prices and market insights

bluejetty:00144021:ios.summary: Unlock endless customization possibilities of your Apple Watch with Watch Faces Gallery app! Get over 27,000 exclusive watch faces for all Apple Watch Series. Whether you prefer classic, animated, sports, retro, or holiday watch faces, our
bluejetty:00144021:ios.description:
Unlock endless customization possibilities of your Apple Watch with Watch Faces Gallery app! Get over 27,000 exclusive watch faces for all Apple Watch Series. Whether you prefer classic, animated, sports, retro, or holiday watch faces, our app has a lot of collections for everyone. A powerful watch face editor lets you create your own custom designs of watch faces for your Apple Watch.
FEATURES
- Exclusive and high quality watch faces for everyone.
- Watch faces with Complications & Widgets, animated watch faces, photo and portrait watch faces.
- Powerful watch face editor. You can change something or create your own and unique watch face.
- Compatible with all Apple Watch Series.
- One-tap watch face installation.
- TOP Charts with free and premium watch faces.
- Updates every week.
- Detailed instructions for all kinds of issues.
WATCH FACES WITH COMPLICATIONS
- The data on the watch faces is updated every 15 minutes.
- HealthKit is used to display your activity on the watch faces and widgets.
- Watch faces with complications work on all Apple Watches starting with Apple Watch Series 4 (Series 4, Series 5, Series 6, Series 7, Series 8, Series 9, Series 10, SE, SE 2, Series ULTRA and Series ULTRA 2).
ANIMATED WATCH FACES
- For animated watch faces to work properly, you should turn off the “Always On” feature on your Apple Watch.
- Animated watch face plays for 3 seconds every time you raise your wrist.
WATCH FACE EDITOR
- You can edit animated, photo and portrait watch faces. You can also create your own unique watch face.
- Change the text, background, time style and more!
IMPORTANT
- The app uses your geolocation to properly display the weather forecast.
- The app uses data from HealthKit to properly display activity data.

bluejetty:00162717:ios.name: Choreographic: Dance Formation
bluejetty:00162717:ios.summary: Choreographic is the fast, modern choreography app for planning dance formations and dancer positioning. Visualize formations on stage, fine-tune custom dancer paths, animate transitions in 3D, sync to music, collaborate in real time, and k
bluejetty:00162717:ios.description:
Choreographic is the fast, modern choreography app for planning dance formations and dancer positioning. Visualize formations on stage, fine-tune custom dancer paths, animate transitions in 3D, sync to music, collaborate in real time, and keep creating offline.
REAL-TIME COLLABORATION
Build the same choreography together with your team and watch changes appear instantly across devices.
3D FORMATION VIEW
Visualize formations from any angle for a realistic preview of your dancers on stage.
CUSTOM DANCER PATHS
Create curves, arcs, and multi-point routes to shape exactly how dancers move between formations. Preview every path during playback in both 2D and 3D.
OFFLINE EDITING
Make choreographies and crews available offline, continue editing without a connection, and sync your changes when you reconnect.
MUSIC SYNC
See transitions hit every count as dancers move in time with your selected track.
CUSTOM FOLDER PERMISSIONS
Choose who can view or edit each folder. Keep drafts private and share finished work with the right people.
CREATE REUSABLE CREWS
Save multiple crews and reuse them across choreographies.
DISCOVER FORMATION IDEAS
Browse choreographies hand-picked by our team and save favorites to your Library with a tap.
SET TRANSITION DURATION PRECISELY
Set formation and transition timing down to 0.01s with millisecond precision to plan exact travel time.
SMOOTH TRANSITION SLIDING
Slide through each transition with smooth animation to see movement step by step, helping dancers visualize precise travel paths from set to set and avoid collisions.
CUSTOM STAGE SIZE
Set exact stage width and depth, plus side and back stage areas, so spacing matches the venue.
ADD STAGE PROPS
Add props and visualize interactions. Animate position, shape, size, and color.
SELECT & EDIT DANCERS BY COLOR
Color-code sections, then select by color to visualize interactions and make group edits in one step.
ADD NOTES TO FORMATIONS
Attach notes to any formation so dancers understand intent in context.
POWERFUL SEARCH
Find any choreography, crew, or folder in seconds.
CHOREOGRAPHIC PRO TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION
Start a 14-day free trial with the annual plan. After the trial, your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase confirmation. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://choreographic.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://choreographic.app/privacy

bluejetty:00167982:ios.description:
Welcome to Match Pair Puzzle - a fun and addictive matching game that will keep you entertained for hours! Dive into a vibrant world filled with colorful items, from adorable animals to Easter eggs and various small objects. Your mission is simple: click on the items to place them in the grid below. Match two identical items, and watch them pop and disappear!
How to Play:
Click & Place: Tap on any item to place it in the grid.
Match & Pop: When you place two identical items in the grid, they will match and pop, clearing space for more items.
Strategize: Plan your moves carefully to create combos and clear the grid faster.
Boosters & Power-ups: Use special boosters to help you when you get stuck or to achieve higher scores.
Features:
Engaging Gameplay: Simple yet challenging mechanics that are easy to learn but hard to master.
Vibrant Graphics: Enjoy the colorful and 3D cartoon-style graphics that make the game visually appealing.
Various Items: Match a wide range of items including cute animals, colorful Easter eggs, and various small objects.
Power-ups & Boosters: Unlock and use exciting power-ups and boosters to enhance your gameplay experience.
Why You'll Love Match Pair Puzzle:
Addictive Fun: The perfect game to relax and have fun, whether you have a few minutes or a few hours.

bluejetty:00060945:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00060945:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for Boston Logan Airport (BOS). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at Boston Logan Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every BOS flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Boston Logan Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.
Terms of Use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy
http://flightinfoapps.com/flightinfoapps-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00073953:ios.description:
Dotloop is the leading online transaction and productivity optimization platform in real estate. 
With dotloop for mobile, access your transactions on any device, anytime, anywhere.
* Inman News Innovator of the Year.
* Featured in TechCrunch, Bloomberg, WSJ, and the cover of Entrepreneur Magazine.
Millions of agents, brokers, and clients use dotloop for form creation, e-sign, transaction management, productivity tools, workflow automation, and analytics - all within a single end-to-end solution. 
TRANSACTIONS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Be there when opportunity knocks: create loops (collaborative workspaces) in seconds and keep transactions going by sharing documents from your device, whether from apps – like Dropbox – or office-provided templates or email.
STAY IN THE LOOP
Loops have all you need to collaborate in real-time, manage tasks, and track progress. Receive instant notifications when signing is required, documents have been signed or shared, or any changes are made to your deal.
CLOSE FASTER
Use your device to easily add and assign signatures, initials, and other fields on-the-spot, or to sign documents with clients in person.
---
NOT YET A DOTLOOP SUBSCRIBER?
Dotloop for mobile is free to use for a limited number of loops. For full features, use the app to subscribe to dotloop Premium for $29.99 monthly or $299.99 annual billing.
DOTLOOP PREMIUM 
If you upgrade your account to a monthly or annual, your subscription will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Membership will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of your current period and identify the cost of the renewal. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
---
Questions, suggestions, comments, or bugs? Email us at: support@dotloop.com
We’re looking forward to hearing from you!
Terms of Service: https://www.dotloop.com/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.dotloop.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00137462:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into the ultimate floor plan creator with 3D Snap, powered by cutting-edge LiDAR and AI.
Renovating your home or rearranging furniture? Moving and want to make sure everything will fit in your new apartment? 3D Snap lets you scan rooms in seconds, saving you hours of manual measuring. Just point your camera and start scanning. The smart LiDAR and AI technologies capture walls, doors, and furniture—delivering complete floor plans, 3D models, and precise dimensions instantly. Join 2 million+ professionals and DIY enthusiasts who plan smarter.
WHY 3D SNAP?
• Time saved: Scan a room in 30 seconds.
• No LiDAR required: AI-powered photo scanning creates a full 3D room plan on any device.
• Accuracy you can trust: Measure walls, areas, and furniture for draft planning and fit checks.
• Photo to 3D: Capture objects with a single photo for instant 3D visualization.
• Professional exports: Share floor plans and 3D models as PDFs or import them into design software.
• Easy to use: DIYers and pros alike can scan, plan, and visualize without technical skills.
FLOOR PLAN CREATOR 
Need a floor plan for a contractor or client? Scan any room and get a complete layout instantly. Just walk through with your camera, and walls, doors, and furniture will appear automatically. Get accurate results in just 30 seconds.
3D OBJECT SCANNER 
Capture any object in full 3D—even items in hard-to-reach places, like ceiling lights, high windows, or tall bookcases. Just snap a photo and let AI create a 3D prototype instantly. Perfect for checking how furniture will fit into your space or creating references for custom orders.
MEASURE & ALIGN TOOLS 
Point your camera at any surface to get instant dimensions with the AR ruler. Calculate areas for flooring or paint estimates. Check horizontal and vertical alignment to hang art or level shelves. 
EXPORT & SHARE 
Save your scans as PDFs, 3D files, or images. Send floor plans to contractors, import models into design software, or add them to client proposals. Your scans will be ready for any professional workflow, straight from your iPhone.
DECOR & VISUALIZATION
Experiment with colors and textures for floors and walls using single-click presets. Try different furniture arrangements to see how your space will look before you buy, build, or renovate.
Your all-in-one 3D scanner app is here. Download 3D Snap and turn any space into a plan!
3D Snap PRO
– Subscribe to get access to all features. You will be charged after your purchase is confirmed.
– Subscriptions auto-renew 24 hours before the expiration date. You can manage your subscriptions in Account Settings on the App Store.
Terms of Use: http://bpmob.com/3d_scan_ios/terms/en/ 
Privacy Policy: http://bpmob.com/3d_scan_ios/privacy/en/

bluejetty:00128780:ios.description:
Download the Noticias Telemundo app to get breaking news in Spanish about the US, Mexico, the rest of Latin America, and the world. Watch live video and livestream events in Spanish to keep tabs on the stories that most affect Latino communities in the US and around the world.
Mantente al día con la aplicación de Noticias Telemundo: las últimas noticias en español de Estados Unidos, México, Latinoamérica y el mundo, transmisiones en vivo, videos, noticias de hoy que afectan a la comunidad latina en Estados Unidos y el mundo, y las noticias internacionales de última hora en español.
Get the headlines and live news in Spanish: turn on your alerts and notifications to get in-depth coverage on immigration, politics, elections, economy, health, coronavirus, environment, finance, education, culture, LGBTQ, national and international news. 
Stay up to date with the stories from your country: latest news from Mexico, Venezuela, Colombia, Cuba, Puerto Rico, El Salvador, Honduras, Peru, and the rest of South and Central America, and the Caribbean.
Did you miss a newscast? Enjoy content from your favorite Noticias Telemundo shows: 
- Noticias Telemundo Mediodía, with Felicidad Aveleyra
- Noticias Telemundo 6:30 pm, with Julio Vaqueiro
- Noticias Telemundo en la noche, with Vanessa Hauc
- and our morning show, hoy Día
And more:
- Investigative and exclusive reporting.
- Watch livestream events of national and international breaking news.
- Noticias Telemundo Podcasts.
- Live breaking news from the US-Mexico border.
- Latest COVID-19 updates in the US and Latin America, analysis and in depth coverage from our journalists.
- Watch our livestreams while browsing the app.
- Explore our sections: Últimas noticias, Coronavirus, Inmigración, Estados Unidos, México, América Latina, Internacional, Investiga, Planeta Tierra and Podcasts.

bluejetty:00092516:ios.description:
Grove Bank & Trust Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Grove Bank & Trust Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Grove Bank & Trust Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Grove Bank & Trust Mobile digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Send and receive text messages using SMS from your business number to communicate with clients and coworkers on the spot.

Send files through your mobile device with secure and easy online faxing. Attach files from Dropbox, Box, Google Drive, or any Microsoft Office application, or submit faxes online via email.

WHO IS THIS APP FOR?
- Students of Spiritism
- Those interested in Allan Kardec's work
- People seeking serious, systematized, and organized study
START NOW
Download for free and transform the way you study.

bluejetty:00172145:ios.description:
Bookings, Payments, and Client Management for Barbers. Ring My Barber is the ultimate scheduling app that empowers independent barbers, solo professionals, and shop owners to accept online bookings 24/7, collect deposits, reduce no-shows, and grow their clientele—all from one platform.
Stop juggling calls, texts, and DMs. Use the Ring My Barber app on your phone, tablet, or desktop to securely manage your entire operation. Try it FREE for 7 days to set up your online booking system and professional portfolio—no credit card required!
For Barbers & Barbershops
1. Online Booking: Clients can schedule with you anytime—no calls needed.
2. Client Management: Track appointment history, payments, no-shows, and notes.
3. Payments & Deposits: Secure your time by accepting deposits or full payments through integrated Stripe or Square.
4. Automated Reminders: Send SMS, push, and email reminders to drastically reduce last-minute cancellations.
5. 100 Free SMS Each Month: Sent on your subscription renewal date.
6. No-Show Control: Review client behavior before accepting new bookings.
7. Portfolio Page: Share services, pricing, photos, and availability—like a mini website.
8. Mass Messaging: Notify all clients instantly of schedule changes or special offers.
9. Double Booking Option: Available for managing multiple clients simultaneously.
10. Flexible Scheduling: Easily block personal time, holidays, and set your own availability.
11. Multi-View Calendar: See your schedule daily, 3-day, or weekly at a glance.
12. Free Web Version: Works great on desktops and tablets: https://book.ringmybarber.com
13. Dedicated Support: In-app chat with responses in under 24 hours.
14. Free Migration: Moving from another app? We'll help you bring your data over.
Professional Subscription
* 7-Day Free Trial – No credit card required.
* $9.99/month or $96.99/year (Save 19%).
Subscription auto-renews unless canceled 24 hours before the current period ends.
Manage your subscription in your App Store account.
View Terms of Use: https://www.ringmybarber.com/terms-and-conditions
For Clients
Clients use the Ring My Barber app 100% free.
They can browse profiles, check availability, book services, and pay online with zero added fees.
Download Ring My Barber today and build a successful business, your way.
Questions?
Email: info@ringmybarber.com
Website: https://www.ringmybarber.com
Contact: https://www.ringmybarber.com/contact
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@RingMyPro

◆ Daily gifts reward hints and coins.
◆ Free updates with added themes, puzzles, music, words, and more!
If you enjoy word games, puzzle games, and brain training exercises, we’re sure you’ll love Word Blocks Connect Stacks.
Start connecting those word stacks today!
Be sure to leave a positive review if you enjoy the game. Thank you for playing!

bluejetty:00200117:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00200117:ios.description:
Conduit is a native mobile client for Open WebUI, direct model endpoints, and self-hosted agents. Your chats live on your device first. Nothing routes through a backend the maintainer operates.
Three ways to connect
- Open WebUI — your self-hosted server with chats, folders, notes, channels, workspace, tools, web search, and image generation
- Direct — OpenAI-compatible APIs, Ollama, OpenRouter, and local endpoints. No Open WebUI account required
- Hermes — your self-hosted agent with live tools, approvals for sensitive steps, and scheduled work
Built for mobile
- Real-time streaming chat with model selection, temporary chats, search, and folders
- File, image, audio, and clipboard uploads for multimodal prompts
- Voice input, voice-call mode, share sheet, quick actions, home screen widgets, and Shortcuts
- Rich rendering for Markdown, code, LaTeX, Mermaid, Chart.js, citations, reasoning, and tool calls
- Notes, saved prompts, channels, terminal, and other features when your server supports them
Built for real deployments
- Sign in with username/password, LDAP, JWT, OAuth/SSO, reverse-proxy flows, and custom HTTP headers
- Credentials stored securely in Keychain
- No ads, no analytics SDKs, and no developer-operated relay server
Important
- Conduit does not host models or provide an AI service. You connect to servers and providers you control.
- Available features depend on what you connect to.
- Conduit is open source and is not officially affiliated with Open WebUI or Hermes.

listings.name: Conduit: Open WebUI & AI
listings.description:
Conduit is a native mobile client for Open WebUI, LibreChat, direct model endpoints, Apple Intelligence, and self-hosted agents. Your chats live on your device first. No service the developer runs receives your chats.

Ways to connect
- Open WebUI — your self-hosted server with chats, folders, notes, channels, workspace, tools, web search, and image generation
- LibreChat (beta) — your self-hosted server with synced chats, agents, model specs, web search, code, MCP tools, and memories
- Direct — OpenAI-compatible APIs, Ollama, OpenRouter, and local endpoints. No Open WebUI account required
- Apple Intelligence — Apple's on-device model, even offline, or Private Cloud Compute on eligible devices. No API key needed
- Hermes — your self-hosted agent with live tools, approvals for sensitive steps, and scheduled work

Built for mobile
- Real-time streaming chat with model selection, temporary chats, search, and folders
- File, image, audio, and clipboard uploads for multimodal prompts
- Voice input, voice-call mode, share sheet, quick actions, home screen widgets, and Shortcuts
- Optional push notifications for finished replies, channel messages, and Hermes jobs, encrypted on your own server
- Rich rendering for Markdown, code, LaTeX, Mermaid, Chart.js, citations, reasoning, and tool calls
- Notes, saved prompts, channels, terminal, and other features when your server supports them

Built for real deployments
- Sign in with username/password, LDAP, JWT, OAuth/SSO with passkeys, reverse-proxy flows, and custom HTTP headers
- Credentials stored securely in Keychain
- No ads and no analytics SDKs. Optional push notifications pass through an open-source relay that can't read them

Important
- Conduit does not host models or provide an AI service. You connect to servers and providers you control.
- Available features depend on what you connect to.
- Conduit is open source and is not officially affiliated with Open WebUI, LibreChat, or Hermes.

bluejetty:00173083:ios.description:
Puzzle lovers, challenge yourself, train your brain, test your vocabulary, enjoy this unique free sentence making word search game. Enhance your memory, sorting words in correct order, with a funny way. Tap into your cognitive abilities and tap on the scrambled words to assemble them into coherent formation.Play one of the best free word game.
Play this free offline game without the internet. Change the order of words to form sentences and phrases in an entertaining way with this masterclass word game. Guess the popular sayings, try to find out words and engage in an entertaining and enlightening word puzzle experience.
You do not need to rush as there is no time limitation. This word unscramble game is one of the best ways of relaxing. To aid players, our word puzzle sentence builder game offers valuable boosters, making gameplay sessions easier. Prepare to be captivated by a calming, addictive word puzzle game experience like no other. Challenge your intellect, enhance your memory, fulfill your spare time and improve your game skills. Get ready to be surprised by learning unknown English proverbs! Enjoy a calming, relaxing and addictive word puzzle game all at once. 
Features:
- Thousands of levels and unique word puzzle challenges
- Relaxing background and user friendly UI to enhance word puzzle experience
- Amazing and attractive themes
- Cool animation effects to enhance your gaming experience in the word game.
- Soothing sound effects and music
- Great exercise for both kids and adults
- Earn boosters and rewards for every correct answer 
- No internet connection required
- Play free offline anytime and anywhere

Discover the joy of improving your sentence master and brain skills, and expanding your vocabulary and memory through engaging word puzzles.
Download Sentence That: Word Game for free now and embark on an exhilarating adventure where limitless fun intertwines with knowledge and language skills improvement in this word puzzle game. Explore the realm of games without Internet - your ticket to endless offline adventures.
Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube for updates and more fun word games. Stay connected with Sentence That: Word Game and explore other exciting language learning opportunities through word puzzles.

bluejetty:00185071:ios.summary: Stay informed with trusted journalism from NBC News — your source for breaking news, latest news updates, live video, and in-depth reporting, all in one powerful app. Whether you’re tracking election results, following political news from W
bluejetty:00185071:ios.description:
Stay informed with trusted journalism from NBC News — your source for breaking news, latest news updates, live video, and in-depth reporting, all in one powerful app. Whether you’re tracking election results, following political news from Washington, catching up on world headlines, or watching live breaking news, the NBC News app keeps you informed wherever you are.
Get real-time breaking news alerts, top headlines, and live updates across U.S. news, world news, politics, business, technology, science, health, and entertainment.
Follow the latest politics news, updates, and results of the 2026 midterm elections, including live election results, congressional races, and in-depth coverage of House and Senate candidates across the country. Track key battleground states, major campaign developments, and real-time vote counts with expert analysis from award-winning journalists.
Watch live streaming news 24/7 on NBC News NOW and stream full episodes of Meet the Press, NBC Nightly News, Dateline, and more. Read exclusive reporting, follow live blogs, explore special investigations, and stay connected to the major events and developing stories shaping your world.
NBC NEWS SUBSCRIPTION
Upgrade your experience with an NBC News subscription — bringing you the best of NBC News, all in one place. Available through in-app purchase or on NBCNews.com. Cancel anytime in your App Store settings.
- Full access to exclusive reporting, expert analysis and original video from NBC News journalists.
- Subscriber-only Q&As from Steve Kornacki, Lester Holt, and other anchors and reporters covering the biggest stories in politics, pop culture, sports and more.
- Stream NBC News NOW and watch full episodes of Nightly News, Dateline and Meet the Press on demand.
- Go deeper into the stories shaping our world with subscriber-only newsletters and podcasts delivered to you daily.
- Support best-in-class journalism — helping people understand what’s happening and why it matters through fact-based reporting, meaningful conversations, and powerful stories from our journalists around the world.
CREATE A FREE NBC NEWS ACCOUNT
Sign up for a free NBC News account and enjoy additional features in the app.
- Listen to NBC News articles wherever your day takes you. Sign in to your free account, tap play at the top of any article, and follow the story hands-free.
- Save stories and videos to your library, then come back anytime to catch up on the NBC News coverage that matters to you.
- Add your ZIP code to personalize your NBC News account with local headlines, weather forecasts and updates for your area.
- Choose newsletters that match your interests, including breaking news, politics, sports, Dateline and more, and manage your preferences anytime.
NBC NEWS APP FEATURES
Watch live, read the latest headlines, track election results, and stay connected to trusted NBC News coverage anytime, anywhere.
- Breaking news alerts and push notifications for real-time updates on breaking stories and the latest news.
- National news and world news coverage with in-depth reporting and trusted analysis.
- Live streaming news 24/7 with NBC News NOW, including breaking news, major events and developing stories.
- Live election results, 2026 midterm elections updates, and political news from Washington and across the country.
- Local news and weather alerts tailored to your region.
PRIVACY & INFO
This app includes Nielsen’s proprietary measurement software, allowing you to contribute to market research such as Nielsen’s TV Ratings. Learn more at: nielsen.com/digitalprivacy
Do Not Sell My Personal Information: nbcuniversal.com/privacy/notrtoo?intake=NBC_News

Welcome to Roseon App
RoseonApp is a mobile one-stop crypto trading & earning app, now enhanced with the DePIN Light Node feature, allowing you to earn passive income in the form of XP! 
Trusted by over 350K+ users, RoseonApp combines crypto management with Trading, Launchpad, DeFi, Game Center and NFTs all in one place.
MAIN FEATURES:
DePIN Light Node: Earn passive XP by supporting decentralized networks. Simply run a light node, contribute to the network, and earn rewards effortlessly.
Trade: Trade like a pro at your fingertips anytime, anywhere. 
Smart Wallet: Securely deposit and withdraw tokens or NFTs, supporting 7 chains (Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Solana, OKTC, Arbitrum and Polygon zkEVM).
Staking & Lending: Earn rewards through staking or lend your crypto with competitive rates.
Farming: Access safe, high-quality farms. 
Launchpad: Participate in Token or NFT sales.
Swap & Bridge: Easily swap & bridge tokens. 
Game Center: Play & earn reward with multiple Play-to-Earn games and iGames.
NFT Gallery: Manage, store, and trade rare collectibles and in-game assets.
Portfolio Manager: Track all your crypto assets in one place.
On-Ramp Fiat: Quickly convert fiat to crypto with services like Banxa.
About Roseon
Roseon brings crypto adoption through user experience and gamification. Roseon currently has three products: RoseonX, an AI Powered Exchange with Modular Architecture, RoseonApp, a mobile one-stop crypto trading & earning app, and RoseonAI Bot. Experience the difference with our intuitive, user-friendly interfaces and gamified features that make exploring the crypto world both fun and rewarding.
Roseon's achievements: 
✅ Registered Users: 350K+ 
✅ Community Reach: 1M+ 
✅ LaunchPads: 50+ Projects Launched
✅ Chains: ETH, BSC, ARB, MATIC, OKC, SOL, zkEVM, PwrChain
✅ Accelerated by Binance Chain, Granted by Polygon

bluejetty:00180828:ios.description:
Keep your brain sharp while having fun with this puzzle game of Mahjong Solitaire.
Simple rules - match tiles to win.
Mahjong Solitaire is a very simple and straightforward game. The goal is to clear all the tiles from the board by matching them in pairs. The tiles can only be paired if they have at least one side free and no other tiles on top of them. The drawings and symbols on the tiles must be the same in order for them to match. There are two exceptions, however. The Flowers and Seasons tiles do not need to match in drawings, only in suit.
Wide variety of categories (Tech, Zodiac, Letters & Numbers, Food, Halloween, Animals and more) and beautiful layouts.

- Auto Zoom In
- Highlight free tiles
- Music and sound effects
- Show/hide timer and goals
- Daily Reward - collect prizes every day
- Easy matching gameplay
- Play offline

bluejetty:00174411:ios.name: AudioLayer
bluejetty:00174411:ios.summary: AudioLayer satisfies the most sought after gap for contemporary music production on iOS devices. AudioLayer is a full featured open standard audio multi-sampler pushing the boundaries beyond what has been available even in the desktop music
bluejetty:00174411:ios.description:
AudioLayer satisfies the most sought after gap for contemporary music production on iOS devices. AudioLayer is a full featured open standard audio multi-sampler pushing the boundaries beyond what has been available even in the desktop music production worlds. And all this integrated in all relevant iOS production environments especially the emerging AUv3 AudioUnit standard.
- SSE - Streaming Sample Engine -
The ultra efficient Streaming Sample Engine SSE is capable of playing hundreds of voices of big multi-sampled instruments even in strictly resource limited applications like using multiple instances of AudioLayer in AudioUnit host environments. Innovative features like Sub Sample Looping for perfect loops even in the audible range extend the range of applications even further.
- Multiple storage options -
The consequent usage of the open file structure of the Files app makes organising even large sample libraries a breeze. Sample recordings and Instrument designs made with AudioLayer are seamlessly available across all your devices and desktop using either iCloud storage or external SSD. The iCloud option opens up new forms of collaborations with musicians all around the world to share your creations and work together.
- Multi Scope Editing -
To support the creation of complex multi-sampled instruments AudioLayer allows you to use a hierarchical structure of Layers and Zones each with it’s own sound manipulation parameters. A unique element of AudioLayer is the possibility to decide for each Zone at which Scope level your editing apply: For the all Zones in the Instrument, for the Layer only or individually for this Zone only. This opens a whole new world of creative options for sound mangling. For sound manipulation you can use a full set of Filters, Envelopes and LFOs to shape the pitch, timbre and level of the sound of each Zone.
SIS - Seamless Instrument Switching
The unique architecture of the Streaming Sample Engine allows for instant loading of even complex instruments and makes this switching from one Instrument to the next without cutting off the sound! And this includes of course also different effect settings
- Easy Design Workflow -
The built in audio sample recorder let you create Instruments on the fly in seconds. The Music Effect AudioUnit / Audiobus effect plugin of AudioLayer let you record multi-samples semi automatically directly inside your preferred host and instantly create an Instrument with the help of several Auto mapping options available. This includes file name based mapping of key ranges and velocities and automatic pitch detection. For the creatives we’ve also integrated a special “Single Cycle Waveform” detector making the use of this special files a breeze.
- Auto Sampler feature for easy creation of Sample Instruments from hardware synthesiser.
- Versilian Studio Sample Library ( VCSL/VSCO ) with excellent strings and orchestra samples for free download
- Exchange libraries with XinematiX App
Integration
• Stand-alone App
• Sample import for EXS24 and SFZ Format
• AUv3 AudioUnit Instrument and Music Effect
• Inter App Audio
• Audiobus 3 Input/Effect with state saving support.
• Audio recorder with share function.
• Ableton Link compatible.

SIS - Seamless Instrument Switching
The unique architecture of the Streaming Sample Engine allows for instant loading of even complex instruments and makes this switching from one Instrument to the next without cutting off the sound! And this includes of course also different effect settings

- Easy Design Workflow -
The built in audio sample recorder let you create Instruments on the fly in seconds. The Music Effect AudioUnit / Audiobus effect plugin of AudioLayer let you record multi-samples semi automatically directly inside your preferred host and instantly create an Instrument with the help of several Auto mapping options available. This includes file name based mapping of key ranges and velocities and automatic pitch detection. For the creatives we’ve also integrated a special “Single Cycle Waveform” detector making the use of this special files a breeze.

- Auto Sampler feature for easy creation of Sample Instruments from hardware synthesiser.

- Versilian Studio Sample Library ( VCSL/VSCO ) with excellent strings and orchestra samples for free download

- Exchange libraries with XinematiX App

Integration

• Stand-alone App
• Sample import for EXS24 and SFZ Format
• AUv3 AudioUnit Instrument and Music Effect
• Inter App Audio
• Audiobus 3 Input/Effect with state saving support.
• Audio recorder with share function.
• Ableton Link compatible.

bluejetty:00024905:ios.description:
App developed to control your TV devices from your iOS devices. You need to have enabled USB/Network debugging on your Android device to get it work
Depending on the device, some functions may not be available. Also it is not tested
App allows:
- Install (sideload) apps from your iOS device to your TV devices
- Control your TV apps (include opening, uninstalling, disabling/enabling and downloading APK)
- Control apps permissions (grant/revoke)
- Build-in File Manager
- Make screenshot or screenrecord (you can't capture any video content due to OS restrictions)
- Send files from your phone to TV
- Control your device using remote control and mouse mode in the app 
- Open channels on your iOS device (only Android TV 8+)
- Paste text from your phone
- Run Shell commands
- Clear all apps cache using one button
- Reboot and power TV device 
- See usage of CPU, RAM, network and storage
- See running apps and force-stop them if needed

가스앱은 에스씨지랩에서 운영하는 에너지 통합 플랫폼 서비스입니다. 정부·공공기관을 대행하거나 대표하지 않습니다.
2025년 11월, 전북도시가스가 새로운 가족이 되었어요!
전북특별자치도 전주, 완주, 남원, 순창, 무주, 김제, 고창 지역에서도 가스앱을 이용할 수 있어요.
가스앱을 소개합니다!
도시가스 요금 조회, 납부, 이사 예약 등의 도시가스 서비스는 물론 캐시 혜택을 더해 요금 할인을 받을 수 있어요. 실시간 전기 요금을 확인하거나 에코마일리지를 가스앱 캐시로 전환하는 등 다양한 에너지 서비스를 제공합니다.
현재 서울, 인천, 경기, 강원, 충남, 충북, 전북, 전남, 경남, 제주 등 전국으로 확대 중이며, 더 많은 지역에서 이용할 수 있도록 준비하고 있어요.
가스앱 서비스 지역을 확인해 보세요.
▶ [전북도시가스] 전북특별자치도 : 전주시, 완주군, 남원시, 순창군, 무주군, 김제시, 고창군
▶ [서울도시가스] 서울11개구 : 강서구, 동작구, 서대문구, 영등포구, 은평구, 관악구, 마포구(일부), 서초구(일부), 양천구(일부), 용산구(일부), 종로구(일부) / 경기도 : 파주시, 고양시, 김포시(일부)
▶ [인천도시가스] 인천 : 영종구, 부평구, 계양구, 서해구, 검단구, 강화군, 제물포구(일부), 남동구(일부) / 경기 : 김포시(일부)
▶ [제주도시가스] 제주시, 서귀포시
▶ [JB㈜] 충청남도: 천안시, 공주시, 논산시, 보령시, 아산시, 금산군, 부여군, 서천군, 청양군
▶ [대륜E&S] 서울4개구 : 강북구, 노원구, 도봉구, 성북구(일부) / 경기도 : 의정부시, 포천시, 구리시, 동두천시, 양주시, 연천군
▶ [예스코] 서울9개구 : 동대문구, 중랑구, 광진구, 성동구, 중구, 마포구(일부), 성북구(일부), 용산구(일부), 종로구(일부) / 경기도 : 남양주시, 가평군, 양평군, 퇴계원
▶ [군산도시가스] 전북특별자치도 : 군산시, 진안군, 부안군, 임실군
▶ [귀뚜라미에너지] 서울3개구 : 구로구, 금천구, 양천구(일부)
▶ [참빛도시가스] 강원도 4개사 : 원주시, 강릉시, 속초시, 횡성군, 동해시, 삼척시, 고성군, 양양군 / 충청북도 : 충주시
▶ [MC에너지] 전남광주통합특별시 : 목포시, 무안군, 영암군, 강진군
▶ [경동도시가스] 울산광역시, 양산시
▶ [미래엔서해에너지] 충청남도: 당진시, 서산시, 예산군, 태안군, 홍성군
▶ [대화도시가스] 전남광주통합특별시: 여수시
[주요 기능]
1. 그때 그때 알아서 보여주는 나만의 홈!
- 청구서가 나왔을 때, 자가 검침 기간일 때, 방문 예약일이 가까워 졌을 때 등 내가 필요한 순간에, 딱! 필요한 메뉴를 가스앱 홈에서 바로 확인할 수 있어요.
2. 요금 관리는 한 눈에
- 이번 달 요금, 납부 일정 확인은 물론 가스 요금을 월별, 연간 그래프로 한 눈에 비교할 수 있어요.
3. 간편결제 및 자동이체
- 카드, 가상계좌 등 다양한 결제 수단으로 납부하고, 간편결제나 자동이체도 쉽게 신청할 수 있어요.
4. 캐시 모아 가스비 절약
- 가입만 해도, 퀴즈만 풀어도, 광고만 봐도 캐시가 차곡히 쌓여요. 적립된 캐시로 가스 요금을 할인 받거나(일부 도시가스에 한함), 내 계좌로 인출해 보세요.
5. 모바일 자가검침

listings.name: 가스앱 - 에너지 절약의 시작
listings.description:
가스앱은 에스씨지랩에서 운영하는 에너지 통합 플랫폼 서비스입니다. 정부·공공기관을 대행하거나 대표하지 않습니다.

2025년 11월, 전북도시가스가 새로운 가족이 되었어요!
전북특별자치도 전주, 완주, 남원, 순창, 무주, 김제, 고창 지역에서도 가스앱을 이용할 수 있어요.

가스앱을 소개합니다!
도시가스 요금 조회, 납부, 이사 예약 등의 도시가스 서비스는 물론 캐시 혜택을 더해 요금 할인을 받을 수 있어요. 실시간 전기 요금을 확인하거나 에코마일리지를 가스앱 캐시로 전환하는 등 다양한 에너지 서비스를 제공합니다.
현재 서울, 인천, 경기, 강원, 충남, 충북, 전북, 전남, 경남, 제주 등 전국으로 확대 중이며, 더 많은 지역에서 이용할 수 있도록 준비하고 있어요.

▶ [인천도시가스] 인천 : 영종구, 부평구, 계양구, 서해구, 검단구, 강화군, 제물포구(일부), 남동구(일부) / 경기 : 김포시(일부)
▶ [제주도시가스] 제주시, 서귀포시
▶ [JB㈜] 충청남도: 천안시, 공주시, 논산시, 보령시, 아산시, 금산군, 부여군, 서천군, 청양군

▶ [예스코] 서울9개구 : 동대문구, 중랑구, 광진구, 성동구, 중구, 마포구(일부), 성북구(일부), 용산구(일부), 종로구(일부) / 경기도 : 남양주시, 가평군, 양평군, 퇴계원
▶ [군산도시가스] 전북특별자치도 : 군산시, 진안군, 부안군, 임실군

apple-macos:1620125472.name: Music Transpose - Key Changer
apple-macos:1620125472.description:
The Music Transpose app allows for easy transposition and adjustment of the speed of songs.
Features:
1. Supports common audio formats (mp3, m4a, wav, tiff, flac etc.) and video formats (mp4, mov, avi, mpg etc.).
2. Pitch adjustment displays the pitch range and supports color-coded prompts (green, orange and red indicate the impact on sound quality).
3. Supports fine-tuning of pitch in half-tone increments.
4. Speed adjustment is displayed as a multiple and also shows the tempo (BPM).
5. Pitch and speed adjustments are independent of each other.
6. Supports export in multiple formats.
Why use the Music Transpose app?
Adjusting the pitch and speed of music and songs is a common problem in music learning. While professional software can achieve this, it can be complicated to use. The Music Transpose app provides an easy-to-use solution.
Regarding purchasing:
The Music Transpose app is a one-time purchase and will remain valid for life without any additional charges. The app runs locally and does not depend on cloud functionality, so you do not need to worry about the software becoming unavailable due to network issues.
Regarding the trial and full versions:
The trial version limits the length of the files that can be previewed and exported, but all other features are the same as in the full version.
Regarding importing files:
The app provides information on how to import files from other common apps to the Music Transpose app. Other apps can usually share files directly to the Music Transpose app through the share function. You can also use AirDrop to send audio or video files from an Apple computer or an iPhone/iPad to the Music Transpose app.
Common issues and feedback:
"Why does the app say the file is invalid when I try to import it?"
The app checks the validity of imported files. If the app indicates that the file is invalid, you may need to check if the file is damaged and try again. Alternatively, you can convert the file to a common format and then import it.
"Why does the app stop working after the processing circle appears during preview?"
This issue is usually caused by file compatibility. We suggest converting the file to a different format and trying again. If it still does not work, you can send the file to yueyin.music@foxmail.com, and we will try to identify the problem and release a fix as soon as possible.
For any other questions or feedback, please email yueyin.music@foxmail.com or contact us through WeChat (ID: allhealthyand).

apple-macos:1542285854.name: Personal Weather Monitor
apple-macos:1542285854.description:
The Weather Monitor app is an alternative app for the Oregon Scientific Weather@Home compatible weather stations and sensors. 
Using bluetooth, the app connects to the weather station to show current conditions, as well as history on compatible devices. 
The recommended app is rarely updated and often has connectivity issues which prevent useful operation. 
The app features include:
Indoor and Outdoor temperatures (in ℃ or ℉)
Indoor and Outdoor humidity
Air pressure ( in hPa, mmHg or inHg)
Estimated Sunrise and Sunset times
Current moon phase
Predicted weather forecast for the next 12 hours
Supports Dark mode
Charts are displayed for the last 7 days of historical data 
An export feature is also included to export the current 7 day history to a CSV file which can be emailed from the phone
Currently in active development and considering all feature requests
Permissions:
Bluetooth - The app connects to Oregon Scientific weather stations using Bluetooth, WiFi devices are not supported
Location - The app requires location permission to use Bluetooth, as well as to calculate sunrise and sunset times.
